Linking stock_transfer to outbound_shipment enables transfer-in-transit tracking and carrie

attributes.name: primary_stock_inventory_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating inventory node (store, DC, MFC, or vendor location) from which the stock transfer is dispatched. Supports network balancing and omnichannel fulfillment analytics.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Promotional inventory redistribution tracking: retailers execute inter-node stock transfers to position inventory at high-traffic stores ahead of campaign launches. Direct campaign linkage on stock_tr

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating purchase order that triggered this stock transfer, applicable for DC-to-store replenishment flows sourced from supplier inbound receipts. Links transfer to procurement context.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: replenishment_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.replenishment_order. Business justification: Stock transfers between nodes are frequently triggered by replenishment orders — when a store needs restocking from a DC, a replenishment order is raised and a stock transfer is initiated. Linking sto

attributes.name: replenishment_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the replenishment plan that generated this stock transfer, linking the physical movement to the demand-driven planning signal from Blue Yonder or Oracle Retail. Supports replenishment accuracy analytics.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) being transferred. The SKU is the atomic unit of inventory tracking, uniquely identifying a product variant (size, color, style) within the retail assortment.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Product Classification; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Informatica MDM

attributes.name: uom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.uom. Business justification: Inter-node stock transfers require UOM master reference to ensure transfer_quantity is expressed in the correct unit for both source and destination nodes. Retail DC-to-store and store-to-store transf

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor. Business justification: stock_transfer has is_vendor_managed flag but no vendor reference. VMI replenishment transfers must be attributed to the managing vendor for chargeback processing, VMI settlement, and vendor complianc

attributes.name: actual_receipt_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the stock transfer was physically received and confirmed at the destination node. Compared against expected_receipt_date to measure carrier and DC performance against SLA targets.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System audit timestamp recording when this stock transfer record was first persisted in the data platform. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the transfer cost is denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency retail operations across international markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: destination_node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the receiving inventory node. STORE: retail store; DC: distribution center; MFC: micro-fulfillment center; VENDOR: supplier location for RTV; DARK_STORE: fulfillment-only location.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: expected_receipt_date
attributes.description: Planned calendar date by which the stock transfer is expected to arrive at the destination node. Used for replenishment planning, weeks of supply (WOS) calculations, and SLA compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; Manhattan Associates WMS; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: initiated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the stock transfer record was first created in the system, representing the business event of transfer initiation. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for the transfer lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: inventory_cost_per_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Inventory Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Per Unit
attributes.description: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) value per unit for the transferred SKU at time of transfer, used for inventory valuation, GMROI calculations, and financial reporting. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI/CO standard cost or moving average cost.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 330 Inventory Accounting; SAP S/4HANA Retail FI/CO Module

attributes.name: is_cross_dock
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this stock transfer is executed as a cross-docking (cross-dock) movement, where inventory is transferred directly from inbound to outbound at the DC without putaway storage. Supports DC throughput and flow-through analytics.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: is_ship_from_store
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this stock transfer is part of a ship-from-store (SFS) omnichannel fulfillment flow, where a retail store acts as a fulfillment node dispatching inventory to satisfy an e-commerce or BOPIS order.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: is_vendor_managed
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this stock transfer is part of a Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) program, where the supplier initiates and manages the replenishment transfer rather than the retailer's internal planning team.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); GS1 VMI Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or comments associated with the stock transfer, capturing exception details, special handling instructions, or carrier communication relevant to the transfer execution.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Operational priority assigned to the stock transfer, influencing pick sequencing, carrier selection, and dispatch scheduling at the DC or store. URGENT transfers may be triggered by stockout alerts or product recalls.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Actual number of units confirmed received at the destination node upon delivery. May differ from transfer_quantity due to transit damage, shrinkage, or carrier discrepancies. Drives inventory reconciliation and shrinkage monitoring.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module; FASB ASC 330 Inventory Accounting

attributes.name: rfid_enabled
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this stock transfer was tracked using RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) technology for real-time inventory visibility during transit. Supports RFID-based inventory accuracy programs.
attributes.references: GS1 RFID Standards; NRF RFID Implementation Guidelines

attributes.name: shipment_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the stock transfer was physically dispatched from the source node. Used for lead time calculation, carrier SLA tracking, and inventory in-transit reporting.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; GS1 Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: source_node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the originating inventory node. STORE: retail store; DC: distribution center; MFC: micro-fulfillment center; VENDOR: supplier location for RTV or DSD; DARK_STORE: fulfillment-only location.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this stock transfer record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver layer provenance tracking across the retail technology stack.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; Informatica MDM Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned shipment tracking number for the stock transfer, enabling real-time in-transit visibility and last-mile delivery monitoring. Used for exception management and carrier SLA validation.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; GS1 Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: transfer_cost
attributes.description: Total logistics cost incurred for executing this stock transfer, including carrier freight charges, handling fees, and any 3PL surcharges. Used for inventory valuation (COGS), P&L allocation, and supply chain cost optimization.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 330 Inventory Accounting; SAP S/4HANA Retail FI/CO Module

attributes.name: transfer_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business reference number for the stock transfer, used for tracking and communication across supply chain partners, carriers, and store operations. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM transfer order numbering.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; GS1 Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: transfer_quantity
attributes.description: Number of units of the SKU authorized and dispatched in this stock transfer. Represents the planned transfer quantity as recorded at time of transfer creation.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: transfer_reason_code
attributes.description: Business reason code explaining why the stock transfer was initiated. REPLENISHMENT: routine inventory restocking; NETWORK_BALANCE: lateral balancing to address overstock/understock; RTV: return to vendor; RECALL: product safety recall per CPSC; DAMAGE_RETURN: return of damaged goods; OMNICHANNEL: ship-from-store or BOPIS fulfillment support.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); CPSC Product Recall Standards; NRF Inventory Management Standards

attributes.name: transfer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the stock transfer. DRAFT: initiated but not yet dispatched; IN_TRANSIT: shipment dispatched from source node; RECEIVED: confirmed receipt at destination node; CANCELLED: transfer voided before completion; EXCEPTION: discrepancy or damage reported during transit.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: transfer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inter-node inventory movement. DC_TO_STORE: distribution center replenishment to store; STORE_TO_STORE: lateral balancing between stores; STORE_TO_DC: reverse logistics or consolidation; CROSS_DOCK: direct transfer without storage per cross-docking (DSD) model; RTV: Return to Vendor; MFC_TO_STORE: micro-fulfillment center to store for omnichannel fulfillment (ship-from-store).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Manhattan Associates WMS; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code (UPC) barcode identifier for the transferred SKU, used for scanning and verification during pick, pack, and receipt operations at DC and store nodes.
attributes.references: GS1 US UPC Standards; CPSC Product Identification Requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System audit timestamp recording the most recent modification to this stock transfer record, such as status updates, quantity adjustments, or receipt confirmations. Supports change data capture and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: Difference between transfer_quantity and received_quantity, representing units lost, damaged, or unaccounted for during transit. Positive value indicates shortage; negative indicates overage. Drives shrinkage monitoring and carrier chargeback processes.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; FASB ASC 330 Inventory Accounting; NRF Shrinkage Standards

attributes.name: variance_reason_code
attributes.description: Reason code explaining the cause of any quantity variance between dispatched and received units. Used for shrinkage root cause analysis, carrier chargeback (RMA) processing, and inventory reconciliation.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; NRF Shrinkage and Loss Prevention Standards

products.name: goods_receipt
products.description: Records physical receipt of merchandise at DCs, stores, and MFCs against purchase orders, replenishment orders, or transfer orders. Captures receipt date, receiving node, supplier/source, PO/ASN reference, line-level received/accepted/rejected quantities with discrepancy details (shortage, overage, wrong SKU, damage), unit cost, receipt method (DSD, DC-to-store, cross-dock), quality inspection status, and discrepancy resolution status. Supports receiving workflows, vendor compliance chargebacks, and inventory accuracy at point of induction.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for each goods receipt record in the inventory domain. Primary key for the goods_receipt data product.

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ap_invoice. Business justification: Three-way match (PO + GR + AP Invoice) is a core retail AP process. Linking goods_receipt to ap_invoice enables payment authorization, invoice-to-receipt reconciliation, and chargeback processing. Ret

attributes.name: buyer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.buyer. Business justification: Buyers monitor receipt performance (on-time, quantity accuracy, quality issues) for their purchase orders. Receipt variance resolution and vendor performance scorecarding are buyer responsibilities. B

attributes.name: buying_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.buying_order. attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.carrier. Business justification: Carrier performance reporting: goods receipts record the inbound carrier. Replacing the denormalized carrier_name with a proper FK to fulfillment.carrier enables carrier on-time delivery and damage-ra

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Receiving operations are cost centers with labor, equipment, and overhead costs tracked for budgeting and efficiency analysis. Goods_receipt needs cost_center_id to allocate receiving costs and measur

attributes.name: cost_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.cost_price. Business justification: Receiving process validates invoice costs against contracted pricing and updates landed cost. Three-way match (PO-receipt-invoice) depends on linking goods receipt to cost structure for variance detec

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.department. Business justification: DSD (direct store delivery) receipts are received into specific store departments. Department-level receiving reports, DSD reconciliation, and department receiving compliance tracking are named retail

attributes.name: financial_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.financial_period. Business justification: Goods receipts must be matched to financial periods for uninvoiced receipts accrual accounting in retail. Finance teams use this for period-end GR/IR reconciliation and to ensure inventory asset posti

attributes.name: inbound_appointment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled inbound dock appointment at the receiving node. Links to the inbound_appointment product for dock scheduling, carrier arrival tracking, and receiving labor planning.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: inbound_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.inbound_shipment. Business justification: Goods receipts are triggered by inbound shipment arrivals. Linking goods_receipt to inbound_shipment enables 3-way match (PO/shipment/receipt), carrier performance tracking, and discrepancy resolution

attributes.name: inventory_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical location (DC, store, or MFC) where the merchandise was received. Supports inventory accuracy at point of induction and omnichannel fulfillment visibility.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Goods receipt triggers GR/IR clearing journal entry (inventory asset debit, GR/IR liability credit) in retail accounting. Finance teams require direct traceability from goods_receipt to journal_entry

attributes.name: lead_time_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.lead_time_agreement. Retail DC receiving operation

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific purchase order line item being received. Enables line-level PO matching, partial receipt tracking, and SKU-level discrepancy analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent purchase order against which this goods receipt is posted. Enables PO-to-receipt matching, open order tracking, and three-way match (PO, receipt, invoice) for accounts payable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading number from the carrier's shipping documentation. Used for shipment tracking, freight audit, carrier dispute resolution, and customs compliance for international shipments.

attributes.name: chargeback_eligible

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System audit timestamp recording when this goods receipt record was first created in the data platform. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and SLA monitoring.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: discrepancy_resolution_status

attributes.name: discrepancy_type

attributes.name: expected_qty
attributes.description: Quantity of units expected at the receiving node based on the ASN or replenishment plan. May differ from ordered quantity due to partial shipments or split deliveries. Used for receiving dock planning and discrepancy detection.

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the quality inspection of received merchandise was completed. Used for compliance reporting, CPSC/FDA audit trails, and receiving cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: ordered_qty
attributes.description: Quantity of units originally ordered on the purchase order line. Used as the baseline for receipt variance calculation, fill rate measurement, and vendor compliance scoring.

attributes.name: overage_qty
attributes.description: Quantity of units received in excess of the ASN or PO expectation (received_qty minus expected_qty when positive). Overages require disposition decisions and may trigger vendor compliance chargebacks.

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Externally-known purchase order number as referenced on supplier documentation and EDI transactions. Retained for operational readability, vendor communication, and three-way match without requiring a join.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_status

'not_required' = inspection waived per supplier agreement; 'pending' = awaiting inspection; 'passed' = all units meet quality standards; 'failed' = units do not meet standards; 'partial_pass' = some units accepted, some rejected. Drives accepted/rejected quantity split.

attributes.name: receipt_date

attributes.name: receipt_method

attributes.name: receipt_notes

attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the goods receipt document, typically generated by the WMS or ERP upon physical receipt confirmation. Maps to SAP Material Document Number (MBLNR) or Manhattan WMS Receipt Number.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: receipt_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the goods receipt workflow. attributes.name: receiving_node_type

attributes.name: rejected_qty

attributes.name: rfid_verified

attributes.name: shortage_qty

attributes.name: unit_cost

attributes.name: upc

attributes.references: ISO 27001; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability)

Single source of truth for all reserved and held stock, enabling accurate ATP calculation on stock_position.

Null for non-order-driven hard holds.

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific business reason for the reservation or hold (e.g., BOPIS_ALLOC, SFS_ALLOC, ECOM_HOLD, QA_FAIL, RECALL_CPSC, LEGAL_HOLD, DMG_INBOUND, PRICE_INVEST). Enables operational reporting and root-cause analysis of inventory encumbrances.

attributes.name: hold_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the specific reason for the inventory hold or reservation, providing operational context beyond the structured hold_reason_code. Required for legal holds and regulatory recalls per compliance documentation standards.

attributes.name: inventory_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) per unit for the reserved SKU at the time of reservation creation. Used for financial valuation of encumbered inventory, shrinkage reporting, and GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) analysis. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Retail FI/CO module.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 330 Inventory Accounting; SAP S/4HANA Retail FI/CO Module

attributes.name: is_recalled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reservation was created in response to a regulatory product recall (CPSC, FDA, or other governing body). When true, the hold cannot be released without explicit compliance authorization. Supports mandatory recall reporting and quarantine workflows.
attributes.references: CPSC Consumer Product Safety Standards; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); NRF Recall Procedures

attributes.name: is_vendor_managed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reserved inventory is managed under a Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) agreement, where the supplier retains ownership and replenishment responsibility. Affects financial liability and hold authorization workflows.

attributes.name: priority_level

attributes.name: release_notes

attributes.name: release_status

attributes.name: release_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the reservation was released, cancelled, or converted. Null while the reservation is active. Used for hold duration analysis, SLA compliance reporting, and ATP recalculation upon release.

attributes.name: reservation_number

attributes.name: reservation_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) when the inventory encumbrance was created — the principal business event timestamp. For BOPIS/e-commerce holds, this is when the customer completed checkout. For quality/legal holds, this is when the hold was authorized.

attributes.description: Classification of the ASN by origin and fulfillment pattern. 'supplier' = inbound from vendor; 'dc_transfer' = inter-DC or DC-to-store transfer; 'cross_dock' = direct cross-dock flow; 'drop_ship' = vendor direct-to-customer; 'return_to_dc' = store or customer return to DC.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading number issued by the carrier for the shipment. Legal document of title used for freight claims, customs clearance, and receiving verification.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ASN record was first created in the system, either upon EDI 856 inbound processing or manual entry. Audit trail for record lineage.

attributes.name: destination_node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the receiving node. Determines which receiving workflow and dock door assignment logic applies in the WMS.

attributes.name: discrepancy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a receiving discrepancy (quantity overage, shortage, or SKU mismatch) was detected when comparing the ASN to the actual goods receipt. Triggers discrepancy resolution workflow.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: discrepancy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the receiving discrepancy detected against the ASN. 'overage' = more units received than declared; 'shortage' = fewer units; 'sku_mismatch' = wrong SKU received; 'damage' = goods received in damaged condition; 'none' = no discrepancy.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: dock_door_number
attributes.description: Assigned dock door at the destination node for unloading this shipment. Pre-assigned during dock scheduling to optimize receiving throughput and yard management.

attributes.name: expected_arrival_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date the shipment is expected to arrive at the destination node. Drives dock door scheduling, labor planning, and replenishment availability projections.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: freight_terms
attributes.description: Freight payment responsibility terms for the shipment. 'prepaid' = supplier pays freight; 'collect' = receiver pays; 'third_party' = billed to a third party. Drives accounts payable freight accruals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; GS1 EDI 856

attributes.name: is_cross_dock
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment is designated for cross-docking (direct transfer without storage) at the destination DC. Triggers cross-dock workflow in the WMS and bypasses putaway.

attributes.name: is_rfid_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether RFID tags are present on cartons or pallets in this shipment, enabling automated receiving and inventory tracking via RFID readers at the dock.
attributes.references: GS1 RFID Standards; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: External purchase order number as referenced on the ASN document. Denormalized from the PO for cross-system matching with EDI 856 transmissions and supplier invoices.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; GS1 EDI 856

attributes.name: pro_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned Progressive (PRO) number for LTL (Less-Than-Truckload) shipments. Used for freight bill matching and carrier invoice reconciliation.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 856; National Motor Freight Traffic Association (NMFTA)

attributes.name: receiving_complete_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when all line items on the ASN were fully received and confirmed in the WMS. Marks the transition from 'receiving' to 'received' or 'discrepant' status.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

attributes.name: ship_date
attributes.description: Date the shipment was physically dispatched from the source node or supplier facility. Used to calculate lead time and measure supplier on-time shipping performance.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 856; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: shipment_mode
attributes.description: Transportation mode used for the shipment. Drives freight cost benchmarking, carrier selection analytics, and carbon footprint reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: truckload|ltl|parcel|rail|air|ocean|intermodal — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the originating node. Distinguishes supplier facilities from internal DC, MFC, store, or dark store nodes to support routing and receiving workflow logic.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this ASN record. Supports data lineage tracking and multi-system reconciliation in the lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: total_cartons
attributes.description: Total number of cartons (cases/boxes) included in the shipment as declared on the ASN. Used for dock receiving verification, pallet count planning, and discrepancy detection.

attributes.name: total_pallets
attributes.description: Total number of pallets in the shipment as declared on the ASN. Used for dock door capacity planning, unloading labor scheduling, and yard management.

attributes.name: total_units
attributes.description: Total number of sellable units across all SKU lines declared on the ASN. Used for pre-receiving inventory projection and receiving discrepancy detection against goods receipt.

attributes.name: total_volume_m3
attributes.description: Total cubic volume of the shipment in cubic meters as declared on the ASN. Used for trailer utilization analysis, DC storage capacity planning, and freight density calculations.

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: Gross weight of the entire shipment in kilograms as declared on the ASN. Used for freight cost calculation, carrier compliance, and dock equipment planning.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned tracking number for the shipment. Enables real-time in-transit visibility and last-mile delivery monitoring via carrier APIs.

attributes.name: transmission_method
attributes.description: Channel through which the ASN was received. 'edi_856' = GS1 EDI 856 standard; 'api' = REST/SOAP API integration; 'manual' = entered by receiving staff; 'portal' = supplier self-service portal.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 856; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: transmission_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ASN was transmitted by the supplier or DC via EDI 856 or API. Distinct from created_timestamp; used to measure EDI lead time and supplier advance notice compliance.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 856; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the ASN record, including status transitions, quantity updates, or carrier information changes. Supports change data capture in the lakehouse.

products.name: lot

This supports product recall management, FEFO rotation, and food safety regulatory compliance — a mandatory retail

Linking lot to receiving_event enables lot-level quality audit trails and recall trace

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Each lot contributes to a specific stock position (SKU+node combination). The lot tracks individual batch quantities (available_quantity, quantity) that roll up into the aggregate stock_position. Link

attributes.name: uom_id

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor who provided this lot. Critical for recall management and vendor performance tracking.

attributes.name: vendor_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor_item. Business justification: Lot traceability for food safety, recall management, and regulatory compliance requires linking each lot to the vendor's item specification (country_of_origin, GTIN, certification). Retail food safety

attributes.name: warehouse_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.warehouse_zone. Business justification: Lots are stored in specific warehouse zones (temperature-controlled, hazmat, ambient). Linking lot to warehouse_zone enables FEFO-compliant putaway zone assignment and temperature compliance tracking

attributes.name: available_quantity
attributes.description: Current quantity available for sale or allocation from this lot. Decreases as units are sold or reserved.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer or supplier assigned batch identifier. May differ from internal lot number for vendor-managed inventory scenarios.

attributes.name: best_before_date

attributes.name: certification_code
attributes.description: Product certification or compliance code for the lot. Examples: organic, kosher, halal, fair trade, non-GMO. Supports labeling and marketing claims.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating where the product was manufactured or grown. Required for customs and labeling compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lot record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for unit cost. Standard codes include USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, etc.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the product lot expires and should no longer be sold or consumed. Mandatory for perishable goods and pharmaceuticals.

attributes.name: fefo_sequence

attributes.name: gtin

attributes.name: inspection_date

attributes.name: inspection_result

attributes.name: is_private_label

attributes.name: is_recalled

attributes.name: quantity

attributes.name: recall_reference_number
attributes.description: Official recall case or reference number issued by regulatory authority or manufacturer. Links to recall management system.

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date when the lot was received into inventory at the destination node. Used for aging analysis and FEFO sequencing.

attributes.name: remaining_shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Number of days remaining until expiry as of the current date. Calculated field used for near-expiry alerts and markdown triggers.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Total shelf life of the product in days from manufacture date to expiry date. Used for aging analysis and markdown planning.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system that created or owns this lot record. Examples: WMS, ERP, MDM. Supports data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Warehouse bin, zone, or storage location where the lot is physically stored. Supports pick/pack operations and cycle counting.

attributes.name: supplier_lot_reference
attributes.description: Supplier's original lot or batch identifier. Used for traceability back to the supplier's manufacturing records.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Required storage temperature zone for the lot. Critical for cold chain compliance and food safety.

attributes.name: unit_cost

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

domains.name: customer
domains.description: Single source of truth for all customer identity, profiles, households, segments (B2C and B2B), contact information, preferences, and RFM (Recency Frequency Monetary) analytics. Manages customer lifecycle, NPS scores, CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value), CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost), consent/privacy preferences, and omnichannel interaction history. Supports personalized clienteling and customer recognition across POS, e-commerce, and mobile.

products.name: profile
products.description: Golden record for every customer (B2C and B2B) served by Retail. Stores core identity attributes sourced from Informatica MDM including full legal name, date of birth, gender, preferred language, nationality, customer type (individual/corporate), acquisition channel, CAC, CLTV score, NPS score, lifecycle stage, privacy consent flags (GDPR/CCPA), and golden-record confidence score. This is the single authoritative master entity for all customer identity data across POS, e-commerce, and mobile channels.

products.name: customer_membership
products.description: This association product represents the assignment of customer profiles to market segments for targeted marketing, personalized pricing, and differentiated service delivery. It captures the operational reality that customers can simultaneously belong to multiple segments (e.g., VIP Gold + High CLTV + Geographic Northeast) and that segments contain many customers. Each record links one profile to one segment with lifecycle attributes (start/end dates, status), assignment metadata (method, confidence, override flags), and qualification tracking that exist only in the context of this membership relationship.. Existence Justification: Customer segmentation in retail operates as a true many-to-many relationship where individual customer profiles are simultaneously assigned to multiple segments (e.g., a customer can be both 'VIP Gold Tier' and 'High CLTV' and 'Northeast Geographic' at the same time), and each segment definition contains thousands of customer profiles. Marketing teams actively manage these memberships as operational business entities, tracking when customers enter/exit segments, how they were assigned (auto-refresh vs. manual override), and qualification confidence scores. The segment table currently has no FK relationships to profile—it is a definition table that requires an association product to operationalize the membership relationship.

products.description: Authoritative master record for every Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) in the retail assortment. This is the SSOT for all SKU-level product identity and physical characteristics across the enterprise. Captures the unique sellable unit identity including UPC, EAN, GTIN, internal item number, SKU description, brand reference, unit of measure, pack size, weight, dimensions (gross/net weight, length, width, height, volume, cube), ti-hi pallet configuration, temperature requirement, stackability, country of origin, hazmat flag, age-restriction flag, shelf life, product lifecycle status (active, discontinued, seasonal, clearance, pending setup), and creation/modification timestamps. Aligned with GS1 GDSN Trade Item standard. Sourced from Informatica MDM and Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS). Central hub entity — all other product domain entities reference this record.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Stock Keeping Unit. Primary key for the SKU master record.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_brand. Business justification: Every SKU in the retail assortment belongs to exactly one brand (national brand or private label). product_brand is the authoritative brand master. Adding brand_id FK normalizes the brand relationship

attributes.name: item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.item_hierarchy. Business justification: sku has department_code, category_code, subcategory_code (all STRING) which should be normalized to a single FK to item_hierarchy. The hierarchy table is the authoritative source for merchandise taxon

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_location. Business justification: Store-level assortment planning and authorization. Retail assortment systems maintain store-SKU authorization matrices determining which items each store is authorized to carry. Critical for planogram

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: In retail, each SKU is assigned a default price list (regular retail, clearance, wholesale) governing its base selling price. Pricing analysts use this assignment in price list maintenance reports and

attributes.name: uom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.uom. Business justification: sku.unit_of_measure (STRING) should be normalized to a proper FK to uom reference table. UOM is the authoritative master for all units of measure with conversion factors and standards compliance (GS1,

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary supplier or vendor who provides this SKU to the retailer. Links to the supplier master data.

attributes.name: age_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU has age restrictions for purchase (e.g., alcohol, tobacco, mature-rated products). True if age-restricted, False if not.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating where the product was manufactured or produced. Required for customs and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this SKU record was first created in the master data system. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: cube
attributes.description: Cubic volume of the SKU package calculated as length × width × height. Used for warehouse space planning and transportation optimization. Measured in cubic feet or cubic meters.

attributes.name: dimension_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for length, width, and height fields. IN (Inch), CM (Centimeter), FT (Foot), M (Meter).

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when this SKU will be or was discontinued and removed from the active assortment. Null if the SKU is not planned for discontinuation. Follows format yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: ean
attributes.description: 13-digit European Article Number used for product identification globally. International barcode standard.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this SKU becomes active and available for sale. Used for new product launches and seasonal assortment planning. Follows format yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: gross_weight
attributes.description: Total weight of the SKU including packaging, measured in the unit specified by weight_unit_of_measure. Used for shipping and logistics calculations.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number that uniquely identifies trade items worldwide. Can be 8, 12, 13, or 14 digits. Umbrella term encompassing UPC, EAN, and other GS1 identifiers.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is classified as hazardous material requiring special handling, storage, and transportation procedures. True if hazmat, False if not.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Height dimension of the SKU package, measured in the unit specified by dimension_unit_of_measure. Used for space planning and logistics.

attributes.name: hi
attributes.description: Number of layers (tiers) that can be stacked on a pallet. Part of the Ti-Hi pallet configuration used in warehouse and distribution center operations.

attributes.name: image_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the primary product image. Used for e-commerce, mobile apps, and digital signage.

attributes.name: internal_item_number
attributes.description: Retailer-specific internal product identifier used in legacy systems and internal operations. May differ from external GTIN/UPC.

attributes.name: length
attributes.description: Length dimension of the SKU package, measured in the unit specified by dimension_unit_of_measure. Used for space planning and logistics.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SKU in the product assortment. ACTIVE (currently sold), DISCONTINUED (no longer ordered), SEASONAL (sold during specific periods), CLEARANCE (being phased out), PENDING_SETUP (not yet available for sale), INACTIVE (temporarily unavailable).

attributes.name: minimum_age_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum age in years required to purchase this SKU. Null if no age restriction applies. Typically 18 or 21 for restricted products.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this SKU record was last modified in the master data system. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: net_weight
attributes.description: Weight of the product contents excluding packaging, measured in the unit specified by weight_unit_of_measure. Used for regulatory compliance and consumer information.

attributes.name: pack_size
attributes.description: Number of consumer units contained in a single sellable pack. For example, a 6-pack of soda has pack_size = 6.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Number of days the product remains sellable and safe for consumption from the date of manufacture or receipt. Critical for perishable goods and inventory rotation.

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Abbreviated product description for use in constrained display contexts such as receipts, labels, and mobile interfaces. Typically 40-60 characters.

attributes.name: sku_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the SKU including key product attributes, features, and specifications. Used for product information management and customer-facing displays.

attributes.name: stackable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU can be safely stacked during storage and transportation. True if stackable, False if not.

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Storage and transportation temperature requirement for the SKU. AMBIENT (room temperature), REFRIGERATED (32-40°F), FROZEN (below 0°F), CONTROLLED (specific temperature range).

attributes.name: ti
attributes.description: Number of units per layer on a pallet. Part of the Ti-Hi pallet configuration used in warehouse and distribution center operations.

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code used for point-of-sale scanning in North America. Standard barcode identifier for retail products.

attributes.name: vendor_item_number
attributes.description: The supplier's own product identifier for this SKU. Used for purchase orders and vendor communication.

attributes.name: volume
attributes.description: Volume or capacity of the product, measured in the unit specified by volume_unit_of_measure. Relevant for liquid and bulk products.

attributes.name: volume_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for volume field. GAL (Gallon), LTR (Liter), ML (Milliliter), OZ (Fluid Ounce), QT (Quart).

attributes.name: weight_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for gross_weight and net_weight fields. LB (Pound), KG (Kilogram), OZ (Ounce), G (Gram).

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Width dimension of the SKU package, measured in the unit specified by dimension_unit_of_measure. Used for space planning and logistics.

products.name: item_hierarchy
products.description: Defines the full merchandise hierarchy and category taxonomy used to organize SKUs into departments, categories, subcategories, and segments for both operational and strategic purposes. This is the SSOT for all product classification and category management taxonomy. Captures hierarchy node identity, node code, node name, level (department, category, subcategory, segment), parent node reference (self-referencing for tree traversal), hierarchy path, hierarchy type (operational, strategic/category management), buyer assignment, planner assignment, strategic classification (destination, routine, convenience, seasonal), assortment breadth/depth targets, category manager, and effective dates. Supports category management, assortment planning, planogram design, financial reporting roll-ups, and NRF ARTS merchandise hierarchy alignment. Managed in Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) and SAP S/4HANA MM module.

attributes.name: item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the item hierarchy node. Primary key for the item hierarchy entity. This is the system-generated surrogate key for each node in the merchandise hierarchy tree.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.cost_center

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.gl_account

attributes.name: parent_hierarchy_node_item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent node in the hierarchy tree. Self-referencing relationship enabling tree traversal and roll-up aggregations. Null for top-level division nodes.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.profit_center

attributes.name: allows_direct_sku_assignment
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allows Direct SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) Assignment Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether SKUs can be directly assigned to this hierarchy node. Typically True for leaf nodes (subcategory, segment, class) and False for parent nodes (division, department, category). Controls data quality and hierarchy integrity in PIM (Product Information Management) systems.

attributes.name: assortment_breadth_target
attributes.description: Target number of distinct subcategories or product families within this category. Assortment breadth measures the range of categories offered. Used in category management and OTB (Open to Buy) planning.

attributes.name: assortment_depth_target
attributes.description: Target number of distinct SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) within a subcategory or product family. Assortment depth measures the variety within a category. Deeper assortments offer more choice but increase inventory complexity and carrying costs.

attributes.name: category_manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the category manager responsible for strategic category management, assortment optimization, and category P&L performance. Category managers define assortment breadth and depth targets and drive GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hierarchy node record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and master data governance. Automatically populated by Informatica MDM (Master Data Management) or source system.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Automated data quality score (0-100) calculated by Informatica MDM based on completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness rules. Scores below threshold trigger data stewardship workflows. Supports master data governance and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this hierarchy node is retired or deprecated. Null for currently active nodes. Supports historical reporting and category lifecycle management. Enables analysis of discontinued categories and assortment changes over time.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this hierarchy node becomes active and available for use in assortment planning, purchase orders, and reporting. Supports time-variant hierarchy structures and seasonal category introductions.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: External identifier from source system or third-party data provider. Used for cross-system reconciliation, EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) integration, and external reporting. Examples: GS1 category codes, NRF ARTS hierarchy IDs, supplier category codes.

attributes.name: hierarchy_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the hierarchy node purpose, scope, and business rules. Includes category definition, inclusion/exclusion criteria, and merchandising guidelines. Used for training, onboarding, and cross-functional alignment.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The level of this node within the merchandise hierarchy tree. Defines the depth and classification granularity. Division is the highest level, followed by department, category, subcategory, segment, and class as the most granular.

attributes.name: hierarchy_node_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the hierarchy node. This is the externally-known unique code used in Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) and SAP S/4HANA MM module for category management and reporting. Examples: DEPT01, CAT-ELEC, SUBCAT-TV.

attributes.name: hierarchy_node_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the hierarchy node. Examples: Electronics, Home Appliances, Televisions, 4K Smart TVs. Used in reporting, planograms, and category management dashboards.

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Full path from root to current node using node codes separated by forward slashes. Example: DIVISION01/DEPT05/CAT-ELEC/SUBCAT-TV. Enables efficient hierarchy queries and reporting roll-ups without recursive joins.

attributes.name: hierarchy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the hierarchy purpose. Operational hierarchies support daily store operations and planograms. Strategic hierarchies support category management and assortment planning. Financial hierarchies align with P&L reporting. Planning hierarchies support OTB (Open to Buy) and MRP (Material Requirements Planning).

attributes.name: is_leaf_node
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this node is a leaf node (has no children) in the hierarchy tree. Leaf nodes are the most granular classification level and are directly associated with SKUs. True for leaf nodes, False for parent nodes.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system account that last modified this hierarchy node record. Supports audit trail, accountability, and master data governance. Captured from Informatica MDM workflow or source system authentication.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hierarchy node record was last updated. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing. Updated automatically on every modification in Informatica MDM or source system.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Average supplier delivery lead time in days for this category. Used in demand planning, safety stock calculations, and OTB (Open to Buy) planning. Managed in Blue Yonder Demand Planning and Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS).

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the hierarchy node. Active nodes are in use for assortment planning and reporting. Inactive nodes are temporarily disabled. Pending nodes are awaiting approval. Deprecated nodes are being phased out. Archived nodes are retained for historical reporting only.

attributes.name: markdown_cadence
attributes.description: Frequency and timing of planned price markdowns for this category. Weekly and biweekly cadences support fast fashion and perishables. Monthly cadences support durable goods. Seasonal cadences align with end-of-season clearance. Event-driven markdowns respond to competitive pressure or excess inventory. Managed in Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM).

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required by suppliers for this category. Impacts purchase order planning, inventory carrying costs, and cash flow management. Negotiated by buyers and enforced in procurement systems.

attributes.name: omnichannel_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this category is available across all channels (stores, e-commerce, mobile app, BOPIS, ship-from-store). True for omnichannel categories, False for channel-specific categories. Supports unified commerce strategy and cross-channel inventory visibility.

attributes.name: planner_name
attributes.description: Name of the merchandise planner responsible for demand forecasting, inventory planning, and replenishment for this category. Planners use Blue Yonder Demand Planning to optimize inventory levels and minimize stockouts and overstock.

attributes.name: pricing_strategy
attributes.description: Pricing strategy classification for this category. EDLP (Everyday Low Price) maintains consistent low prices. Hi-Lo (High-Low Pricing Strategy) uses frequent promotions and markdowns. Premium targets higher-margin positioning. Competitive matches market pricing. Value emphasizes affordability. Managed in Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM).

attributes.name: private_label_penetration_target_percent
attributes.description: Target percentage of category sales from private label (store brand) products. Private label products typically offer higher margins than national brands. Used in assortment planning and supplier negotiations to optimize category profitability.

attributes.name: replenishment_method
attributes.description: Inventory replenishment method for this category. Auto uses system-driven replenishment based on demand forecasting. Manual requires planner intervention. Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) delegates replenishment to suppliers. Cross-docking transfers inventory directly from receiving to shipping. Drop ship sends directly from vendor to customer.

attributes.name: safety_stock_weeks
attributes.description: Target safety stock level expressed in weeks of supply (WOS). Buffer inventory to protect against demand variability and supply chain disruptions. Calculated based on service level targets and lead time variability in Blue Yonder Demand Planning.

attributes.name: seasonality_indicator
attributes.description: Seasonal demand pattern classification for this category. Non-seasonal categories have consistent year-round demand. Seasonal categories have predictable demand peaks tied to calendar periods. Used in demand forecasting, markdown planning, and inventory optimization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: non_seasonal|spring|summer|fall|winter|holiday|back_to_school — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence for ordering sibling nodes within the same parent. Used for consistent presentation in reports, planograms, and digital storefronts. Lower numbers appear first.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record that is the authoritative source for this hierarchy node. ORMS (Oracle Retail Merchandising System) for merchandising hierarchies, SAP MM (Materials Management) for procurement hierarchies, Informatica MDM for golden record hierarchies, Manual for user-created nodes.

attributes.name: strategic_classification
attributes.description: Strategic role of the category in the overall merchandising strategy. Destination categories drive store traffic and differentiation. Routine categories are frequently purchased staples. Convenience categories are impulse or fill-in purchases. Seasonal categories have time-bound demand. Private label vs. national brand classification supports margin optimization.

products.name: attribute
products.description: Stores extended descriptive, technical, and measurement attributes for each SKU beyond core identity fields using a flexible entity-attribute-value (EAV) pattern. Captures attribute name, attribute value, attribute group (e.g., fabric, color, size, flavor, nutritional supplement, technical spec, UOM conversion, environmental certification, data quality score), data type, unit of measure, conversion factor, validation rule, source system, and locale/language for multilingual and multi-market support. Enables faceted search on e-commerce platforms, product comparison, PIM-driven enrichment, multi-UOM transaction support across procurement/inventory/POS, data completeness scoring for GS1 GDSN readiness, and regulatory attribute capture. Sourced from Informatica MDM PIM module and Salesforce Commerce Cloud product catalog. Aligned with GS1 GDSN attribute standards for trade item data synchronization.

attributes.name: attribute_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product attribute record. Primary key for the product_attribute entity.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent product (SKU) to which this attribute belongs. Links to the product master catalog.

attributes.name: uom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.uom. Business justification: The attribute table stores extended descriptive and measurement attributes for SKUs, and has a unit_of_measure STRING column for the measurement unit of each attribute value. The uom table is the auth

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the person who approved this product attribute value for publication. Supports accountability and audit trails in PIM workflows.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this product attribute value was approved for publication or use in operational systems. Supports PIM workflow and governance processes.

attributes.name: attribute_group
attributes.description: Logical grouping or category of the attribute (e.g., 'physical', 'technical', 'descriptive', 'nutritional', 'environmental', 'regulatory', 'marketing', 'quality', 'packaging', 'pricing'). Enables faceted search and attribute organization in PIM systems. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: physical|technical|descriptive|nutritional|environmental|regulatory|marketing|quality|packaging|pricing — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: attribute_name
attributes.description: The name or label of the product attribute (e.g., 'color', 'size', 'fabric', 'flavor', 'wattage', 'nutritional_info'). Represents the semantic key in the entity-attribute-value (EAV) pattern.

attributes.name: attribute_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this attribute record (e.g., 'active', 'inactive', 'pending_approval', 'deprecated', 'archived'). Supports attribute governance and PIM workflow management.

attributes.name: attribute_value
attributes.description: The actual value of the product attribute (e.g., 'Red', 'Large', '100% Cotton', 'Vanilla', '60W', '15g protein per serving'). Stores the descriptive, technical, or measurement data for the attribute.

attributes.name: certification_body
attributes.description: The name of the organization or authority that certified this attribute value (e.g., 'USDA Organic', 'Energy Star', 'Fair Trade', 'UL Listed'). Applicable when is_certified is True.

attributes.name: certification_date
attributes.description: The date on which this attribute value was certified. Applicable when is_certified is True. Supports audit trails and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: conversion_factor
attributes.description: Numeric conversion factor to translate this attribute's unit of measure to a base or standard unit (e.g., 1 lb = 0.453592 kg). Enables cross-UOM calculations and reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this product attribute record was first created in the system. Supports audit trails and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0-100) representing the completeness and accuracy of this attribute value. Used for GS1 GDSN readiness assessment and PIM data quality dashboards.

attributes.name: data_type
attributes.description: The data type of the attribute value (e.g., 'string', 'numeric', 'boolean', 'date', 'timestamp', 'decimal'). Used for validation and type-safe processing in downstream systems.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence controlling the display order of attributes on product detail pages, labels, and reports. Lower numbers appear first.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date until which this attribute value is effective. Null indicates the attribute is currently active. Supports historical attribute tracking and product lifecycle management.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this attribute value is effective and should be used in product displays, transactions, and reporting. Supports time-variant attribute management.

attributes.name: is_certified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this attribute value has been certified or verified by an authoritative source (e.g., environmental certification, organic certification, safety compliance). True if certified, False otherwise.

attributes.name: is_comparable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this attribute should be displayed in product comparison views (True) or not (False). Supports side-by-side product comparison features in e-commerce.

attributes.name: is_regulatory_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this attribute is required by regulatory or legal mandate (e.g., FDA nutritional labeling, CPSC safety warnings, FTC advertising disclosures). True if mandated, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) and Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) Standards

attributes.name: is_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this attribute is mandatory for the product (True) or optional (False). Used for data completeness scoring and GS1 GDSN readiness checks.

attributes.name: is_searchable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this attribute should be indexed for faceted search on e-commerce platforms (True) or not (False). Drives search and filter capabilities in digital commerce.
attributes.references: E-Commerce Search and Merchandising Best Practices

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this product attribute record was last modified. Supports change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: The locale or language-region code for this attribute value (e.g., 'en_US', 'es_MX', 'fr_CA'). Supports multilingual and multi-market product catalogs for global retail operations.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes and ISO 3166-1 Country Codes

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or context about this product attribute. Used for internal documentation, special handling instructions, or data steward annotations.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Citation or reference to the specific regulation, statute, or standard that mandates this attribute (e.g., 'FDA 21 CFR 101.9', 'CPSC 16 CFR 1500', 'FTC 16 CFR Part 255'). Applicable when is_regulatory_required is True.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC), Food and Drug Administration (FDA), Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system or module from which this attribute was sourced (e.g., 'Informatica MDM', 'Salesforce Commerce Cloud', 'Oracle Retail Merchandising System', 'Supplier EDI'). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier or key for this attribute record in the source system. Enables traceability and cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: validation_rule
attributes.description: Business rule or regex pattern used to validate the attribute value (e.g., 'must be positive integer', 'must match color palette', 'must be ISO 8601 date'). Enforces data quality at attribute capture time.

products.name: brand
products.description: Master record for all brands carried in the retail assortment, covering national brands, private label (store brand), exclusive, and licensed products. Captures brand name, brand owner, brand type (national, private label, exclusive, licensed), brand tier (premium, value, standard), country of origin, brand logo asset reference, brand status, launch date, and brand portfolio grouping. Supports private label vs. national brand assortment strategy, vendor brand negotiations, brand-level margin analysis, and consumer-facing brand filtering on e-commerce platforms.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product brand record. Primary key.

attributes.name: margin_target_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.margin_target. Business justification: Retail pricing teams set margin targets at the brand level, especially for private label vs. national brand differentiation. product_brand.average_margin_percent is a denormalized representation of th

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Retail brand managers report brand-level P&L against dedicated profit centers. Private label vs. national brand profitability tracking is a standard retail management reporting process. Brand-to-profi

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary supplier or vendor who provides products under this brand. Links to the supplier master data for vendor negotiations, chargeback processing, and Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) programs.

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the brand for internal identification and system integration. Used in merchandising, procurement, and reporting systems.

attributes.name: brand_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the brand positioning, value proposition, target customer segment, and key differentiators. Used for internal merchandising guidance and external marketing content.

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: Official registered name of the brand as it appears on product packaging and marketing materials. Consumer-facing brand identifier.

attributes.name: brand_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the brand in the retail assortment. Active brands are available for new item setup and replenishment; inactive brands are temporarily suspended; discontinued brands are permanently removed; pending approval brands are under review for introduction.
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) Product Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: brand_tier
attributes.description: Market positioning tier indicating price point and quality perception. Premium brands command higher margins and target affluent consumers; value and economy brands focus on price-sensitive segments. Drives assortment strategy and shelf placement.
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) Merchandising Best Practices

attributes.name: brand_type
attributes.description: Classification of brand ownership and distribution model. National brands are manufacturer-owned and widely distributed; private label are retailer-owned store brands; exclusive brands are sold only through specific retail partnerships; licensed brands use third-party intellectual property.
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) Brand Classification Standards

attributes.name: country_of_origin_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the primary country where products under this brand are manufactured or sourced. Required for customs compliance and consumer transparency.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Country Codes, Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Country of Origin Labeling

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this brand record was first created in the Master Data Management (MDM) system. Used for data lineage tracking and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when the brand was permanently removed from the retail assortment. Null for active brands. Used for historical analysis and Return to Vendor (RTV) processing.

attributes.name: is_exclusive
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this brand is sold exclusively through this retailer or a limited retail partnership. True for exclusive brands, false for widely distributed brands. Supports competitive differentiation strategy.
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) Merchandising Best Practices

attributes.name: is_licensed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this brand operates under a licensing agreement using third-party intellectual property (e.g., character brands, celebrity brands, sports team brands). True for licensed brands, false otherwise. Impacts royalty payments and contract management.

attributes.name: is_private_label
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this brand is a retailer-owned private label (store brand) product. True for private label brands, false for national or licensed brands. Critical for margin analysis and private label penetration reporting.
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) Private Label Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this brand record was most recently updated in the Master Data Management (MDM) system. Used for change tracking and data synchronization across systems.

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Date when the brand was first introduced into the retail assortment. Used for new brand performance tracking, vendor scorecard evaluation, and assortment lifecycle analytics.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Average number of days from purchase order placement to product delivery at the Distribution Center (DC) for this brand. Used for demand planning, safety stock calculation, and Weeks of Supply (WOS) analysis.
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: license_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the licensing agreement for this brand expires. Null for non-licensed brands. Used for contract renewal planning and inventory liquidation strategy for expiring licenses.

attributes.name: logo_asset_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Brand Logo Asset Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
attributes.description: Reference URL or path to the digital brand logo asset stored in the Product Information Management (PIM) or Digital Asset Management (DAM) system. Used for e-commerce product pages, marketing materials, and mobile app display.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required by the supplier for purchase orders of products under this brand. Used for Open to Buy (OTB) planning and inventory replenishment optimization.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified this brand record. Used for audit trail and data governance accountability.

attributes.name: owner_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country where the brand owner is headquartered. Used for country-of-origin reporting and supplier diversity analytics.

attributes.name: owner_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the company or entity that owns the intellectual property rights to the brand. May be the retailer (for private label) or a manufacturer/supplier (for national brands).

attributes.name: portfolio_group
attributes.description: Higher-level grouping of related brands under a common portfolio or brand family. Enables portfolio-level margin analysis, vendor negotiations, and strategic assortment planning across brand families.
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) Category Management Standards

attributes.name: quality_rating
attributes.description: Internal quality assessment score for the brand based on product defect rates, customer returns, and quality audits. Scale of 0.00 to 5.00. Used for vendor scorecard evaluation and assortment quality management.

attributes.name: return_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of units sold under this brand that are returned by customers. Calculated as (units returned / units sold) * 100. High return rates may indicate quality issues or misaligned customer expectations.
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) Returns Management Standards

attributes.name: sustainability_certification
attributes.description: Environmental or social responsibility certifications held by the brand (e.g., Fair Trade, Organic, B Corp, Carbon Neutral). Supports ESG reporting and consumer filtering on e-commerce platforms for sustainable products.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management, Fair Trade International Standards

attributes.name: target_customer_segment
attributes.description: Primary demographic or psychographic customer segment that this brand is designed to appeal to (e.g., millennials, families, health-conscious, budget shoppers). Supports personalized marketing and assortment localization.
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) Customer Segmentation Standards

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Official website URL for the brand, providing additional product information, brand story, and consumer engagement content. Used for e-commerce product page enrichment and customer education.

products.name: item_variant
products.description: Captures all SKU-to-SKU relationships including variant relationships (parent style/base item to child SKUs across size, color, flavor, scent, pack configuration) and approved substitution relationships (equivalent, upgrade, downgrade, cross-sell for fulfillment and out-of-stock scenarios). This is the SSOT for all inter-SKU relationships within the product domain. Stores source SKU reference, target SKU reference, relationship type (variant, substitution), dimension type (size, color, flavor, etc.), dimension value, substitution priority rank, channel applicability (in-store, online, BOPIS), customer consent required flag, variant-level UPC, and effective dates. Critical for apparel size-color grids, grocery flavor/size variants, omnichannel fulfillment substitution, BOPIS/ROPIS picking, and reducing lost sales from stockouts. Enables parent-child item navigation in PIM and e-commerce.

attributes.name: item_variant_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the item variant relationship record. Primary key.

attributes.name: primary_item_sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent or source SKU in the variant or substitution relationship. For variant relationships, this is the parent style or base item. For substitution relationships, this is the original SKU being substituted.

attributes.name: target_item_sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the child or target SKU in the variant or substitution relationship. For variant relationships, this is the child SKU (specific size, color, flavor). For substitution relationships, this is the replacement SKU.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
