attributes.description: The date and time when this variant or substitution relationship was approved for activation. Used to track the approval workflow and ensure proper governance of product relationships.

attributes.name: auto_substitute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this substitution can be applied automatically by fulfillment systems without manual intervention. True enables automatic substitution during picking when the source item is out of stock. False requires manual approval or customer consent.

attributes.name: channel_applicability
attributes.description: Sales and fulfillment channels where this variant or substitution relationship is valid. All indicates the relationship applies across all channels. Specific values restrict the relationship to designated channels. Critical for omnichannel fulfillment and BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store) and ROPIS (Reserve Online Pick Up In Store) scenarios. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: all|in_store|online|bopis|ropis|mobile_app|call_center — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this variant relationship record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: customer_consent_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit customer consent is required before applying this substitution. True means the customer must approve the substitution (e.g., for price upgrades or significant product differences). False means the substitution can be applied automatically (e.g., for equivalent items). Applicable primarily for substitution relationships.
attributes.references: Consumer Protection Standards and Order Management Best Practices

attributes.name: display_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric order for displaying variants in e-commerce product pages, mobile apps, and digital catalogs. Lower numbers appear first. Used to control the presentation order of size-color grids and variant selectors.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this variant or substitution relationship expires and is no longer valid. Null indicates an open-ended relationship. Used to manage product lifecycle transitions and discontinuations.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this variant or substitution relationship becomes active and can be used by merchandising, e-commerce, and fulfillment systems. Supports time-bound relationships for seasonal assortments or promotional periods.

attributes.name: inventory_interchangeable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the source and target items can be treated as interchangeable for inventory allocation and fulfillment purposes. True means inventory of either item can fulfill demand for the other. False means they must be tracked separately. Relevant for substitution relationships.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this variant relationship record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization across systems.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, business rules, or special handling instructions related to this variant or substitution relationship. Used by merchandising and fulfillment teams for operational guidance.

attributes.name: price_differential_amount
attributes.description: The price difference between the source and target items. Positive values indicate the target is more expensive (upgrade). Negative values indicate the target is less expensive (downgrade). Zero or null indicates equivalent pricing. Used for substitution cost impact analysis.

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the variant or substitution relationship. Active means the relationship is in use. Inactive means temporarily disabled. Pending means awaiting approval or activation. Discontinued means permanently retired.

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Type of relationship between source and target items. Variant indicates parent-child SKU relationship (e.g., style to size-color). Substitution indicates approved replacement for out-of-stock scenarios. Cross-sell and upsell support merchandising. Bundle and accessory support product associations.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system that created or manages this variant relationship record. Examples: PIM for Product Information Management, MDM for Master Data Management, OMS for Order Management System. Used for data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: substitution_priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank indicating the priority order for substitution when multiple substitutes are available. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used by fulfillment systems to select the best substitute when the source item is out of stock.

attributes.name: substitution_type
attributes.description: Classification of the substitution relationship. Equivalent indicates same quality and price point. Upgrade indicates higher quality or price. Downgrade indicates lower quality or price. Alternative indicates different but acceptable replacement. Applicable only when relationship_type is substitution.

attributes.name: variant_dimension_type
attributes.description: The dimension along which the variant differs from the parent item. Applicable only when relationship_type is variant. Examples: size for apparel, flavor for beverages, scent for personal care, pack configuration for multi-packs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: size|color|flavor|scent|pack_configuration|material|style|fit|length|width — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: variant_dimension_value
attributes.description: The specific value of the variant dimension for the target item. Examples: Small, Medium, Large for size; Red, Blue, Green for color; Vanilla, Chocolate for flavor; 6-pack, 12-pack for pack configuration.

attributes.name: variant_ean
attributes.description: The 13-digit EAN barcode assigned to the target variant item. Used internationally for product identification and scanning. Common in European and global retail operations.

attributes.name: variant_group_code
attributes.description: A code that groups related variants together under a common parent style or product family. Used to aggregate sales, inventory, and performance metrics across all variants of a base item. Supports category management and assortment planning.

attributes.name: variant_gtin
attributes.description: The Global Trade Item Number assigned to the target variant item. GTIN is the umbrella term for UPC, EAN, and other GS1 product identifiers. Used for global supply chain and EDI transactions.

attributes.name: variant_upc
attributes.description: The 12-digit UPC barcode assigned to the target variant item. Used for point-of-sale scanning and inventory tracking. Each variant SKU typically has its own unique UPC.

products.name: image
products.description: Manages digital image assets associated with each SKU including primary product images, alternate angles, lifestyle images, and swatch images. Captures image URL, image type (hero, alternate, swatch, lifestyle, packaging), resolution, file format, locale, channel applicability (web, mobile, print, in-store), CDN asset reference, and approval status. Sourced from Salesforce Commerce Cloud and PIM digital asset management. Supports e-commerce product display and planogram design.

attributes.name: image_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product image asset record.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: product_image.sku (STRING) should be normalized to a proper FK. Images are assets associated with specific SKUs. This is a standard 1:N relationship (one SKU has many images).

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor. Business justification: Retail product images are frequently vendor-supplied assets. Digital asset management and vendor compliance workflows require tracking which vendor provided each image. vendor_image_code is a denormal

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The current approval state of the image asset in the content workflow: draft (initial upload), pending_review (awaiting approval), approved (ready for publication), rejected (failed quality check), archived (no longer active).

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the merchandising or marketing user who approved this image for publication.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this image was approved for publication.

attributes.name: aspect_ratio
attributes.description: The proportional relationship between width and height (e.g., 1:1, 4:3, 16:9). Used for responsive design and layout planning.

attributes.name: background_color
attributes.description: The hexadecimal color code of the image background (e.g., #FFFFFF for white). Used for consistent product presentation and dynamic background replacement.

attributes.name: caption
attributes.description: Optional marketing or descriptive caption displayed alongside the image in certain contexts (e.g., lifestyle images with usage tips).

attributes.name: cdn_asset_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier or key used by the Content Delivery Network to cache and serve this image asset globally.

attributes.name: channel_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of channels where this image is approved for use (web, mobile, print, in-store, social, marketplace). Supports omnichannel merchandising.

attributes.name: color_profile
attributes.description: The color space or profile used in the image (sRGB, Adobe RGB, ProPhoto RGB, CMYK). Critical for color accuracy across web, print, and in-store displays.

attributes.name: copyright_holder
attributes.description: The legal entity or individual who holds the copyright to this image asset. Critical for rights management and legal compliance.
attributes.references: Copyright Law and Intellectual Property Standards

attributes.name: dpi
attributes.description: The resolution of the image in dots per inch. Typically 72 DPI for web and 300 DPI for print. Used to determine print quality suitability.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when the license to use this image expires. Null for perpetual licenses. Used to manage rights and prevent unauthorized use.

attributes.name: file_format
attributes.description: The digital file format of the image asset (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WEBP, SVG, TIFF).

attributes.name: file_size_kb
attributes.description: The file size of the image asset in kilobytes. Used for performance optimization and bandwidth management.

attributes.name: has_transparency
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the image contains transparent pixels (alpha channel). Relevant for PNG and GIF formats used in layered designs.

attributes.name: image_type
attributes.description: Classification of the image purpose: hero (primary product shot), alternate (additional angles), swatch (color/material sample), lifestyle (in-use context), packaging (box/container), detail (close-up feature).

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this image is currently active and available for display. Inactive images are retained for historical reference but not shown to customers.

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the primary/hero image for the SKU. Only one image per SKU should be marked as primary.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this image record or the image file itself was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: license_type
attributes.description: The licensing model under which the retailer has rights to use this image: owned (created in-house), licensed (paid third-party), royalty_free (unlimited use), creative_commons (open license), vendor_supplied (provided by supplier).

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: The language and region code (e.g., en_US, fr_FR, es_MX) indicating which market or locale this image is intended for. Supports localized product imagery.

attributes.name: mobile_optimized
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this image has been optimized for mobile device display (compressed, resized, or formatted for mobile bandwidth and screen size).

attributes.name: photographer_credit
attributes.description: Attribution to the photographer or content creator who produced the image. Used for rights management and licensing compliance.

attributes.name: planogram_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this image is suitable for use in planogram design and shelf layout planning. Typically requires consistent background and perspective.

attributes.name: print_ready
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this image meets the resolution and color profile requirements for print media (catalogs, circulars, in-store signage).

attributes.name: quality_score
attributes.description: A computed or manually assigned quality score (0.00 to 5.00) representing the technical and aesthetic quality of the image. Used for quality control and merchandising decisions.

attributes.name: resolution_height
attributes.description: The height of the image in pixels. Used to determine image quality and suitability for different channels (web, mobile, print).

attributes.name: resolution_width
attributes.description: The width of the image in pixels. Used to determine image quality and suitability for different channels (web, mobile, print).

attributes.name: seo_keywords
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of keywords associated with this image for search engine optimization and internal search relevance.

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: The display order of this image within the product's image gallery. Lower numbers appear first in the carousel or gallery view.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The originating system or platform from which this image was sourced (e.g., Salesforce Commerce Cloud, PIM, vendor portal, photography studio).

attributes.name: upload_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this image was first uploaded to the digital asset management system.

attributes.name: url
attributes.description: The full URL path to the digital image asset, typically hosted on a Content Delivery Network (CDN) or digital asset management system.

attributes.name: usage_rights_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any special terms, restrictions, or notes regarding the usage rights of this image (e.g., geographic restrictions, channel limitations, attribution requirements).

attributes.name: view_angle
attributes.description: The perspective or angle from which the product is photographed (front, back, left, right, top, bottom, angle). Helps customers understand product dimensions and features. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: front|back|left|right|top|bottom|angle — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: zoom_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this image supports zoom functionality on the e-commerce platform. High-resolution images typically enable zoom for detailed product inspection.

products.name: compliance
products.description: Tracks regulatory and safety compliance attributes for each SKU including FDA food labeling compliance, CPSC safety certifications, FTC advertising standards, hazardous material classification, age restriction requirements, country-specific import compliance, and recall status. Captures compliance type, certifying body, certification number, effective date, expiry date, compliance status, and last audit date. Supports regulatory reporting and product recall management.

attributes.name: compliance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product compliance record. Primary key.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.location. Business justification: Jurisdiction-specific compliance (Prop 65, age-restriction laws, state alcohol regulations) requires tying compliance records to specific store locations. Retailers must demonstrate per-location regul

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product (SKU) that this compliance record applies to.

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor_contract. Business justification: Compliance audits in retail reference the vendor contract that mandates certification requirements (hazmat, prop65, organic). Compliance officers need to link a SKU's compliance record to the governin

attributes.name: age_restriction_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product requires age verification at point of sale due to regulatory restrictions (e.g., alcohol, tobacco, certain chemicals).
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: allergen_declaration_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product labeling complies with allergen disclosure requirements (e.g., contains milk, eggs, peanuts, tree nuts, fish, shellfish, soy, wheat).
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA)

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: Unique certification or approval number issued by the certifying body for this compliance record.

attributes.name: certifying_body
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority or third-party organization that issued the compliance certification (e.g., FDA, CPSC, UL, NSF, USDA).
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC), Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC), Food and Drug Administration (FDA)

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of the product for this regulatory requirement.

attributes.name: compliance_type
attributes.description: Category of regulatory compliance requirement (e.g., food safety, product safety, hazardous material classification, age restriction, import/export, labeling, environmental). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: food_safety|product_safety|hazmat|age_restriction|import_export|labeling|environmental — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA), CPSC Safety Standards, FTC Advertising Standards

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating the jurisdiction or market where this compliance requirement applies (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: country_of_origin_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product labeling meets country-of-origin marking requirements for customs and consumer disclosure.
attributes.references: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Country of Origin Marking Requirements, FTC Made in USA Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the compliance record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the compliance certification becomes effective and the product is authorized for sale or distribution.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the compliance certification expires and requires renewal or re-certification. Null if certification does not expire.

attributes.name: fda_food_facility_registration
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Food Facility Registration
attributes.description: FDA registration number for the manufacturing facility where food products are produced. Required for food safety compliance. Null for non-food items.

attributes.name: hazmat_classification
attributes.description: Classification code for hazardous materials according to transportation and storage regulations (e.g., UN number, DOT hazard class). Null if product is not hazardous.
attributes.references: Department of Transportation (DOT) Hazardous Materials Regulations, UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: import_license_number
attributes.description: Government-issued import license or permit number required for cross-border trade of regulated products. Null if not applicable.
attributes.references: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), International Trade Administration (ITA)

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance audit or inspection conducted by the certifying body or internal quality assurance team.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the compliance record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: minimum_age_years
attributes.description: Minimum age in years required to purchase this product. Null if no age restriction applies.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified the compliance record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance audit or inspection. Used for proactive compliance management.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional compliance information, special handling instructions, or notes from compliance audits.

attributes.name: nutrition_labeling_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product meets FDA nutrition labeling requirements (Nutrition Facts panel). Applicable to food and beverage products.
attributes.references: FDA Nutrition Labeling and Education Act (NLEA)

attributes.name: organic_certification
attributes.description: Organic certification number or designation (e.g., USDA Organic, EU Organic). Null if product is not certified organic.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP), EU Organic Regulation

attributes.name: prop_65_chemical_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of Prop 65 chemicals present in the product that trigger warning requirements. Null if no Prop 65 warning required.
attributes.references: California Safe Drinking Water and Toxic Enforcement Act (Proposition 65)

attributes.name: prop_65_warning_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product requires a California Prop 65 warning label due to presence of chemicals known to cause cancer, birth defects, or reproductive harm.
attributes.references: California Safe Drinking Water and Toxic Enforcement Act (Proposition 65)

attributes.name: recall_date
attributes.description: Date when the product recall was initiated. Null if no recall has been issued.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) Recall Standards

attributes.name: recall_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the reason for the product recall (e.g., contamination, safety hazard, labeling error). Null if no recall.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) Recall Standards, FDA Recall Guidelines

attributes.name: recall_severity_level
attributes.description: FDA classification of recall severity: Class 1 (serious health hazard or death), Class 2 (temporary health problem), Class 3 (unlikely to cause adverse health effects). Null if no recall.

attributes.name: recall_status
attributes.description: Current recall status of the product indicating whether it is subject to a safety or quality recall.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) Recall Standards, FDA Recall Guidelines

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Sub-national region or state code where specific compliance requirements apply (e.g., CA for California Prop 65, NY for New York regulations).

attributes.name: responsible_party_contact
attributes.description: Contact information (phone or email) for the responsible party. Used for regulatory inquiries and recall coordination.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) Responsible Party Requirements

attributes.name: sustainability_certification
attributes.description: Sustainability or environmental certification (e.g., Fair Trade, Rainforest Alliance, Marine Stewardship Council, Forest Stewardship Council). Null if not certified.
attributes.references: Fair Trade International, Rainforest Alliance, Marine Stewardship Council (MSC), Forest Stewardship Council (FSC)

attributes.name: tariff_classification_code
attributes.description: Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) code used for customs classification and duty calculation for imported products.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System, U.S. International Trade Commission (USITC)

attributes.name: test_report_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the compliance test report issued by the testing laboratory. Null if no test report available.

attributes.name: testing_laboratory
attributes.description: Name of the accredited third-party laboratory that conducted compliance testing (e.g., UL, Intertek, SGS, Bureau Veritas). Null if no third-party testing performed.

products.name: item_bundle
products.description: Defines product bundle and kit configurations where multiple component SKUs are sold together as a single sellable unit. Captures bundle SKU reference (the parent sellable unit), component SKU references, component quantity, component sequence, bundle type (fixed bundle, mix-and-match, gift set, kit, variety pack, multi-pack), pricing method (bundle price, component sum, discount percentage), component substitution allowed flag, and effective dates. Supports promotional bundling, gift set creation, variety packs, multi-pack configurations, and meal deal combos across all channels. Critical for POS scanning (bundle has its own GTIN), inventory component deduction, and promotional planning.

attributes.name: item_bundle_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the item bundle configuration. Primary key.

attributes.name: bundle_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: item_bundle.bundle_sku (STRING) should be normalized to a proper FK. The bundle itself is a SKU in the catalog. This links the bundle definition to its SKU master record. bundle_gtin can be retrieved

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Bundle revenue recognition (ASC 606/IFRS 15) requires mapping bundles to a specific GL account for deferred/recognized revenue posting. Retail finance teams assign distinct GL accounts to bundle types

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_location. Business justification: Promotional bundles are often authorized only for specific stores or store clusters (e.g., seasonal bundles in tourist locations, regional promotions). Bundle authorization by store is required for pr

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: In retail, bundles are sold under a specific price list (promotional, bundle, or clearance price list) that governs their pricing framework. Linking item_bundle to price_list enables bundle pricing ma

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.loyalty_program. Business justification: Retail bundle promotions are explicitly enrolled in specific loyalty programs (e.g., 'Buy bundle X, earn 3x points in Program Y'). This FK enables bundle loyalty configuration reports, POS loyalty cal

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_offer. Business justification: Bundles are frequently created as part of promotional offers (e.g., 'Buy bundle X at promotional price'). item_bundle has a promotion_eligible flag but no FK to the specific promo_offer driving the bu

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.storefront. Business justification: Bundle channel availability management requires knowing which ecommerce storefront a bundle is offered on. Retail operations configure bundles per channel/storefront for pricing, promotion eligibility

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary vendor or supplier responsible for providing the bundle or its components. Used for vendor managed inventory and procurement.

attributes.name: assortment_category
attributes.description: The merchandising category or department this bundle belongs to for assortment planning and category management (e.g., Grocery, Apparel, Electronics).

attributes.name: bundle_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the bundle contents and value proposition for merchandising and marketing purposes.

attributes.name: bundle_name
attributes.description: The customer-facing name of the bundle (e.g., 'Summer BBQ Pack', 'Family Meal Deal', 'Holiday Gift Set').

attributes.name: bundle_price_amount
attributes.description: The selling price of the bundle when pricing_method is bundle_price. Represents the total customer-facing price.

attributes.name: bundle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the bundle: active (available for sale), inactive (temporarily unavailable), pending (awaiting approval), discontinued (permanently removed), seasonal (available during specific periods).

attributes.name: bundle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bundle configuration: fixed_bundle (pre-defined components), mix_and_match (customer selects from options), gift_set (curated gift collection), kit (assembly required), variety_pack (multiple flavors/variants), multi_pack (quantity of same item).

attributes.name: channel_availability
attributes.description: Defines which sales channels can sell this bundle: all_channels, store_only, online_only, bopis_eligible (Buy Online Pick Up In Store), ship_from_store (fulfillment from store inventory).

attributes.name: component_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the component SKU included in one unit of the bundle. Supports fractional quantities for weight-based items.

attributes.name: component_sequence
attributes.description: The display order or assembly sequence of this component within the bundle. Used for kit assembly instructions and merchandising display.

attributes.name: component_sku
attributes.description: The SKU of an individual component item included in this bundle. References the product master catalog.

attributes.name: component_substitution_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component can be substituted with an equivalent item during fulfillment (e.g., out-of-stock scenarios, mix-and-match bundles).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this bundle configuration record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for bundle pricing (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The fixed dollar discount applied to the component sum when pricing_method is discount_amount.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage discount applied to the component sum when pricing_method is discount_percentage (e.g., 15.00 for 15% off).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this bundle configuration expires or is discontinued. Null indicates no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this bundle configuration becomes active and available for sale across all channels.

attributes.name: inventory_deduction_method
attributes.description: Defines how inventory is tracked and decremented: component_level (deduct each component SKU), bundle_level (track bundle as single inventory unit), hybrid (track both bundle and components).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this bundle configuration record was last updated.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers can earn loyalty program points on bundle purchases.

attributes.name: maximum_purchase_quantity
attributes.description: The maximum number of bundle units a customer can purchase in a single transaction. Used to prevent stockouts and ensure fair distribution of limited-time offers.

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum number of bundle units a customer must purchase in a single transaction. Typically 1, but may be higher for wholesale or bulk bundles.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or username of the person who last modified this bundle configuration. Used for audit trail and change management.

attributes.name: pricing_method
attributes.description: Defines how the bundle price is calculated: bundle_price (fixed price for entire bundle), component_sum (sum of individual component prices), discount_percentage (percentage off component sum), discount_amount (fixed dollar discount off component sum).

attributes.name: promotion_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bundle can be included in additional promotional offers or discounts beyond its configured bundle pricing.

attributes.name: return_policy_code
attributes.description: Reference code to the specific return policy applicable to this bundle (e.g., standard 30-day, final sale, exchange only).

attributes.name: returnable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bundle can be returned. Some bundles (e.g., opened gift sets, perishable meal kits) may not be returnable.

products.name: gtin_registry
products.description: Authoritative registry of all Global Trade Item Numbers (GTINs) including UPC-A, UPC-E, EAN-13, EAN-8, and ITF-14 barcodes associated with each SKU. Captures GTIN value, GTIN type (UPC, EAN, GTIN-14), SKU reference, issuing GS1 company prefix, barcode image reference, packaging level (unit, inner pack, case, pallet), parent GTIN reference (self-referencing for packaging hierarchy — e.g., case GTIN contains N unit GTINs), child GTIN count per parent, and registration status. Models the full GS1 packaging hierarchy enabling warehouse receiving at case level to resolve to constituent unit GTINs. Aligned with GS1 global standards. Supports EDI transactions (ASN, PO, invoice), warehouse receiving, POS scanning, and GDSN data synchronization.

attributes.name: gtin_registry_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) Registry ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the GTIN registry record. Primary key for the GTIN registry product.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: gtin_registry.sku_code (STRING) should be normalized to a proper FK. GTINs are registered for specific SKUs - this is the authoritative link between global trade item numbers and internal SKU master.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor. Business justification: GS1 company prefix on a GTIN identifies the brand owner/vendor. GDSN synchronization, recall traceability, and GS1 compliance reporting all require linking GTIN registrations to the responsible vendor

attributes.name: barcode_image_url
attributes.description: URL reference to the digital barcode image asset (PNG, SVG, or EPS format). Used for printing labels, packaging artwork, and digital commerce applications. Points to asset management system or CDN location.

attributes.name: barcode_symbology
attributes.description: The barcode encoding standard used to represent this GTIN. EAN (European Article Number bars), UPC (Universal Product Code bars), ITF-14 (Interleaved 2 of 5 for cases), GS1-128 (application identifier barcodes), QR (2D matrix code). Determines scanner compatibility.

attributes.name: check_digit
attributes.description: The final digit of the GTIN calculated using GS1 check digit algorithm (modulo 10). Used to validate GTIN integrity during scanning and data entry. Automatically calculated but stored for validation purposes.

attributes.name: child_gtin_quantity
attributes.description: Number of child GTINs (next lower packaging level) contained within this GTIN. For example, a case GTIN with child_gtin_quantity=24 contains 24 unit GTINs. Null for unit-level GTINs. Used to calculate inventory at different packaging levels.

attributes.name: country_of_sale
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where this GTIN is authorized for sale. A single SKU may have different GTINs for different countries due to regulatory labeling requirements. For example, USA, CAN, MEX, GBR, DEU, FRA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this GTIN registry record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking. Immutable after initial creation.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when this GTIN is retired and should no longer be used in new transactions. Null for active GTINs. Used for product lifecycle management and to prevent ordering of discontinued items. Historical transactions retain the GTIN for audit purposes.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this GTIN becomes active and can be used in transactions. For new product launches, this is the go-live date. For packaging changes, this is when the new GTIN replaces the old one. Critical for supply chain cutover planning.

attributes.name: gdsn_last_sync_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful synchronization of this GTIN data to the GDSN data pool. Used to track data freshness and identify GTINs requiring re-publication after attribute changes.

attributes.name: gdsn_publication_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Data Synchronization Network (GDSN) Publication Status
attributes.description: Status of this GTIN in the GS1 Global Data Synchronization Network. Published (live in GDSN data pool), unpublished (not yet shared), pending (awaiting data pool validation), synchronized (confirmed by trading partners), rejected (validation errors). Required for supplier collaboration and EDI.

attributes.name: gross_weight_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for gross_weight_value. Typically g (gram), kg (kilogram), oz (ounce), or lb (pound). Must be consistent across supply chain for accurate logistics planning.
attributes.references: GS1 Unit of Measure Code List

attributes.name: gross_weight_value
attributes.description: Total weight of the packaged item including product and packaging materials. Used for shipping calculations, freight costing, and warehouse capacity planning. Measured in gross_weight_unit.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: The actual GTIN barcode value. Can be 8-digit (EAN-8, UPC-E), 12-digit (UPC-A), 13-digit (EAN-13), or 14-digit (GTIN-14/ITF-14) format. This is the scannable barcode number used at POS, warehouse receiving, and throughout the supply chain.

attributes.name: gtin_type
attributes.description: The specific GTIN format type. UPC-A (12-digit North America standard), UPC-E (8-digit compressed UPC), EAN-13 (13-digit international standard), EAN-8 (8-digit short EAN), GTIN-14 (14-digit case/pallet level), ITF-14 (Interleaved 2 of 5 barcode for GTIN-14).

attributes.name: is_base_unit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GTIN is the base unit of measure for inventory tracking. Typically true for the smallest sellable unit (each). All other packaging levels are multiples of the base unit. Used for inventory conversion calculations.

attributes.name: is_consumer_unit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GTIN represents a consumer-facing unit sold at POS. True for retail each units. False for case/pallet GTINs used only in supply chain. Determines whether GTIN should appear in e-commerce catalog and POS systems.

attributes.name: is_orderable_unit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GTIN can be ordered directly via EDI purchase orders. True for case and pallet GTINs typically ordered from suppliers. False for unit GTINs that are only sold at retail. Controls EDI transaction validation.

attributes.name: is_variable_measure
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GTIN represents a variable measure item (e.g., meat, produce, cheese sold by weight). True for items where price varies by weight/quantity. Affects POS scanning behavior and pricing logic.
attributes.references: GS1 General Specifications - Variable Measure Items

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this GTIN registry record. Updated whenever any attribute changes. Used to track data freshness and trigger downstream synchronization processes.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system account that last modified this GTIN registry record. Used for audit trail and accountability. Links to identity management system for user details.

attributes.name: net_content_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for net_content_value. Standard units: g (gram), kg (kilogram), mg (milligram), oz (ounce), lb (pound), mL (milliliter), L (liter), gal (gallon), qt (quart), pt (pint), ea (each), ct (count). Must align with regulatory labeling requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: g|kg|mg|oz|lb|mL|L|gal|qt|pt|ea|ct — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Unit of Measure Code List

attributes.name: net_content_value
attributes.description: The numeric quantity of product contained in this GTIN package. For example, 500 (when unit is mL), 12 (when unit is oz), 1.5 (when unit is kg). Used with net_content_unit to describe package size. Required for GDSN synchronization.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Synchronization Network (GDSN) Standard

attributes.name: package_depth_value
attributes.description: Depth dimension of the package. Used with height and width for cubic volume calculations. Essential for warehouse bin sizing and transportation load planning. Measured in package_dimension_unit.

attributes.name: package_dimension_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for package dimensions (height, width, depth). Standard units: mm (millimeter), cm (centimeter), m (meter), in (inch), ft (foot). Must be consistent for all three dimensions.
attributes.references: GS1 Unit of Measure Code List

attributes.name: package_height_value
attributes.description: Height dimension of the package. Used with package_width_value and package_depth_value to calculate cubic volume for warehouse slotting, transportation planning, and shelf space allocation. Measured in package_dimension_unit.

attributes.name: package_width_value
attributes.description: Width dimension of the package. Critical for planogram design, shelf allocation, and transportation cube optimization. Measured in package_dimension_unit.

attributes.name: packaging_level
attributes.description: The packaging hierarchy level this GTIN represents. Unit (each/consumer unit), inner pack (multi-pack sold as one), case (shipping carton), pallet (full pallet load), display (retail display shipper). Critical for warehouse receiving and inventory management.

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this GTIN registration. Active (in use), inactive (temporarily disabled), pending (awaiting approval), suspended (compliance issue), retired (permanently discontinued). Controls whether the GTIN can be used in transactions.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GTIN meets all applicable regulatory requirements for its country of sale. Compliant (approved for sale), non_compliant (blocked), pending_review (under evaluation), exempt (not subject to specific regulations). Enforced by quality assurance and legal teams.

attributes.name: replacement_gtin
attributes.description: The new GTIN that supersedes this one when discontinued. Used for packaging changes, reformulations, or product transitions. Enables automatic substitution in ordering systems and maintains continuity in assortment planning.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The system of record that originated or manages this GTIN data. PIM (Product Information Management), MDM (Master Data Management), ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), GDSN (Global Data Synchronization Network), MANUAL (manual data entry). Used for data lineage and conflict resolution.

products.name: uom
products.description: Unit of measure reference master defining all valid units (each, case, pallet, pound, kilogram, liter, ounce) and conversion factors used across ordering, inventory, pricing, and distribution. Captures UOM code, description, UOM class (weight, volume, count, length), base UOM conversion factor, and GS1 standard mapping.

attributes.name: uom_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the unit of measure. Primary key for the UOM reference master.

attributes.name: base_uom_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on uom (base_uom_id)

attributes.name: conversion_factor
attributes.description: Numeric multiplier to convert this unit of measure to the base unit. For example, if 1 case = 12 each, the conversion factor is 12. A value of 1 indicates this is the base unit.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this unit of measure record was first created in the master data system. Part of audit trail for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0-100) representing the completeness, accuracy, and consistency of this unit of measure record based on Master Data Management (MDM) data quality rules and validation checks.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this unit of measure is no longer valid for new transactions. Null indicates no planned end date. Part of temporal validity tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this unit of measure becomes valid and available for use across retail systems. Part of temporal validity tracking.

attributes.name: gs1_uom_code
attributes.description: Standardized GS1 unit of measure code used for Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) and global supply chain interoperability. Maps internal UOM codes to GS1 standards.

attributes.name: inverse_conversion_factor
attributes.description: Reciprocal of the conversion factor, used for reverse conversions from base unit to this unit. Calculated as 1 divided by conversion_factor.

attributes.name: is_base_unit
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the base unit of measure in its class (True) or a derived/alternate unit (False). Base units have a conversion factor of 1.

attributes.name: is_consumer_unit
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this unit of measure represents a consumer-facing selling unit (True for each, single item, False for case, pallet, or bulk units).

attributes.name: is_fractional_allowed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether fractional quantities are permitted for this unit of measure (True for weight/volume units like pounds or liters, False for discrete count units like cases or pallets).

attributes.name: is_inventory_tracked
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether inventory quantities are tracked and managed in this unit of measure (True if used in Warehouse Management System (WMS) and inventory systems, False if conversion-only).

attributes.name: is_orderable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this unit of measure can be used for purchase order creation and supplier ordering (True if valid for procurement, False if display-only or internal-use).

attributes.name: is_variable_measure
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this unit of measure is used for variable-weight or variable-measure items (True for items sold by weight or volume with varying quantities, False for fixed-count items).

attributes.name: iso_uom_code
attributes.description: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) unit code per ISO 80000 and ISO 31 standards, ensuring global consistency in measurement representation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this unit of measure record was most recently updated. Part of audit trail for data governance and change tracking.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the unit of measure: active (in use), inactive (not currently used but retained for historical data), deprecated (being phased out), or pending (awaiting approval for use).

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the data steward or system user who last modified this unit of measure record. Part of audit trail for accountability and data governance.

attributes.name: precision_decimal_places
attributes.description: Number of decimal places to which quantities in this unit of measure should be rounded for display and calculation purposes (e.g., 0 for whole units like cases, 2 for currency-like precision, 3 for weight measurements).

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric value controlling the display sequence of units of measure in user interfaces and reports. Lower values appear first.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name or code of the source system from which this unit of measure record originated (e.g., Informatica MDM, SAP S/4HANA MM, Oracle Retail Merchandising System). Used for data lineage and integration tracking.

attributes.name: superseded_by_uom_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Superseded By Unit of Measure (UOM) Code
attributes.description: Code of the replacement unit of measure that supersedes this one when deprecated. Used to maintain continuity during UOM transitions and system migrations.

attributes.name: symbol
attributes.description: Standard abbreviated symbol for the unit of measure (e.g., kg for kilogram, lb for pound, L for liter, oz for ounce). Used in labels, reports, and user interfaces.

attributes.name: unece_code
attributes.description: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe (UN/ECE) Recommendation 20 unit code, widely used in international trade and customs documentation.

attributes.name: uom_class
attributes.description: Classification of the unit of measure by measurement type: weight (mass), volume (capacity), count (discrete units), length (distance), area (surface), or time (duration).

attributes.name: uom_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the unit of measure (e.g., EA for each, CS for case, LB for pound, KG for kilogram). Used as the business identifier across ordering, inventory, pricing, and distribution systems.

attributes.name: uom_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the unit of measure, including usage context and business rules for application across retail operations.

attributes.name: uom_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the unit of measure (e.g., Each, Case, Pound, Kilogram, Liter, Ounce, Pallet).

attributes.name: uom_type
attributes.description: Functional type indicating the primary business context where this UOM is used: base (fundamental unit), alternate (conversion unit), display (customer-facing), ordering (procurement), inventory (stock tracking), pricing (selling unit), or shipping (logistics). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: base|alternate|display|ordering|inventory|pricing|shipping — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: usage_context
attributes.description: Textual description of the business contexts and operational scenarios where this unit of measure is typically applied (e.g., used for bulk ordering of dry goods, used for pricing fresh produce, used for shipping pallet quantities).

products.name: assortment
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment of SKUs to fulfillment nodes in the retail network. It captures which products are authorized to be stocked at which locations, along with node-specific inventory policies, allocation rules, and stocking parameters. Each record links one SKU to one fulfillment node with attributes that govern how that SKU is managed at that specific location. This is the authoritative source for product assortment decisions and location-specific inventory control parameters.. Existence Justification: In retail omnichannel operations, a single SKU is stocked across multiple fulfillment nodes (distribution centers, stores acting as ship-from-store locations, micro-fulfillment centers, dark stores), and each node carries thousands of different SKUs. The business actively manages these SKU-to-node assignments through assortment planning processes, setting node-specific inventory policies, allocation priorities, and stocking parameters for each SKU at each location. This is a core operational relationship managed by merchandising and supply chain teams.

attributes.name: assortment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this SKU-to-node assortment assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_budget. Business justification: Retail assortment planning is governed by Open-to-Buy (OTB) budgets stored in finance_budget. Buyers must validate assortment additions against approved OTB amounts. This link enables the merchandise

attributes.name: format_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.format. Business justification: Format-level assortment planning is a core retail process — hypermarket vs. convenience formats carry distinct SKU sets. Linking assortment records to store format enables format-level range reviews,

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the fulfillment node master record. Identifies which location is authorized to stock this SKU.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the SKU master record. Identifies which product is assigned to this fulfillment node.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.storefront. Business justification: Online assortment planning requires assigning SKUs to specific storefronts. Retail domain experts expect assortment records to identify the ecommerce storefront they apply to, enabling storefront-leve

attributes.name: allocation_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking for inventory allocation when supply is constrained. Lower numbers indicate higher priority (1 = highest priority). Used by allocation engines to determine which nodes receive inventory first during shortages. Typically based on sales velocity, strategic importance, or customer service level agreements.

attributes.name: assignment_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this SKU was first authorized to be stocked at this node. Marks the beginning of the assortment assignment. Used for assortment history tracking and performance analysis.

attributes.name: assignment_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this SKU was removed from the authorized assortment at this node. Null for currently active assignments. Used for assortment history and discontinued product tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this assortment assignment record was created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this assortment assignment record was last updated. Tracks changes to stocking status, min/max quantities, or other assignment parameters.

attributes.name: last_received_date
attributes.description: Date when this SKU was last received into inventory at this node. Used to identify slow-moving or stale inventory, support FIFO/FEFO rotation, and flag potential obsolescence. Updated by warehouse management system upon receipt confirmation.

attributes.name: max_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum inventory quantity that should be stocked at this node for this SKU. Prevents overstocking and ensures efficient use of storage capacity. Set based on storage constraints, demand forecasts, and inventory turn targets. Node-specific based on storage capacity and sales velocity.

attributes.name: min_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum inventory quantity that should be maintained at this node for this SKU. Triggers replenishment when on-hand inventory falls below this threshold. Set based on lead time demand, safety stock calculations, and service level targets. Node-specific based on local demand patterns.

attributes.name: replenishment_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days required to replenish this SKU at this specific node from the time a replenishment order is placed. Includes order processing, picking, packing, transit, and receiving time. Node-specific based on distance from supply source, transportation mode, and receiving capacity.

attributes.name: stocking_status
attributes.description: Current stocking status of this SKU at this specific node. ACTIVE (currently stocked and replenished), DISCONTINUED (no longer carried at this location), SEASONAL (stocked only during specific seasons), CLEARANCE (final inventory selldown), PENDING_SETUP (authorized but not yet received), TEMPORARY_OUT (temporarily not stocked). This is node-specific and can differ from the SKU's global lifecycle_status.

domains.name: order
domains.description: Manages omnichannel order lifecycle from cart creation through fulfillment including online orders, in-store POS transactions, BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store), ROPIS, ship-from-store (SFS), and drop-ship orders. Tracks order headers, line items, payment methods, fulfillment status, delivery tracking, and RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization). Integrates with OMS for end-to-end order orchestration.

products.name: header
products.description: Core master record for every omnichannel order. Captures order number, channel origin (web, app, call center, marketplace), order date/time, customer reference, fulfillment node reference (FK to store/distribution domain), order status, currency, locale, totals (subtotal, tax, discount, shipping, grand total), OMS reference ID, source system, and audit timestamps. SSOT for order identity and lifecycle. Carrier and fulfillment node masters are owned by peer domains and referenced via cross-domain FK.
products.reference: OMS Order Header / SAP SD Sales Order Header

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the order header record. Primary key for the order header entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: B2B and account-based retail operations require tracking orders against customer accounts for credit limit enforcement, account statement generation, billing cycle management, and corporate purchasing

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Retail orders require cost center allocation for internal accounting, departmental P&L tracking, B2B order costing, and management reporting. Standard practice in multi-department retail operations fo

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store, distribution center, or warehouse responsible for fulfilling this order. Cross-domain reference to inventory or store domain.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.location. Business justification: Omnichannel order attribution: retail orders (BOPIS, in-store pickup, ship-from-store) must be attributed to the originating or fulfilling store location for store-level P&L reporting, sales comp repo

attributes.name: loyalty_membership_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.membership. Business justification: Online and phone orders must link to loyalty membership for points accrual, tier-based pricing, personalized promotions, and member purchase history tracking—core retail loyalty operations.

attributes.name: outbound_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.outbound_shipment. Business justification: Retail order-to-shipment traceability: the outbound_shipment from the DC is the physical execution of the customer order. Customer service, carrier billing reconciliation, and on-time delivery reporti

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: Order-level pricing audit and customer segment revenue reporting require knowing which price list (VIP, wholesale, regional) governed the entire order. Retail pricing analysts and finance teams reconc

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who placed the order. Links to customer master data.

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.season. Business justification: Retail operations tag customer orders with selling season for seasonal performance analysis, trend reporting, merchandising plan effectiveness measurement, and comparing actual sales against seasonal

attributes.name: sla_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.sla. Business justification: Each order header is governed by a fulfillment SLA based on channel, geography, and customer tier. This FK enables promised_delivery_date validation at order creation, SLA breach reporting, customer c

attributes.name: source_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.purchase_order. Business justification: Retail drop-ship orders where vendor ships directly to customer require tracking the source supplier PO for cost reconciliation, vendor chargeback processing, and fulfillment exception handling. Essen

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.storefront. Business justification: Storefront-level sales reporting and revenue attribution require linking each online order header to its originating storefront. Retail omnichannel analytics and P&L reporting by digital channel depen

attributes.name: subscription_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.subscription. Business justification: A subscription generates recurring order headers (one subscription produces many headers over its lifecycle). Without this FK, subscription-generated orders cannot be traced back to their originating

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: Actual date the order was delivered to the customer. Null until delivery is confirmed.

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the billing address associated with the payment method.

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the billing address for apartment, suite, or unit number.

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City or municipality for the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region for the billing address.

attributes.name: carrier_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the shipping carrier or third-party logistics (3PL) provider handling delivery (e.g., UPS, FedEx, USPS).

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Sales channel through which the order was originated. Distinguishes omnichannel order sources for analytics and fulfillment routing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this order header record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this order (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: customer_email
attributes.description: Email address provided by the customer for order confirmation and communication.

attributes.name: customer_phone
attributes.description: Contact phone number for delivery coordination and customer service.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to the order including promotional discounts, coupons, loyalty rewards, and markdowns.

attributes.name: grand_total_amount
attributes.description: Final order total including subtotal, tax, shipping, minus discounts. Amount charged to customer payment method.

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: Language and regional locale for the order (e.g., en_US, fr_CA). Used for localized content and formatting.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes, ISO 3166-1 Country Codes

attributes.name: oms_reference_code
attributes.description: External reference identifier from the Order Management System for end-to-end order orchestration and tracking.

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the order was placed by the customer. Principal business event timestamp for the transaction.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the order. Used for customer communication, tracking, and cross-system reference.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the order in the fulfillment workflow. Tracks progression from creation through final disposition. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|confirmed|processing|picking|packing|shipped|delivered|completed|cancelled|returned — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of order fulfillment method. BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store), ROPIS (Reserve Online Pick Up In Store), SFS (Ship From Store), or standard home delivery. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|bopis|ropis|ship_from_store|drop_ship|exchange|replacement — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Primary payment instrument used for the order. Identifies the payment type without exposing sensitive card details. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|paypal|apple_pay|google_pay|gift_card|store_credit|cash|check|bank_transfer — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: PCI DSS Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current status of payment processing for the order. Tracks authorization, capture, and settlement lifecycle. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|authorized|captured|paid|failed|refunded|partially_refunded — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: PCI DSS Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: promised_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date committed to the customer for order delivery. Used for SLA compliance measurement.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Customer-requested target delivery date. Used for scheduling and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: shipping_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the shipping address including street number and name. Primary delivery location identifier.

attributes.name: shipping_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the shipping address for apartment, suite, or unit number. Optional address detail.

attributes.name: shipping_amount
attributes.description: Shipping and handling charges for order delivery. Zero for in-store pickup orders.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Pricing Transparency Standards

attributes.name: shipping_city
attributes.description: City or municipality for the shipping address.

attributes.name: shipping_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the shipping address (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR).

attributes.name: shipping_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the shipping address. Critical for carrier routing and delivery zone determination.

attributes.name: shipping_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region for the shipping address. Used for tax jurisdiction and carrier routing.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the originating system that created this order record (e.g., Salesforce Commerce Cloud, SAP S/4HANA, Store POS).

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Customer-provided delivery instructions or notes (e.g., gate code, leave at door, signature required).

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all line item amounts before taxes, discounts, and shipping charges. Base merchandise value.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax applied to the order based on jurisdiction and product taxability rules.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Pricing Transparency Standards

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-provided tracking number for shipment visibility and customer self-service tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this order header record was last modified. Audit trail for record changes.

products.name: order_line
products.description: Individual line-item detail within an order header. Captures SKU/UPC/GTIN, product description snapshot, ordered quantity, unit retail price (AUR), extended price, discount amount, tax amount, line status, fulfillment method per line (ship, BOPIS, ROPIS, SFS, drop-ship), substitution flag, gift flag, personalization notes, and line-level cancellation reason. Supports split-fulfillment where different lines ship from different nodes.
products.reference: OMS Order Line / SAP SD Sales Order Item

attributes.name: order_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the order line item. Primary key for the order line product.

attributes.name: accrual_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.accrual_rule. Business justification: Each order line earns points under a specific accrual rule (product category multiplier, promo bonus). Recording the applied rule per line enables points audit trails, member dispute resolution, and l

attributes.name: assortment_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.assortment_item. Business justification: Assortment sell-through reporting — a core merchandising KPI — requires linking actual sales (order lines) to the assortment item plan. Retail merchandisers track planned vs. actual units sold per ass

attributes.name: buying_order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.buying_order_line. Business justification: Sell-through and vendor performance reporting requires tracing customer order lines back to the buying order line that sourced the inventory. Retail merchandisers use this link to measure actual vs. p

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Line-level cost center assignment enables accurate departmental P&L in mixed-cart orders, supports product category profitability analysis, and is required for internal management accounting and segme

attributes.name: cost_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.cost_price. Business justification: COGS audit and gross margin reporting require the exact cost record (landed cost, duty, freight) used at order line fulfillment time. order_line.cost_of_goods_sold is a scalar snapshot; the FK enables

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.department. Business justification: Department-level sales reporting: order lines must be attributed to a store department for department P&L, gross margin targets, and shrinkage rate analysis. Retail domain experts expect order lines t

attributes.name: digital_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.digital_catalog. Business justification: Catalog-to-conversion reporting — identifying which digital product listing drove each sale — is a core e-commerce analytics requirement. Merchandising and content teams use this for A/B test attribut

attributes.name: fulfilling_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.location. Business justification: Ship-from-store and BOPIS fulfillment: individual order lines can be fulfilled from different store locations. Store-level fulfillment attribution per line drives store inventory depletion, store P&L

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center, store, or warehouse assigned to fulfill this line. Supports split-fulfillment where different lines ship from different nodes.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent order header. Links this line item to its containing order transaction.

attributes.name: item_bundle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.item_bundle. Business justification: When a customer orders a product bundle, the order line must reference the bundle definition to enforce bundle pricing rules, validate component quantities, apply bundle discounts, and drive component

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.lot. Business justification: Lot traceability is mandatory for recalls, quality issues, and regulatory compliance in retail (especially food, pharma, cosmetics). Fulfillment systems must record which specific lot/batch was picked

attributes.name: markdown_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.markdown_event. Business justification: Omnichannel markdown impact reporting requires linking online/digital order lines sold at markdown prices to the authorizing markdown_event. Merchandising teams measure actual revenue and margin impac

attributes.name: markdown_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.markdown. Business justification: Markdown sell-through reporting — a core retail buying KPI — requires linking order lines to the markdown event that authorized the reduced price. Buyers track units sold and revenue per markdown even

attributes.name: member_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.member_offer. Business justification: Each online/omnichannel order line may be fulfilled under a specific personalized member offer. Needed for offer attribution reporting, loyalty personalization ROI analysis, and member offer redemptio

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.po_line. Business justification: Drop-ship retail operations require line-level PO-to-order-line reconciliation: which specific PO line is fulfilling which customer order line. Retail buyers and operations teams use this for fill-rat

attributes.name: price_change_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_change. Business justification: Retail margin analysis requires linking each order line to the price change event (promotional, competitive, cost-driven) that set the unit retail price. Pricing analysts measure price change effectiv

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profit center allocation at line level is essential for channel profitability analysis, store/DC performance measurement, segment reporting, and financial consolidation. Retail standard for tracking m

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the promotion applied to this line item. Links to the promotion master for discount calculation and campaign tracking.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.purchase_order. Business justification: Drop-ship and special-order retail: each order line references the specific PO created to source that item. Retail operations teams use this for line-level PO-to-customer-order traceability, vendor ac

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Order lines must reference the product SKU being ordered. The product_description column becomes redundant as it can be joined from product.sku. This is a fundamental cross-domain relationship between

attributes.name: sku_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.sku_price. Business justification: Order lines capture actual transaction prices. Linking to sku_price enables margin variance analysis, promotional effectiveness measurement, price compliance auditing, and reconciliation between plann

attributes.name: uom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.uom. Business justification: Order line fulfillment requires UOM conversion factor lookups for inventory deduction accuracy, carrier weight calculations, and cross-channel unit reconciliation. Current unit_of_measure string preve

attributes.name: vendor_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor_item. Business justification: Order line costing, margin reporting, and vendor compliance tracking require resolving which vendor_item record governs unit cost and pack configuration for the SKU-vendor combination. Retail OMS and

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: Actual date when this line item was shipped from the fulfillment node. Used for SLA performance measurement and delivery estimation.

attributes.name: backorder_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is on backorder due to insufficient inventory at order time. True if the item will be shipped when inventory becomes available.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why this line was cancelled. Populated only when line_status is CANCELLED. Enables root cause analysis of order cancellations.

attributes.name: cancelled_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity cancelled and not fulfilled. Tracks partial cancellations where only a portion of the ordered quantity is cancelled.

attributes.name: carrier_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the shipping carrier assigned to deliver this line item. Supports multi-carrier fulfillment strategies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FEDEX|UPS|USPS|DHL|ONTRAC|LASERSHIP|LOCAL_COURIER — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cost_of_goods_sold
