attributes.description: Unit cost of the product at the time of order fulfillment. Used for margin analysis and profitability reporting. Business-confidential financial data.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this order line record was first created in the system. Represents the moment the line item was added to the order.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this line. Supports multi-currency transactions in global retail operations.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to this line item. Includes promotional discounts, markdowns, coupons, and loyalty rewards applied at the line level.

attributes.name: expected_ship_date
attributes.description: Planned date when this line item is expected to ship from the fulfillment node. Used for customer communication and Service Level Agreement (SLA) tracking.

attributes.name: extended_price
attributes.description: Total price for this line item before discounts and taxes. Calculated as ordered_quantity multiplied by unit_retail_price.

attributes.name: fulfillment_method
attributes.description: Method by which this line will be fulfilled. Supports omnichannel fulfillment including ship-to-home, Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS), Reserve Online Pick Up In Store (ROPIS), Ship-from-Store (SFS), and drop-ship.

attributes.name: gift_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is marked as a gift. True if the customer designated this item for gift wrapping, gift messaging, or special handling.

attributes.name: gift_message
attributes.description: Customer-provided gift message to be included with this line item. Populated only when gift_flag is true.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: 14-digit Global Trade Item Number. International standard for product identification across the supply chain.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the order. Determines the display and processing order of line items within a single order header.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment status of this order line. Tracks the line through the fulfillment lifecycle from order confirmation to final delivery or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PENDING|CONFIRMED|ALLOCATED|PICKED|PACKED|SHIPPED|DELIVERED|CANCELLED|RETURNED — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: margin_amount
attributes.description: Gross margin for this line item calculated as line_total minus cost_of_goods_sold. Key metric for profitability analysis and Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) calculations.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this order line record was last modified. Tracks any updates to quantity, status, pricing, or fulfillment details.

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the product ordered by the customer. Supports fractional quantities for weight-based or volume-based items.

attributes.name: original_sku
attributes.description: Original SKU that was ordered by the customer, populated only when substitution_flag is true. Enables tracking of substitution patterns and customer acceptance rates.

attributes.name: personalization_notes
attributes.description: Special instructions for product personalization such as monogramming, engraving, or custom text. Captured at order time and passed to fulfillment operations.

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why this line was returned by the customer. Populated when returned_quantity is greater than zero. Supports Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) processing.

attributes.name: returned_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity returned by the customer after delivery. Supports partial returns and links to Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) processing.

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity shipped to the customer. May differ from ordered_quantity due to partial fulfillment, substitutions, or inventory constraints.

attributes.name: substitution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is a substitution for an out-of-stock product. True if a substitute product was provided instead of the originally ordered item.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax charged on this line item. Includes sales tax, VAT, GST, or other applicable taxes based on jurisdiction and product category.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the tax jurisdiction for this line item. Determines applicable tax rates based on ship-to location and product tax category.

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: Effective tax rate applied to this line item expressed as a decimal. For example, 0.0825 represents 8.25 percent sales tax.

attributes.name: total
attributes.description: Final total amount for this line item after discounts and taxes. Calculated as extended_price minus discount_amount plus tax_amount.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier tracking number for this line item shipment. Enables customer self-service tracking and last-mile delivery visibility.

attributes.name: unit_retail_price
attributes.description: Price per unit at the time of order. Represents the Average Unit Retail (AUR) before any line-level discounts or promotions.

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code barcode identifier. Standard North American product identifier used at point of sale.

products.name: status_history
products.description: Immutable audit trail of every status transition for an order header throughout its lifecycle (e.g., CREATED → CONFIRMED → ALLOCATED → PICKED → SHIPPED → DELIVERED → RETURNED). Captures status code, previous status, transition timestamp, triggering system/user, reason code, and node identifier. Enables SLA tracking, exception management, and customer-facing order tracking.

attributes.name: status_history_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each status transition record in the order lifecycle. Primary key for the immutable audit trail.

attributes.name: carrier_service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.carrier_service. Business justification: Order status transitions track service level changes (upgrade to overnight, downgrade due to inventory). Business requires carrier_service_id to analyze SLA breach rates by service tier and generate c

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical or logical node (store, DC, MFC, dark store, vendor) responsible for this stage of fulfillment. Enables location-based performance tracking.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order header that this status transition belongs to. Links this status event to the parent order entity.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.location. Business justification: Store-level SLA and exception reporting: order status events such as 'ready for pickup', 'picked up in store', or 'exception at store' must be attributed to a store location for store-level SLA breach

attributes.name: order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_line. Business justification: Order lines have their own lifecycle status (line_status on order_line) that transitions independently from the header status — e.g., a single line can be backordered, partially shipped, or cancelled

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.shipment. Business justification: Status events like 'shipped', 'out_for_delivery', 'delivered' are directly triggered by shipment records. This FK enables carrier SLA breach analysis and customer notification audit trails. tracking_n

attributes.name: actual_delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the order was successfully delivered to the customer. Populated only for DELIVERED status. Critical for SLA compliance measurement.

attributes.name: assigned_to_team_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the team or department responsible for resolving this exception. Supports workload distribution and capacity planning.

attributes.name: carrier_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the shipping carrier responsible for delivery at this stage. Populated for SHIPPED, IN_TRANSIT, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, and DELIVERED statuses.

attributes.name: created_by_process
attributes.description: Identifier of the ETL job, API call, or data ingestion process that created this record in the lakehouse. Supports data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this status history record was created in the data platform. Distinct from transition_timestamp which represents the business event time.

attributes.name: customer_notification_channel
attributes.description: The communication channel used to notify the customer of this status change. Null if no notification was sent.

attributes.name: customer_notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether a customer notification (email, SMS, push) was sent for this status transition. Supports customer communication audit.

attributes.name: duration_in_previous_status_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Duration in Previous Status in Minutes
attributes.description: The number of minutes the order spent in the previous status before this transition. Enables stage-level performance analysis.

attributes.name: estimated_delivery_date
attributes.description: Projected delivery date communicated to the customer at this status transition. Updated as the order progresses through fulfillment stages.

attributes.name: event_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating the order of status transitions for this order. Enables chronological sorting and gap detection.

attributes.name: exception_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the exception type. Enables exception trend analysis and root cause identification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: INVENTORY|PAYMENT|ADDRESS|CARRIER|FRAUD|QUALITY|SYSTEM|CUSTOMER|NONE — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: exception_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this status transition represents an exception or abnormal condition requiring intervention. True for statuses like FAILED, ON_HOLD, CANCELLED.

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fulfillment node handling this order stage. Supports omnichannel fulfillment strategy analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: STORE|DC|MFC|DARK_STORE|VENDOR|3PL|CROSS_DOCK — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments related to this status transition. Captures operational context not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the order fulfillment model. Denormalized for performance in fulfillment-type-specific analysis. BOPIS = Buy Online Pick Up In Store, ROPIS = Reserve Online Pick Up In Store, SFS = Ship From Store. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: STANDARD|BOPIS|ROPIS|SFS|DROP_SHIP|SUBSCRIPTION|RUSH — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: previous_status_code
attributes.description: The status that the order was in immediately before this transition. Enables tracking of status flow and identifying invalid state transitions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CREATED|CONFIRMED|ALLOCATED|PICKED|PACKED|SHIPPED|IN_TRANSIT|OUT_FOR_DELIVERY|DELIVERED|CANCELLED|RETURNED|REFUNDED|FAILED|ON_HOLD|BACKORDERED — 15 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this status transition or exception. Drives resolution sequencing and resource allocation.

attributes.name: resolution_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this status transition requires manual resolution or intervention. True for exceptions that cannot be auto-resolved.

attributes.name: sla_breach_duration_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: SLA (Service Level Agreement) Breach Duration in Minutes
attributes.description: The number of minutes by which the SLA was breached. Null if no breach occurred. Enables quantitative analysis of service failures.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this status transition violated the defined SLA target. True if transition occurred after the SLA target timestamp.

attributes.name: sla_target_timestamp
attributes.description: The target date and time by which this status transition should have occurred per the service level agreement. Enables SLA breach detection.

attributes.name: source_order_channel
attributes.description: The originating channel through which the order was placed. Denormalized for performance in channel-specific SLA analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WEB|MOBILE_APP|STORE|CALL_CENTER|MARKETPLACE|SOCIAL|KIOSK — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_system_transaction_code
attributes.description: Unique transaction or event identifier from the originating system. Enables end-to-end traceability and reconciliation across systems.

attributes.name: status_code
attributes.description: The new status that the order transitioned to at this point in time. Represents the current state in the order fulfillment lifecycle. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CREATED|CONFIRMED|ALLOCATED|PICKED|PACKED|SHIPPED|IN_TRANSIT|OUT_FOR_DELIVERY|DELIVERED|CANCELLED|RETURNED|REFUNDED|FAILED|ON_HOLD|BACKORDERED — 15 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: transition_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code explaining why the status transition occurred. Enables root cause analysis for exceptions and delays. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CUSTOMER_REQUEST|INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE|PAYMENT_FAILED|ADDRESS_INVALID|CARRIER_DELAY|SYSTEM_ERROR|FRAUD_DETECTED|QUALITY_ISSUE|DAMAGED_IN_TRANSIT|CUSTOMER_REFUSED|BUSINESS_RULE|MANUAL_OVERRIDE|AUTOMATED_PROCESS — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: transition_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text explanation providing additional context for the status transition. Captures details not covered by the standardized reason code.

attributes.name: transition_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the order status changed to the new status. Critical for SLA (Service Level Agreement) tracking and customer-facing order tracking.

attributes.name: triggering_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the system or application that initiated this status transition. Enables system-level performance analysis and troubleshooting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OMS|WMS|TMS|POS|ECOM|CARRIER_API|PAYMENT_GATEWAY|FRAUD_ENGINE|CSR_PORTAL|BATCH_JOB|EDI|MOBILE_APP — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: triggering_user_name
attributes.description: Display name of the user who triggered the status change. Provides human-readable context for manual interventions.

products.name: pos_transaction
products.description: Point-of-Sale transaction record for in-store purchase events at registers. Captures POS terminal ID, register number, cashier/associate ID, store number, transaction date/time, transaction type (sale, return, exchange, void), total tender, tax, discount, loyalty card number, basket metrics (item count, UPT, ATV), and fiscal receipt number. SSOT for brick-and-mortar register transactions. Complements order_header for transactions originating at physical registers rather than digital order flow. Payment tenders linked via the payment product.
products.reference: SAP CAR POS Transaction / NRF ARTS Transaction

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the POS transaction record. Primary key for in-store register transactions.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: POS transactions must be allocated to cost centers for store-level P&L, department performance tracking, and internal management reporting. Required for daily sales accounting, variance analysis, and

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order header for omnichannel transactions such as BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store) pickups or ship-from-store fulfillments that originated as digital orders.

attributes.name: loyalty_membership_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.membership. Business justification: POS transactions require direct membership link for real-time points posting, tier validation, member-only pricing, receipt balance printing, and daily loyalty reconciliation—critical in-store loyalty

attributes.name: original_transaction_pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original POS transaction being returned or exchanged when transaction_type is return or exchange.

attributes.name: payment_method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.payment_method. Business justification: Omnichannel payment method usage reporting and stored-card fraud detection require linking POS transactions to the customer's stored payment method. primary_payment_method is a denormalized text field

attributes.name: pos_terminal_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the POS terminal device used to process the transaction.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_zone. Business justification: Zone-level pricing compliance and revenue analytics require knowing which price zone was active for each POS transaction. Retail pricing teams audit that correct zone prices were charged at each store

attributes.name: primary_pos_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retail store location where the transaction occurred.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer who made the purchase. Populated when loyalty card is scanned or customer account is identified.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Every POS transaction requires profit center assignment for segment reporting, store profitability analysis, financial consolidation, and management reporting. Fundamental requirement for retail finan

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.season. Business justification: POS transactions analyzed by season for in-store seasonal sell-through reporting, validating merchandising plans against actual store performance, seasonal GMROI calculation, and measuring effectivene

attributes.name: business_date
attributes.description: Retail business day to which this transaction is attributed for financial reporting. May differ from transaction timestamp for transactions after store closing but before end-of-day processing.

attributes.name: change_amount
attributes.description: Cash change returned to the customer when tender_amount exceeds total_amount.

attributes.name: coupon_count
attributes.description: Number of coupons redeemed in the transaction including manufacturer coupons and store coupons.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the POS transaction record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction monetary amounts.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied to the transaction including promotional discounts, coupons, markdowns, and employee discounts.

attributes.name: fiscal_receipt_number
attributes.description: Government-mandated fiscal receipt identifier for tax compliance and audit purposes. Required in jurisdictions with fiscal receipt regulations.

attributes.name: fulfillment_type
attributes.description: Fulfillment method for the transaction distinguishing between traditional in-store purchases and omnichannel fulfillment scenarios.

attributes.name: item_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct line items in the transaction basket. Used for basket analysis and UPT (Units Per Transaction) calculation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the POS transaction record was last updated. Used for audit trail and data synchronization.

attributes.name: loyalty_card_number
attributes.description: Loyalty program card number scanned during the transaction for points accrual and customer identification.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points earned by the customer for this transaction based on purchase amount and promotional multipliers.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed by the customer during this transaction for discounts or rewards.

attributes.name: manager_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a manager override was required during the transaction for actions such as large discounts, voids, or policy exceptions.

attributes.name: payment_method_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct payment methods used in the transaction. Supports split-tender analysis.

attributes.name: promotion_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct promotions applied to the transaction. Used for promotional effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: receipt_email
attributes.description: Email address provided by the customer for digital receipt delivery.

attributes.name: receipt_phone
attributes.description: Phone number provided by the customer for SMS receipt delivery or order pickup notifications.

attributes.name: register_number
attributes.description: Physical register or checkout lane number within the store where the transaction was processed.

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for return when transaction_type is return. Used for return analytics and product quality monitoring.

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all line item amounts before taxes, fees, and discounts are applied.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax charged on the transaction based on applicable tax jurisdiction and product tax categories.

attributes.name: tender_amount
attributes.description: Total amount tendered by the customer across all payment methods. May exceed total_amount when cash change is given.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Final total amount tendered by the customer including all items, taxes, fees, and after all discounts. Represents the net transaction value and ATV (Average Transaction Value).

attributes.name: total_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of all items purchased in the transaction, summed across all line items. May differ from item_count when multiple units of the same SKU are purchased.

attributes.name: training_mode_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transaction was processed in training mode for new cashier onboarding. Training transactions are excluded from financial reporting.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-readable transaction number printed on the customer receipt. Externally visible identifier for customer service and returns processing.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the POS transaction indicating whether it was completed, voided, suspended for later completion, or refunded.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transaction was completed at the register. Primary business event timestamp for sales analytics and footfall analysis.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of POS transaction distinguishing between sales, returns, exchanges, voids, and no-sale register opens.

attributes.name: void_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for voiding the transaction when transaction_status is voided. Used for fraud detection and operational quality monitoring.

products.name: pos_transaction_line
products.description: Individual line-item detail within a POS transaction. Captures SKU, UPC, EAN, GTIN, item description, quantity sold, unit retail price, extended price, markdown amount, promotion code applied, tax code, tax amount, return reason (if applicable), serial number (for electronics), and weight (for variable-weight items). Supports basket analysis and sell-through rate calculations.
products.reference: SAP CAR POS Line Item / NRF ARTS LineItem

attributes.name: pos_transaction_line_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Point of Sale (POS) Transaction Line ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the individual line item within a POS transaction. Primary key for the transaction line detail record.

attributes.name: accrual_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.accrual_rule. Business justification: Each POS line item earns points under a specific accrual rule. Needed for store-level loyalty audit, cashier training validation, and points dispute resolution at POS. Retail store operations and loya

attributes.name: assortment_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.assortment_item. Business justification: In-store POS sales must be mapped to assortment items for real-time sell-through tracking against assortment plan targets. Retail merchandisers use daily POS-to-assortment data to make markdown timing

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.category. Business justification: pos_transaction_line carries a denormalized category_code. Replacing with a proper FK to merchandising.category enables category-level sales reporting, margin analysis, and sell-through tracking — sta

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Line-level cost center tracking enables department-specific performance measurement within store transactions, supports mixed-department basket analysis, and provides granular data for departmental P&

attributes.name: cost_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.cost_price. Business justification: In-store gross margin reporting requires the exact cost record per POS transaction line. pos_transaction_line.cost_of_goods_sold is a scalar; the FK to cost_price enables full landed cost audit (duty,

attributes.name: coupon_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.coupon. Business justification: Coupon redemption at POS line level: cashier scans coupon barcode applied to a specific line item. Required for coupon redemption tracking, fraud detection, single-use coupon enforcement, and vendor-f

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.department. Business justification: POS department sales reporting: POS transaction lines carry a denormalized department_code; a proper FK to store.department enforces referential integrity and enables department-level sales, shrinkage

attributes.name: item_bundle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.item_bundle. Business justification: POS bundle sales (e.g., meal deals, multi-buy promotions) must reference the bundle definition to apply correct bundle pricing, validate component scan sequence, and report bundle attachment rates. Re

attributes.name: markdown_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.markdown_event. Business justification: POS lines sold at markdown prices must reference the authorizing markdown_event to enable actual vs. projected markdown impact reporting. Retail merchandising accountability requires reconciling markd

attributes.name: markdown_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.markdown. Business justification: In-store markdown sell-through analysis — tracking units sold per markdown event at POS — is a standard retail buying report. Buyers need this to evaluate clearance markdown effectiveness across chann

attributes.name: member_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.member_offer. Business justification: A POS line item may be sold under a personalized member offer (targeted discount or bonus points). Recording which member offer applied per line enables offer redemption tracking, personalization effe

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent POS transaction header. Links this line item to the overall transaction.

attributes.name: price_change_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_change. Business justification: In-store price change effectiveness reporting requires linking POS transaction lines to the price change event that set the selling price. Retail pricing and buying teams measure units sold and margin

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Line-level profit center allocation supports accurate segment reporting for mixed-department transactions, enables product category profitability analysis, and is required for financial consolidation

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_offer. Business justification: POS line-item promo attribution: each scanned item can have a specific promo_offer applied, mirroring order_line.promo_offer_id. Required for vendor chargeback reconciliation, margin reporting by offe

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the master product record. Links to product information management system for detailed product attributes.

attributes.name: sku_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.sku_price. Business justification: POS lines record actual selling prices at point of sale. Linking to sku_price enables real-time price verification, override detection, shrinkage analysis from pricing discrepancies, and margin tracki

attributes.name: stock_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_ledger. Business justification: Each POS line item generates a stock ledger transaction recording the inventory movement at SKU level. Required for item-level inventory accounting, variance analysis, and reconciling physical sales t

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the supplier or vendor who provided this product. Used for vendor performance analysis and chargebacks.

attributes.name: vendor_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor_item. Business justification: POS transaction lines need vendor_item reference for DSD reconciliation, private label tracking, vendor-level sales reporting, and cost-of-goods reconciliation. Retail analytics and vendor scorecardin

attributes.name: cost_of_goods_sold
attributes.description: Unit cost of the product at the time of sale. Used for gross margin calculation and profitability analysis. Business confidential.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this transaction line record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trails.

attributes.name: ean
attributes.description: 13-digit European Article Number for international product identification. Used for global product tracking and cross-border commerce.

attributes.name: extended_price
attributes.description: Total price for this line item calculated as quantity multiplied by unit price before discounts. Gross line amount before markdown.

attributes.name: fulfillment_type
attributes.description: Method by which this line item was fulfilled. Supports omnichannel order orchestration and fulfillment analytics.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number that uniquely identifies trade items worldwide. Can be 8, 12, 13, or 14 digits depending on product type.

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the product as it appears on the receipt. Includes brand, product name, size, and variant details.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the transaction. Determines the order in which items were scanned or entered at the point of sale.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points earned for this line item purchase. Used for customer loyalty program management and engagement.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed to discount this line item. Reduces the net amount paid by the customer.

attributes.name: markdown_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied to this line item. Includes promotional discounts, coupons, and price reductions.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this transaction line record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: net_line_amount
attributes.description: Net amount for this line item after markdown but before tax. Calculated as extended price minus markdown amount.

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is a store brand or private label item. True for private label, false for national brands.

attributes.name: quantity_sold
attributes.description: Number of units sold for this line item. Supports fractional quantities for variable-weight items such as produce and deli products.

attributes.name: return_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item represents a product return. True for returned items, false for normal sales.

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for product return. Used for return analytics and quality management.

attributes.name: scanned_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this item was scanned or entered at the point of sale. Used for transaction timing analysis and basket sequence.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for serialized products such as electronics and appliances. Used for warranty tracking and theft prevention.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Internal stock keeping unit identifier for the product sold. Used for inventory tracking and assortment management.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax charged for this line item. Calculated by applying the tax rate to the net line amount.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction and category code for this line item. Determines applicable sales tax rate based on product category and location.

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: Sales tax rate applied to this line item expressed as a decimal. Example: 0.0825 represents 8.25 percent sales tax.

attributes.name: total_line_amount
attributes.description: Final total amount for this line item including tax. Sum of net line amount and tax amount.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity sold. Indicates whether the item is sold by each, weight, or bulk packaging. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|lb|kg|oz|g|case|pack|box — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_retail_price
attributes.description: Regular retail price per unit before any discounts or promotions. Represents the shelf price or list price of the item.

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code scanned at point of sale. Standard barcode identifier for North American retail products.

attributes.name: void_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for voiding this line item. Used for shrinkage analysis and operational improvement.

attributes.name: voided_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item was voided or cancelled during the transaction. True for voided items, false for completed sales.

attributes.name: weight_actual
attributes.description: Actual weight of variable-weight items measured at point of sale. Captured for produce, deli, meat, and bakery items sold by weight.
attributes.references: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Handbook 44

attributes.name: weight_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the actual weight. Indicates whether weight is measured in pounds, kilograms, ounces, or grams.
attributes.references: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Standards

products.name: payment
products.description: Payment tender record capturing each payment instrument applied to an order or POS transaction. Stores payment method type (credit card, debit, gift card, loyalty points, BNPL, cash, digital wallet), masked PAN/token, payment processor reference, authorization code, settlement status (authorized, captured, settled, declined, voided), payment amount, currency, tender sequence for split-tender scenarios, PCI DSS tokenization reference, fraud score, and 3DS authentication result. Supports split-tender where multiple payment methods cover a single order total. Integrates with PCI SSC compliance requirements and payment gateway APIs.
products.reference: OMS Payment / PCI DSS Payment Record

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment tender record. Primary key.

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ar_invoice. Business justification: Cash application process: retail finance teams match customer payments to AR invoices to clear open items, manage aging reports, and reconcile accounts receivable. A retail AR analyst expects payment

attributes.name: checkout_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.checkout. Business justification: Payment fraud audit and checkout-to-payment reconciliation require tracing each OMS payment record back to the digital checkout session that initiated it. Finance and fraud teams use this link daily.

attributes.name: gift_card_id
attributes.description: Masked or tokenized gift card number used for this payment tender. Applicable only when payment method type is gift card.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order or POS (Point of Sale) transaction to which this payment tender is applied. Links payment to the originating order header.

attributes.name: payment_method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.payment_method. Business justification: Tokenized payment reconciliation and chargeback management require linking each payment transaction to the customer's stored payment method on file. Retail fraud detection and PCI compliance reporting

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.pos_transaction. Business justification: A payment tender can be applied directly to a POS transaction (in-store purchase). While online order payments link via header_id, pure in-store POS payments need a direct FK to pos_transaction. This

attributes.name: redemption_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.redemption. Business justification: Payments made via 'pay with points' (loyalty redemption as tender) must link to the specific redemption event. Enables payment reconciliation reports, fraud detection for points-as-payment, and loyalt

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.shipment. Business justification: Retail e-commerce uses ship-to-capture payment models where final payment capture is triggered by shipment confirmation. Linking payment to shipment enables automated capture workflows, financial audi

attributes.name: subscription_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.subscription. Business justification: Recurring subscription payments generate individual payment records for each billing cycle. Without a subscription_id FK on payment, there is no way to associate a specific payment transaction with th

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount applied by this payment tender toward the order total. In split-tender scenarios, multiple payment records sum to the order total.

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Authorization code returned by the payment processor or issuing bank confirming approval of the payment transaction. Used for reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: authorization_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment was authorized by the payment processor or issuing bank. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this payment tender.

attributes.name: avs_result_code
attributes.description: Result code returned by Address Verification Service (AVS) indicating match status of billing address and postal code. Used for fraud prevention and risk assessment.

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the billing address associated with the payment method. Used for AVS (Address Verification Service) and fraud prevention.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; PCI DSS AVS Requirements

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the billing address (apartment, suite, unit number). Optional field for AVS (Address Verification Service).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; PCI DSS AVS Requirements

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City of the billing address associated with the payment method. Used for AVS (Address Verification Service) and fraud prevention.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; PCI DSS AVS Requirements

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the billing address (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Used for AVS (Address Verification Service) and international payment processing.

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the billing address. Critical for AVS (Address Verification Service) validation and fraud prevention.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; PCI DSS AVS Requirements

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the billing address. Used for AVS (Address Verification Service) and tax calculation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; PCI DSS AVS Requirements

attributes.name: bnpl_provider
attributes.description: Name of the Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) service provider (e.g., Affirm, Klarna, Afterpay). Applicable only when payment method type is BNPL.

attributes.name: capture_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the authorized payment was captured (funds marked for settlement). Typically occurs at order fulfillment or shipment.

attributes.name: card_brand
attributes.description: Brand or network of the payment card used (e.g., Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover). Applicable only when payment method type is credit or debit card. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: visa|mastercard|amex|discover|jcb|diners_club|unionpay — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: card_expiry_month
attributes.description: Expiration month of the payment card (1-12). Used for validation and recurring payment processing. Stored securely per PCI DSS requirements.

attributes.name: card_expiry_year
attributes.description: Expiration year of the payment card (four-digit format, e.g., 2025). Used for validation and recurring payment processing. Stored securely per PCI DSS requirements.

attributes.name: cardholder_name
attributes.description: Name of the cardholder as it appears on the payment card. Used for verification and fraud prevention. Stored securely per PCI DSS and GDPR requirements.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Channel or interface through which the payment was initiated. Distinguishes web, mobile app, in-store POS (Point of Sale), call center, kiosk, or third-party platform.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment tender record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the payment amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CAD). Supports multi-currency transactions.

attributes.name: cvv_result_code
attributes.description: Result code indicating whether the Card Verification Value (CVV/CVV2/CVC) provided by the cardholder matched the issuer's records. Used for fraud prevention.

attributes.name: digital_wallet_type
attributes.description: Type of digital wallet used for this payment tender (e.g., Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay, PayPal, Venmo). Applicable only when payment method type is digital wallet.

attributes.name: fraud_decision
attributes.description: Decision outcome from fraud detection system. Indicates whether the payment was approved, declined, flagged for manual review, or challenged with additional authentication.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Fraud Prevention Best Practices

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Numerical fraud risk score assigned by fraud detection system, typically ranging from 0 (low risk) to 100 (high risk). Used for payment approval decisions and risk management.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Fraud Prevention Best Practices

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed as payment for this tender. Applicable only when payment method type is loyalty points.

attributes.name: masked_pan
attributes.description: Masked or truncated version of the payment card Primary Account Number (PAN), typically showing only the last four digits (e.g., ****1234). Used for display and customer service without exposing full card number.
attributes.references: PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) Requirement 3.3

attributes.name: method_type
attributes.description: Type of payment instrument used for this tender. Includes credit card, debit card, gift card, loyalty points, BNPL (Buy Now Pay Later), cash, digital wallet (e.g., Apple Pay, Google Pay), or check. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|gift_card|loyalty_points|bnpl|cash|digital_wallet|check — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: PCI SSC (Payment Card Industry Security Standards Council) Payment Types

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment tender. Tracks progression from authorization through settlement, including declined, voided, or refunded states.

attributes.name: processor_reference_code
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the payment gateway or processor. Used for tracing and reconciliation with external payment systems.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount refunded to the customer for this payment tender. May be partial or full refund of the original payment amount.

attributes.name: refund_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when a refund was processed for this payment tender. Applicable for returns and RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) scenarios.

attributes.name: settlement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment was settled and funds were transferred from the customer's account to the merchant's account. Final step in payment lifecycle.

attributes.name: tender_sequence
attributes.description: Sequence number indicating the order in which this payment tender was applied in a split-tender scenario. First tender is 1, second is 2, etc.

attributes.name: three_ds_authentication_result
attributes.description: Result of 3-D Secure (3DS) authentication protocol for card-not-present transactions. Indicates whether cardholder was successfully authenticated, reducing fraud liability.

attributes.name: three_ds_version
attributes.description: Version of the 3-D Secure protocol used for authentication (e.g., 1.0.2, 2.1.0, 2.2.0). Newer versions provide enhanced security and user experience.

attributes.name: token
attributes.business_glossary_term: PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) Payment Token
attributes.description: Tokenized reference to the payment instrument, replacing sensitive card data. Token is generated by PCI DSS compliant tokenization service and used for recurring payments or stored payment methods.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment tender record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: void_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment authorization was voided (cancelled before capture). Applicable when order is cancelled before fulfillment.

products.name: discount
products.description: Discount and promotion application record at the order header or line level. Captures discount type (coupon, promo code, loyalty reward, markdown, BOGO, clearance, employee discount), discount code, discount amount or percentage, promotion campaign reference, stackability flag, applied-at level (header vs line), and approval status. Enables promotion attribution, markdown tracking, sell-through analysis, and P&L impact per order. Tax calculation attributes (taxable amount adjustment) included where discount affects tax basis.

attributes.name: discount_id
attributes.description: Primary key for discount

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Discount postings must reference specific GL accounts for financial reporting, promotional expense tracking, markdown accounting, and audit trails. Required for accurate revenue recognition, promotion

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order to which this discount is applied. Links to the order header.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical store location where the discount was applied. Null for online or non-store channels.

attributes.name: loyalty_membership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program member who redeemed points or received a loyalty-based discount. Null if discount is not loyalty-based.

attributes.name: markdown_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.markdown_event. Business justification: Discounts originating from a markdown event must be traceable to that event for markdown accountability reporting. Retail finance and merchandising teams reconcile markdown-driven discount amounts aga

attributes.name: order_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific order line item to which this discount is applied. Null if discount is applied at order header level.

attributes.name: pos_terminal_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the Point of Sale (POS) terminal or register where the discount was applied. Null for online channels.

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.pos_transaction. Business justification: Discounts and promotions are applied at POS transactions in-store, analogous to how discount.header_id links to online order headers. A discount applied at the transaction level (e.g., a store-wide pr

attributes.name: pos_transaction_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.pos_transaction_line. Business justification: Line-level discounts at POS (e.g., markdown on a specific scanned item, BOGO applied to a specific line) need a FK to pos_transaction_line, mirroring the existing discount.order_line_id for online ord

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing or promotional campaign that generated this discount. Links to the promotion campaign master data for attribution and performance analysis.

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_offer. Business justification: Discount records are linked to promo_campaign but not to the specific promo_offer that triggered them. Vendor-funded offer chargeback reconciliation and offer-level discount performance reporting requ

attributes.name: redemption_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.redemption. Business justification: A discount applied to an order may be funded by a loyalty redemption (points-for-discount reward). Linking discount to the specific redemption enables loyalty liability reconciliation, discount audit

attributes.name: rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.rule. Business justification: Pricing rule effectiveness reporting requires linking discount records to the pricing rule that triggered them. Retail pricing teams audit rule-driven discount spend, measure rule ROI, and validate th

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor_contract. Business justification: Vendor-funded markdowns and cooperative advertising allowances are governed by vendor contracts. Linking discount to vendor_contract enables vendor deduction accounting, co-op fund reconciliation, and

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the discount applied, in the order currency. Represents the total reduction in price due to this discount.

attributes.name: applied_at_level
attributes.description: Indicates whether the discount was applied at the order header level (affecting the entire order) or at the line item level (affecting a specific product).

attributes.name: applied_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the discount was applied to the order or line item. Represents the business event time of discount application.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval status of the discount application. Indicates whether the discount was automatically applied, requires manager approval, has been approved, or was rejected.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the discount was approved. Null if auto-applied or pending approval.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The sales channel through which the discount was applied. Indicates whether the discount was applied via online e-commerce, in-store Point of Sale (POS), mobile app, call center, or kiosk.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this discount record was first created in the data platform. Audit field for data lineage and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the discount amount. Typically matches the order currency.

attributes.name: discount_code
attributes.description: The promotional code, coupon code, or discount identifier entered or applied by the customer or system. Examples include promo codes, loyalty reward codes, employee discount codes.

attributes.name: discount_method
attributes.description: The calculation method used to determine the discount value. Indicates whether the discount is a percentage off, fixed dollar amount, tiered based on quantity or spend, Buy One Get One (BOGO) offer, or free shipping.

attributes.name: discount_type
attributes.description: Classification of the discount mechanism. Indicates the nature of the discount applied (e.g., coupon, promotional code, loyalty reward, markdown, Buy One Get One (BOGO), clearance, employee discount, volume discount, seasonal promotion, bundle discount, price override, manager override). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: coupon|promo_code|loyalty_reward|markdown|bogo|clearance|employee_discount|volume_discount|seasonal_promotion|bundle_discount|price_override|manager_override — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: final_price
attributes.description: The final price after the discount has been applied. Represents the net amount the customer pays for the discounted item or order.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: The number of loyalty program points redeemed to obtain this discount. Null if discount is not loyalty-based.

attributes.name: original_price
attributes.description: The original price of the item or order before the discount was applied. Used to calculate discount impact and markdown analysis.

attributes.name: percentage
attributes.description: The percentage discount applied to the order or line item. Populated when discount_method is percentage. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 15.00 for 15% off).

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: The priority order in which this discount is applied when multiple discounts are present. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used to determine discount application sequence.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: A code indicating the business reason for the discount. Examples include customer complaint resolution, price match, damaged goods, loyalty reward, seasonal clearance, or promotional campaign.

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context or justification for the discount application. Used for audit trail and customer service reference.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the source system that originated this discount record. Examples include Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM), Salesforce Commerce Cloud, SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR), or Point of Sale (POS) system.

attributes.name: source_system_discount_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this discount record in the source system. Used for traceability and reconciliation with upstream systems.

attributes.name: stackable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this discount can be combined (stacked) with other discounts on the same order or line item. True if stackable, False if exclusive.

attributes.name: tax_treatment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the discount is applied before tax calculation (pre-tax) or after tax calculation (post-tax). Affects the taxable amount and final tax computation.

attributes.name: taxable_amount_adjustment
attributes.description: The adjustment to the taxable base amount resulting from this discount. Used to recalculate sales tax when discount affects the tax basis.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this discount record was last modified in the data platform. Audit field for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The start date from which the discount code or promotion is valid. Used to enforce discount eligibility windows.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The end date until which the discount code or promotion is valid. Used to enforce discount eligibility windows. Null for open-ended discounts.

products.name: cancellation
products.description: Order or line-level cancellation event record capturing the full context of why and when an order or individual line was cancelled before shipment. Captures cancellation number, order/line reference, cancellation initiator (customer-initiated via web/app/call-center, system-initiated via OMS rules, fraud-hold auto-cancel, inventory allocation failure), cancellation reason code, cancellation timestamp, cancellation stage (pre-allocation, post-allocation-pre-pick, post-pick-pre-ship), refund eligibility flag, inventory release confirmation, and processing agent/system ID. Distinct from RMA which covers post-shipment returns.

attributes.name: cancellation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cancellation event. Primary key for the cancellation record.

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ar_invoice. Business justification: Invoice reversal process: when an invoiced order is cancelled, finance must reverse or credit-memo the AR invoice. Linking cancellation to ar_invoice enables automated credit memo generation, refund r

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.fulfillment_order. Business justification: When an order is cancelled, the associated fulfillment_order must be halted and inventory released. Cancellation records must reference fulfillment_order to trigger WMS stop-pick/stop-pack workflows a

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Cancellation accounting (restocking fees, cancellation charges, refund processing) requires GL account assignment for proper revenue/expense recognition, financial reporting, and audit compliance. Sta

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent order that was cancelled. Links this cancellation to the originating order header.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.location. Business justification: Store-level cancellation tracking: BOPIS and in-store order cancellations must be attributed to the store location for store-level cancellation rate KPIs, inventory release reconciliation, and custome

attributes.name: order_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific order line item that was cancelled. Null if the entire order was cancelled rather than individual lines.

attributes.name: payment_method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.payment_method. Business justification: Refund-to-original-tender processing requires linking cancellations to the specific customer payment method for automated refund routing. Retail return management and PCI-compliant refund workflows de

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.pos_transaction. Business justification: In-store transaction voids and returns are cancellation events that apply to a POS transaction. The cancellation table currently links to header_id and order_line_id for online orders, but lacks a FK

attributes.name: pos_transaction_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.pos_transaction_line. Business justification: Line-level returns at POS (customer returning a specific item from a prior transaction) require a FK to pos_transaction_line, mirroring the existing cancellation.order_line_id for online order line ca

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer associated with the cancelled order. Links cancellation to the customer master record for analytics and customer service.

attributes.name: redemption_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.redemption. Business justification: When an order is cancelled, any loyalty redemption applied (points-for-discount) must be reversed. The cancellation record must reference the specific redemption to trigger the reversal workflow and e

attributes.name: rma_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to returns.rma. Business justification: Post-shipment cancellations generate RMAs for already-shipped items. Linking cancellation to rma enables post-shipment cancellation workflows, refund reconciliation, and inventory recovery tracking. R

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.shipment. Business justification: If a shipment is already in transit at cancellation time, the cancellation must reference the shipment to initiate carrier recall or return-to-sender. Retail reverse logistics, carrier void processing

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cancellation requires managerial or supervisory approval before execution. True for high-value orders or policy exceptions.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cancellation was approved by an authorized agent or manager. Null if no approval required or not yet approved.

attributes.name: cancellation_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique cancellation reference number used for customer communication and tracking. Format: CXL-XXXXXXXXXX.

attributes.name: cancellation_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the cancellation request. Tracks the cancellation through its approval and execution workflow.

attributes.name: cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cancellation was initiated or requested. Represents the business event time of the cancellation action.

attributes.name: cancelled_amount
attributes.description: Total order or line value that was cancelled, including product cost, taxes, and fees. Represents the gross cancelled transaction value.

attributes.name: cancelled_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the product or item that was cancelled. Relevant for line-level cancellations. Measured in the unit of measure of the ordered item.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Channel or interface through which the cancellation was submitted. Tracks omnichannel cancellation touchpoints. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web|mobile_app|call_center|store|email|chat|system_automated — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this cancellation record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: customer_notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a cancellation confirmation notification was sent to the customer via email, SMS, or app notification. True if notification sent.

attributes.name: customer_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cancellation confirmation notification was sent to the customer. Null if notification not sent or failed.

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Administrative or processing fee charged for the cancellation. Zero if no cancellation fee applies per business policy or customer segment.

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was triggered by fraud detection rules or suspected fraudulent activity. True if fraud-related cancellation.

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Fraud risk score assigned by the fraud detection system at the time of cancellation. Higher scores indicate higher fraud risk. Null if not fraud-related.

attributes.name: initiator_type
attributes.description: Category of entity that initiated the cancellation. Distinguishes between customer-initiated, system-initiated, agent-initiated, and automated rule-based cancellations.

attributes.name: inventory_release_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when allocated inventory was released back to available stock following the cancellation. Null if inventory was never allocated or not yet released.

attributes.name: inventory_released_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether inventory allocated to the cancelled order or line has been released back to available stock. True if inventory release confirmed.

attributes.name: processing_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the system or automated process that executed the cancellation. Used for system-initiated cancellations to track which rule engine or service triggered the action.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the reason for cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: customer_request|out_of_stock|pricing_error|duplicate_order|payment_declined|fraud_suspected|delivery_delay|product_unavailable|customer_changed_mind|incorrect_item_ordered|found_better_price|shipping_cost_too_high|delivery_time_too_long|order_placed_by_mistake|item_no_longer_needed|quality_concerns|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description or additional details provided by the initiator explaining the reason for cancellation. Captures customer comments or agent notes.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary amount to be refunded to the customer for this cancellation. Includes product cost, taxes, and fees as applicable.

attributes.name: refund_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the refund amount. Indicates the currency in which the refund will be processed.

attributes.name: refund_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cancelled order or line is eligible for a refund based on payment status and business rules. True if refund should be processed.

attributes.name: refund_method
attributes.description: Method by which the refund will be issued to the customer. Typically matches the original payment method but may differ based on business rules.

attributes.name: refund_processed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund was successfully processed and submitted to the payment gateway or finance system. Null if refund not yet processed.

attributes.name: restocking_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged to the customer for cancelling the order after certain fulfillment stages. Zero if no restocking fee applies per business policy.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cancellation was subsequently reversed and the order reinstated. True if the cancellation was undone.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why the cancellation was reversed. Captures business justification for reinstating the order.

attributes.name: reversal_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cancellation was reversed and the order reinstated. Null if no reversal occurred.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the source system that originated the cancellation record. Used for data lineage and integration tracking across OMS, e-commerce, and POS systems.

attributes.name: stage
attributes.description: Order fulfillment stage at which the cancellation occurred. Indicates how far the order progressed before cancellation and impacts inventory release and refund processing.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this cancellation record was last modified. Audit field for tracking changes to cancellation status, refund processing, or other attributes.

products.name: gift_card
products.description: Master record for gift cards and stored-value instruments sold and redeemed across all channels. Captures card number, card type (physical, digital), initial balance, current balance, activation date, expiry date, and issuing channel.

attributes.name: gift_card_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the gift card record. Primary key.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the order transaction in which this gift card was purchased. Links gift card to originating sales transaction. Nullable for cards issued outside normal order flow (e.g., corporate bulk issuance).

attributes.name: liability_gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Gift card liability tracking requires specific GL account for deferred revenue, breakage recognition, balance sheet reporting, and ASC 606 compliance. Role-prefixed because gift cards have multiple GL

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical store location where the gift card was issued or sold. Nullable for non-store channels.

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.pos_transaction. Business justification: Gift cards are frequently purchased and activated at POS terminals in-store. The gift_card table currently has header_id for online gift card purchases but lacks a FK to pos_transaction for in-store a

attributes.name: primary_gift_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer who purchased the gift card. May differ from the recipient. Nullable if purchased anonymously or by guest.

attributes.name: primary_replacement_for_card_gift_card_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the original gift card that this card replaces (e.g., lost or damaged card replacement). Nullable for original issuances. Balance is typically transferred from original card.

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.loyalty_program. Business justification: Gift cards in retail are frequently issued under a specific loyalty program (co-branded cards, program-exclusive gift cards). Linking gift_card to loyalty_program enables program-level liability repor

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the promotional campaign associated with this gift card issuance (e.g., holiday bonus card, purchase-with-purchase offer). Nullable for non-promotional cards.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.shipment. Business justification: Physical gift cards require shipment tracking. Linking gift_card to its delivery shipment enables customer service to resolve 'where is my gift card?' inquiries, supports lost-card replacement workflo

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.storefront. Business justification: Gift cards sold or redeemed through digital channels require storefront attribution for revenue recognition, liability tracking by channel, and fraud prevention. Retailers must track which digital sto

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date when the gift card was activated and became available for redemption. May differ from issue date if activation is delayed (e.g., physical cards activated at first use).

attributes.name: barcode
attributes.description: Barcode value encoded on physical gift cards for scanning at Point of Sale (POS). May be UPC (Universal Product Code), EAN (European Article Number), or proprietary format.

attributes.name: card_number
attributes.description: Unique card number printed or encoded on the gift card. Typically 16-19 digits. Used for identification and redemption at Point of Sale (POS) or e-commerce checkout.
attributes.references: PCI DSS - Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: card_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the gift card. Inactive: issued but not yet activated; Active: available for use; Suspended: temporarily blocked; Expired: past validity period; Depleted: balance fully redeemed; Cancelled: voided or returned.
attributes.references: ISO 8583 - Financial Transaction Card Originated Messages

attributes.name: card_type
attributes.description: Type of gift card instrument. Physical cards are tangible plastic cards; digital/virtual cards are delivered electronically via email or app; mobile wallet cards are provisioned into digital wallets (Apple Pay, Google Pay).
attributes.references: GS1 - Global Standards for Product Identification

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gift card record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the denomination of the gift card balance (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CAD).

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: Remaining monetary value available on the gift card after all redemptions, adjustments, and fees. Updated in real-time with each transaction.

attributes.name: escheatment_date
attributes.description: Date when the gift card balance was escheated (transferred) to state unclaimed property authority. Nullable if not yet escheated.

attributes.name: escheatment_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the gift card balance is eligible for escheatment (transfer to state unclaimed property) based on dormancy period and state regulations. True: eligible; False: not eligible.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the gift card expires and can no longer be redeemed. Nullable for cards with no expiration. Subject to regulatory requirements (e.g., CARD Act in USA mandates minimum 5-year validity).
attributes.references: Credit CARD Act of 2009 - Gift Card Regulations

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this gift card has been flagged for suspected fraudulent activity (e.g., unauthorized use, balance tampering, stolen card). True: fraud suspected; False: no fraud detected.
attributes.references: PCI DSS - Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: fraud_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for fraud flag (e.g., STOLEN, COUNTERFEIT, BALANCE_TAMPERING, SUSPICIOUS_ACTIVITY). Nullable if fraud_flag is false.
attributes.references: PCI DSS - Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: initial_balance
attributes.description: Original monetary value loaded onto the gift card at the time of issuance or purchase. Represents the starting balance before any redemptions or adjustments.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the gift card was originally issued or sold to the customer. Marks the beginning of the card lifecycle.

attributes.name: issuing_channel
attributes.description: Sales channel through which the gift card was originally issued or purchased. Store: in-store POS; Ecommerce: online storefront; Mobile App: mobile commerce; Call Center: phone order; Corporate Sales: bulk B2B sales; Third Party: external marketplace or partner.
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gift card record was last updated. Tracks data currency and supports change data capture (CDC) processes.

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent transaction (redemption, reload, or adjustment) on this gift card. Used for dormancy tracking and escheatment compliance.

attributes.name: pin_code
attributes.description: Personal Identification Number (PIN) required for online redemption or balance inquiry. Typically 4-8 digits. Stored encrypted in production systems.
attributes.references: PCI DSS - Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: qr_code
attributes.description: Quick Response (QR) code data for mobile wallet provisioning or contactless redemption. Encoded with card number and validation data.

attributes.name: recipient_email
attributes.description: Email address of the gift card recipient. Used for digital card delivery and balance notifications. Required for digital/virtual cards.

attributes.name: recipient_phone
