attributes.name: assortment_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.assortment_item. Business justification: In retail, a digital catalog listing is authorized by an assortment_item record that approved the SKU for the online channel. This link enables assortment sell-through reporting by channel, lifecycle

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_brand. Business justification: Ecommerce brand pages, brand-filtered search, and brand-level promotions require catalog entries to reference the authoritative brand record. brand_name is a denormalized string; a proper FK enables b

attributes.name: buyer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.buyer. Business justification: Buyers manage online assortment, pricing strategy, and product content decisions for their assigned categories. Digital catalog accountability and performance reporting require buyer attribution for m

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary digital storefront category (navigation taxonomy node) under which this SKU is merchandised online. May differ from the master merchandise hierarchy in ORMS to reflect digital-specific category management and assortment breadth strategies.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Category Management; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: fulfilling_dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.dc_facility. Business justification: Drop-ship and delivery promise: digital_catalog.is_drop_ship_eligible requires knowing which DC fulfills the item to display accurate lead times and shipping promises online. Role-prefix 'fulfilling_'

attributes.name: inventory_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.inventory_node. Business justification: Online catalog displays store-level availability for BOPIS and ship-from-store fulfillment options. Enables "available at nearby stores" feature and store inventory lookup for omnichannel shoppers.

attributes.name: item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.item_hierarchy. Business justification: Ecommerce catalog navigation, faceted browsing, and category-level reporting depend on product hierarchy. Retail domain experts expect digital catalog entries to reference the product taxonomy node di

attributes.name: primary_image_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.image. Business justification: Ecommerce catalog listings must reference the approved product image record for display. Linking digital_catalog to product.image enforces referential integrity, enables image lifecycle management (ex

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Catalog items are assigned to profit centers for gross margin analysis, markdown accounting, channel profitability reporting, and product line P&L in retail management accounting systems.

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.season. Business justification: Online catalog organized by retail seasons (Spring/Summer, Fall/Winter, Holiday). Seasonal merchandising drives publish/unpublish schedules, promotional calendars, and assortment planning. Critical fo

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Catalog publishing process requires authoritative link to product master for attributes, compliance flags, lifecycle status, vendor data, and pricing rules. Retail operations depend on single source o

attributes.name: sku_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.sku_price. Business justification: Digital catalog product pages must display authoritative online prices from sku_price, which maintains channel-specific and zone-specific pricing. Core business process: e-commerce price display and c

attributes.name: target_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: Segment-targeted catalog publication: retail merchandising teams publish catalogs for specific customer segments (VIP members-only catalog, B2B wholesale catalog). Segment-level catalog visibility con

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor_contract. Business justification: Exclusive/private-label catalog authorization: vendor contracts with exclusivity_flag or private-label terms govern which products can be listed online. Merchandising compliance requires linking a cat

attributes.name: vendor_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor_item. Business justification: Drop-ship catalog management: a digital catalog listing for a drop-ship product must reference the specific vendor_item record to surface accurate lead times, pack configuration, country of origin, an

attributes.name: canonical_url
attributes.description: The canonical URL of the product detail page (PDP) used to prevent duplicate content issues across multiple storefront URLs or faceted navigation paths. Declared in the HTML link rel=canonical tag. Managed in Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — SEO Configuration; Google Search Central Guidelines

attributes.name: content_completeness_score
attributes.description: Percentage score (0.00–100.00) measuring how complete the digital content is for this catalog record, based on presence of required fields such as title, description, images, SEO metadata, and rich media. Used to prioritize content enrichment efforts and improve Conversion Rate (CR).
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Content Quality Scoring; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this digital catalog record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and content age analysis. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Information Security Audit; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the online_price for this digital catalog record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency storefronts in international e-commerce operations.

attributes.name: has_video
attributes.description: Indicates whether at least one product video (e.g., demonstration, unboxing, lifestyle) is published for this SKU on the storefront. Rich media presence is a key driver of Conversion Rate (CR) improvement in digital commerce.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Rich Media Management; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: image_count
attributes.description: Total number of product images published for this SKU on the storefront, including hero, alternate angles, lifestyle, and swatch images. Used to measure digital content completeness and identify SKUs requiring additional imagery.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Digital Asset Management; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: is_drop_ship_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is fulfilled via Drop Ship, where the vendor ships directly to the customer without passing through a Distribution Center (DC). Relevant for extended aisle and marketplace assortment strategies.
attributes.references: NRF — Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) and Drop Ship Standards

attributes.name: is_featured
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU has been manually designated as a featured product by digital merchandisers, qualifying it for placement in featured product carousels, homepage spotlights, or category hero positions on the storefront.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Merchandising Rules; NRF — Visual Merchandising Standards

attributes.name: is_online_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU is currently available for purchase on the digital storefront. Distinct from publication_status — a product may be published but temporarily unavailable due to inventory depletion or fulfillment constraints. Drives add-to-cart eligibility.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Inventory Availability; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: is_private_label
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is a private label (store brand) product owned and sold exclusively by the retailer. Private label products typically carry higher gross margins and are a key strategic differentiator in assortment planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) — Assortment Planning; NRF — Private Label Standards

attributes.name: is_searchable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is indexed and returned in on-site search results on the digital storefront. A product may be published but excluded from search (e.g., exclusive landing page products or clearance items managed via direct URL only).
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Search Index Configuration

attributes.name: last_published_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when this digital catalog record was most recently published or re-published to the live storefront. Used for content freshness tracking, cache invalidation, and audit trails in Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Publish History; ISO 27001 — Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: locale_code
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 locale code specifying the language and regional variant for this digital catalog record (e.g., en-US, fr-CA, es-MX). Supports multi-locale storefront content management and international e-commerce operations in Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Localization; IETF BCP 47 — Language Tags

attributes.name: long_description
attributes.description: Full consumer-facing product description displayed on the product detail page (PDP), including features, benefits, materials, and usage instructions. Supports rich HTML formatting. Managed in Salesforce Commerce Cloud content management.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Product Detail Page (PDP); FDA — Food Labeling Requirements (for grocery SKUs)

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: The consumer-facing product title as displayed on the digital storefront. May differ from the master product name in PIM to reflect channel-specific merchandising copy or A/B tested titles. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE IDENTITY_LABEL category.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Product Detail Page (PDP); NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: publication_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the digital catalog record on the storefront. Controls whether the SKU is visible and purchasable by online shoppers. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE LIFECYCLE_STATUS category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|published|unpublished|scheduled|archived|suspended — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Catalog Management; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: publish_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this digital catalog record is scheduled to be or was deactivated and removed from the storefront. Used for seasonal assortment management, limited-time offers, and clearance markdown lifecycle management.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Catalog Scheduling; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM)

attributes.name: publish_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which this digital catalog record is scheduled to become or became active and visible on the storefront. Used for pre-launch product scheduling and promotional launch coordination in Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Catalog Scheduling; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: rating_average
attributes.description: Average customer review rating for this SKU on the digital storefront, on a scale of 0.00 to 5.00. Aggregated from verified purchase reviews. Used in product ranking algorithms, content completeness scoring, and conversion rate optimization analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Ratings and Reviews; NRF — Customer Experience Standards

attributes.name: review_count
attributes.description: Total number of published customer reviews for this SKU on the digital storefront. Used alongside rating_average to assess review volume credibility and identify SKUs requiring review generation campaigns.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Ratings and Reviews; FTC — Endorsement and Testimonial Guidelines

attributes.name: seo_meta_description
attributes.description: The HTML meta description tag for the product detail page (PDP), summarizing the product for search engine result snippets. Typically 150-160 characters. Drives organic Click-Through Rate (CTR) from search engine results pages.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — SEO Configuration; Google Search Central Guidelines

attributes.name: seo_title
attributes.description: The HTML page title tag for the product detail page (PDP), optimized for search engine indexing. Typically limited to 60 characters per SEO best practices. Managed in Salesforce Commerce Cloud content management.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — SEO Configuration; Google Search Central Guidelines

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Brief consumer-facing product description displayed in product listing pages (PLP) and search results. Typically 100-200 characters. Sourced from Salesforce Commerce Cloud product content and may differ from the master description in PIM.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Product Information Management (PIM) Integration; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric position used to control the default display sequence of this SKU within its assigned digital category on the storefront. Lower values appear first. Used by merchandisers to manually curate product listing page (PLP) rankings.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Merchandising Rules; NRF — Visual Merchandising Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this digital catalog record originated or was last updated. Supports data lineage tracking across Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC), Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS), Informatica MDM, and Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM).
attributes.references: Informatica MDM — Master Data Management; ISO 27001 — Data Lineage

attributes.name: tax_category_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code assigned to this SKU for digital commerce tax calculation purposes, determining applicable sales tax rates at checkout. Mapped to tax engine rules in Salesforce Commerce Cloud. Relevant for FDA-regulated food items with tax exemptions.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; FDA — Food Tax Exemption Classifications; FTC — Pricing Transparency

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this digital catalog record was most recently modified, including content updates, price changes, status transitions, or SEO edits. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Information Security Audit; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability

attributes.name: url_slug
attributes.description: The human-readable URL path segment for the product detail page (PDP), used in constructing the storefront URL. Must be lowercase, hyphen-separated, and unique per storefront. Example: 'mens-slim-fit-chino-pants-navy'.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — URL Management; Google Search Central Guidelines

products.name: web_session
products.description: Tracks individual visitor sessions on digital storefronts, capturing session start/end timestamps, device type, browser, OS, referral source, UTM parameters, landing page, exit page, page view count, session duration, and whether the session resulted in a cart creation, checkout initiation, or completed order. Supports CTR, CR, and digital journey analytics. High-volume event data — recommend 90-day hot retention with archival to cold storage for historical trend analysis.

attributes.name: web_session_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual visitor session on the digital storefront. Primary key for the web_session data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: cart_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shopping cart created or interacted with during this session. Enables abandoned cart analysis and cart-level GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) attribution even when no order is placed.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order placed during this session, if is_order_placed is True. Enables direct linkage between digital session analytics and order-level GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) and AOV (Average Order Value) reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Order Management; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: loyalty_membership_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.loyalty_membership. Business justification: When a loyalty member logs into the ecommerce storefront, the session must be linked to their membership to drive personalized catalog display, member-tier pricing, and targeted offer presentation. Re

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the authenticated customer associated with this session. Null for anonymous/guest sessions. Enables online-to-offline attribution and CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) analysis.

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program membership associated with this session, if the visitor is an authenticated loyalty member. Supports Customer Loyalty and Engagement Program analytics and CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) attribution.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Loyalty Integration; NRF Customer Loyalty Standards

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Sessions originate from promotional emails, paid search for promotional keywords, or circular ad QR codes; tracking campaign attribution at session level is fundamental to digital marketing ROI, omnic

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_offer. Business justification: Session-level offer attribution and digital marketing ROI reporting require web sessions to reference the specific promo_offer that drove the visit. Retail digital teams track offer-driven session con

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the digital storefront or e-commerce site where the session occurred. Supports multi-brand and multi-region digital commerce operations.

attributes.name: browser_name
attributes.description: Name of the web browser used during the session (e.g., Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge). Used for compatibility analysis and identifying browser-specific conversion drop-offs in the digital funnel.

attributes.name: browser_version
attributes.description: Version string of the web browser used during the session. Supports technical compatibility analysis and identification of outdated browser populations impacting checkout CR (Conversion Rate).

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the consent notice or cookie policy presented to the visitor at session start. Enables compliance audit trails demonstrating which consent framework version was in effect at the time of data collection.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp indicating when this web session record was first captured and written to the Silver Layer data product. Distinct from session_start_timestamp which reflects the real-world event time.

attributes.name: data_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the visitor provided explicit consent for data collection and tracking during this session, as required under GDPR and CCPA. True = consent granted. Governs permissible use of session data for analytics and personalization.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Category of device used by the visitor during the session. Supports omnichannel digital journey analytics and device-specific CR (Conversion Rate) and AOV (Average Order Value) reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Device Detection; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: exit_page_url
attributes.description: Full URL of the last page viewed before the visitor ended the session. Used to identify drop-off points in the digital funnel and optimize checkout flow to improve CR (Conversion Rate).

attributes.name: fulfillment_type
attributes.description: Fulfillment method selected or browsed during the session. BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store), ROPIS (Reserve Online Pick Up In Store), home_delivery, ship_from_store (SFS), or drop_ship. Supports omnichannel attribution and last-mile delivery analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Fulfillment Options; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: geo_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code inferred from the visitor's IP address or browser locale. Supports international digital commerce analytics and regional GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) reporting.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the visitor at session initiation. Used for geolocation inference, fraud detection, and bot traffic filtering. May be considered PII under GDPR/CCPA in some jurisdictions. Stored in compliance with data minimization principles.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; PCI DSS Requirement 1

attributes.name: is_bot
attributes.description: Indicates whether the session was identified as automated bot or crawler traffic rather than a genuine human visitor. True = bot session. Used to filter non-human traffic from CR (Conversion Rate), CTR (Click-Through Rate), and Footfall analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Bot Detection; FTC Advertising Standards

attributes.name: is_bounce
attributes.description: Indicates whether the session was a bounce — the visitor viewed only a single page and exited without further interaction. True = bounce session. Used to calculate bounce rate as a digital storefront health KPI.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Session Analytics; NRF Digital Commerce KPIs

attributes.name: is_cart_created
attributes.description: Indicates whether the visitor created a shopping cart (added at least one item) during this session. True = cart was created. Key funnel stage flag for CR (Conversion Rate) and abandoned cart analysis in Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Cart Management; NRF Digital Commerce KPIs

attributes.name: is_checkout_initiated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the visitor initiated the checkout flow during this session. True = checkout was started. Enables measurement of cart-to-checkout conversion rate and identification of checkout abandonment in the digital funnel.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Checkout Flow; NRF Digital Commerce KPIs

attributes.name: is_order_placed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the session resulted in a completed order placement. True = order was placed. Primary conversion flag for CR (Conversion Rate) calculation and GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) attribution to digital sessions.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Order Management; NRF Digital Commerce KPIs; FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: landing_page_url
attributes.description: Full URL of the first page viewed by the visitor upon entering the digital storefront. Critical for measuring landing page CR (Conversion Rate) and identifying high-performing entry points in the digital customer journey.

attributes.name: last_search_query
attributes.description: The most recent on-site search term entered by the visitor during the session. Supports merchandising and assortment planning by revealing demand signals and zero-result search patterns.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Search Analytics; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: operating_system
attributes.description: Operating system of the visitor's device during the session (e.g., Windows, macOS, iOS, Android). Used for device ecosystem analysis and platform-specific performance optimization.

attributes.name: page_view_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct pages viewed by the visitor during the session. Indicator of session engagement depth and product discovery behavior. Used in basket analysis and digital journey analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Session Analytics; NRF Digital Commerce KPIs

attributes.name: referral_source
attributes.description: High-level channel classification of how the visitor arrived at the digital storefront. Supports digital marketing attribution, CTR (Click-Through Rate) analysis, and channel-level CR (Conversion Rate) reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: organic_search|paid_search|social|email|direct|affiliate|display|referral|sms|push_notification — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Marketing Attribution; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: referral_url
attributes.description: Full URL of the referring page or external site that directed the visitor to the digital storefront. Null for direct traffic. Enables granular attribution analysis beyond high-level referral_source classification.

attributes.name: search_query_count
attributes.description: Number of on-site search queries executed by the visitor during the session. Indicator of product discovery intent and search effectiveness. Used to optimize PIM (Product Information Management) and assortment depth.

attributes.name: session_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in seconds between session_start_timestamp and session_end_timestamp. Raw measurement used to compute average session duration KPIs and correlate engagement with CR (Conversion Rate) and AOV (Average Order Value).
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Session Analytics; NRF Digital Commerce KPIs

attributes.name: session_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the visitor session ended, either through explicit logout, timeout, or browser close. Null if session is still active. Used to compute session duration.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Session Management; ISO 8601

attributes.name: session_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when the visitor session was initiated on the digital storefront. Principal business event timestamp for session lifecycle analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Session Management; ISO 8601

attributes.name: session_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the web session. 'active' = session in progress; 'completed' = session ended with a conversion event; 'abandoned' = session ended without conversion; 'timed_out' = session expired due to inactivity; 'bounced' = single-page session with immediate exit.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Session Management; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: session_token
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric session identifier generated by Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) at session initiation. Used for cross-system session correlation and digital journey stitching across touchpoints.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp indicating when this web session record was last modified in the Silver Layer, such as when session_end_timestamp or conversion flags are updated upon session close.

attributes.name: utm_campaign
attributes.description: Urchin Tracking Module (UTM) campaign parameter identifying the specific marketing campaign name or promotion (e.g., spring_sale_2024, loyalty_reactivation). Links sessions to Pricing and Promotions Management campaigns.
attributes.references: Google Analytics UTM Parameter Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Marketing Attribution

attributes.name: utm_content
attributes.description: Urchin Tracking Module (UTM) content parameter used to differentiate ads or links pointing to the same URL (e.g., banner_top, text_link). Supports A/B testing and creative-level CTR (Click-Through Rate) analysis.

attributes.name: utm_medium
attributes.description: Urchin Tracking Module (UTM) medium parameter identifying the marketing medium (e.g., cpc, email, social, banner). Used alongside utm_source for multi-channel attribution and GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) contribution analysis.
attributes.references: Google Analytics UTM Parameter Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Marketing Attribution

attributes.name: utm_source
attributes.description: Urchin Tracking Module (UTM) source parameter from the session entry URL, identifying the advertiser, site, publication, or other source (e.g., google, newsletter, facebook). Core dimension for digital marketing campaign attribution.
attributes.references: Google Analytics UTM Parameter Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Marketing Attribution

attributes.name: utm_term
attributes.description: Urchin Tracking Module (UTM) term parameter capturing the paid search keyword that triggered the session. Used for paid search keyword-level ROI (Return on Investment) and CTR (Click-Through Rate) analysis.

attributes.name: visitor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the visitor for this session. 'new' = first-time visitor; 'returning' = previously visited but not authenticated; 'authenticated' = logged-in registered customer; 'guest' = checkout without account. Supports CR (Conversion Rate) segmentation and personalization.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Visitor Segmentation; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

products.name: cart
products.description: Represents a shopping cart instance created during a customer's digital session on a storefront. Captures cart creation timestamp, last modified timestamp, cart status (active, abandoned, converted, expired), total item count, subtotal, applied promotion/coupon identifiers, discount amounts, estimated tax, estimated shipping, and the channel/storefront context. Includes digital promotion redemption details: promotion ID, coupon code, discount amount, redemption channel (web, mobile app, email link), redemption status (applied, validated, rejected, reversed), and customer identity reference. SSOT for cart-level data supporting abandoned cart recovery, AOV analysis, and promotion effectiveness measurement within the digital channel. Cart abandonment is determined by timeout or session expiry; recovery workflows are tracked in the abandoned_cart_recovery product.

attributes.name: cart_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for a shopping cart instance created during a customer's digital session on a storefront. Serves as the primary key for the cart data product and is referenced by cart line items, abandoned cart recovery workflows, and order conversion records.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: B2B account-based cart management: corporate accounts require credit limit validation and tax-exempt status checks at cart creation. Retail B2B platforms track cart-to-account for approval workflows,

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Internal employee purchases and corporate procurement via ecommerce platforms require cost center attribution for departmental charge-back accounting, budget tracking, and GL posting in retail finance

attributes.name: coupon_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.coupon. Business justification: Coupon validation and abandoned-cart coupon recovery reporting require the cart to reference the coupon entity directly. Retail analysts track coupon-driven cart conversion rates by coupon_id. The exi

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order record created when this cart was successfully converted at checkout. Null for carts that have not yet converted (active, abandoned, or expired). Enables cart-to-order traceability, Conversion Rate (CR) measurement, and reconciliation between the digital commerce platform and the Order Management System (OMS).
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Order Object; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical store location selected by the customer for Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) or Reserve Online Pick Up In Store (ROPIS) fulfillment. Null for ship-to-home and drop-ship carts. Supports online-to-offline attribution, store-level BOPIS volume reporting, and inventory reservation at the designated store.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud BOPIS Configuration; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: loyalty_membership_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.loyalty_membership. Business justification: Cart already tracks loyalty_points_earned and loyalty_points_redeemed but has no FK to the member. Linking cart to loyalty_membership enables real-time points preview, member-specific pricing, and aba

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the authenticated customer who owns this cart. Null for guest/anonymous sessions where no login has occurred. Used for abandoned cart recovery, Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) attribution, and personalization workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Customer Object; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary promotion applied to this cart. Used for promotion effectiveness measurement, discount attribution, and digital marketing ROI analysis. A cart may have one primary promotion; additional promotions are tracked at the line level.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Salesforce Commerce Cloud Promotions

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_offer. Business justification: Offer stacking rule enforcement and maximum redemption limit checking at cart level require the cart to reference the specific promo_offer applied. Retail promotions teams validate offer eligibility a

attributes.name: shipping_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.address. Business justification: Cart-level shipping address pre-selection: customers assign a saved address to the cart for real-time shipping rate calculation, BOPIS eligibility checks, and delivery date estimation before checkout.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the digital storefront or site context in which this cart was created. Supports multi-brand, multi-region, and multi-locale storefront configurations within Salesforce Commerce Cloud. Enables Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) and Average Order Value (AOV) analysis by storefront.

attributes.name: abandoned_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the cart was classified as abandoned, either by session timeout or explicit inactivity threshold breach. Null for non-abandoned carts. Used to calculate time-to-abandonment metrics, trigger abandoned cart recovery email sequences, and measure recovery window effectiveness.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Cart Abandonment; ISO 8601

attributes.name: abandonment_reason
attributes.description: Classified reason code for why the cart was abandoned. 'session_timeout' indicates the session expired; 'inactivity' indicates no user action within the inactivity window; 'explicit_exit' indicates the customer navigated away; 'payment_failure' indicates checkout was attempted but payment was declined; 'out_of_stock' indicates items became unavailable; 'price_change' indicates a price change triggered cart exit. Null for non-abandoned carts. Supports abandonment root cause analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Session Management; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: cart_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally referenceable business identifier for the cart instance. Used in customer service interactions, abandoned cart recovery email communications, and cross-system reconciliation between Salesforce Commerce Cloud and the Order Management System (OMS). Formatted as CART- followed by a 10-digit sequence.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Cart Object; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: cart_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the shopping cart. 'active' indicates the cart is open and being interacted with; 'abandoned' indicates the session timed out or the customer left without checkout; 'converted' indicates the cart was successfully submitted as an order; 'expired' indicates the cart exceeded the maximum retention window; 'merged' indicates the cart was consolidated with another cart (e.g., guest-to-authenticated merge). Drives abandoned cart recovery workflows and Conversion Rate (CR) reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Cart Lifecycle; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The digital channel or interface through which the cart was created and is being managed. Supports omnichannel analytics distinguishing web browser, native mobile application, mobile web browser, email-link-initiated sessions, and Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) kiosk interactions. Critical for channel-level Conversion Rate (CR) and Average Order Value (AOV) analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Channel Configuration; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: converted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the cart was successfully converted to an order at checkout completion. Null for carts that have not converted. Used for cart-to-order conversion time analysis, checkout funnel performance measurement, and Conversion Rate (CR) reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the cart instance was first created in the system, recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Represents the start of the cart lifecycle. Used for cart age calculation, session duration analysis, and abandonment timeout determination.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Cart Object; ISO 8601

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this cart (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, CAD). Supports multi-currency storefronts and international e-commerce operations. All amount fields on this cart are denominated in this currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: data_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has provided explicit consent for their cart and behavioral data to be used for personalization, marketing, and analytics purposes (True) or has not consented or opted out (False). Mandatory for GDPR and CCPA compliance. Governs eligibility for abandoned cart recovery communications and behavioral targeting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 Lawful Basis; CCPA Section 1798.120; FTC Privacy Standards

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Classification of the device category used by the customer to create and interact with this cart. Supports device-level Conversion Rate (CR) analysis, responsive design optimization, and omnichannel customer journey analytics. Derived from user-agent parsing at session creation.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Session Analytics; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of all discounts applied to the cart, including promotional markdowns, coupon redemptions, and loyalty reward deductions. Represents the aggregate reduction from subtotal_amount. Used for promotion effectiveness measurement and markdown analysis per Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: estimated_shipping_amount
attributes.description: Estimated shipping and handling cost calculated for the cart based on the selected fulfillment type, destination, and applicable shipping promotions. This is an estimate at cart stage; final shipping cost is confirmed at order submission. Relevant for BOPIS and ROPIS carts where this may be zero.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Shipping Calculation; FTC Pricing Transparency

attributes.name: estimated_tax_amount
attributes.description: Estimated sales tax calculated on the cart based on the customer's shipping destination and applicable tax jurisdiction rules. This is an estimate at cart stage; final tax is confirmed at order submission. Supports pre-checkout transparency requirements per FTC pricing standards.
attributes.references: FTC Pricing Transparency Standards; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this cart is scheduled to expire and be purged from the active cart pool if not converted or explicitly abandoned. Determined by storefront-level cart retention policy configuration. Used for cart lifecycle management, data retention compliance, and inventory reservation release scheduling.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Cart Expiry Policy; GDPR Article 5 Data Minimization

attributes.name: fulfillment_type
attributes.description: The intended fulfillment method selected by the customer for this cart. Values include standard Ship-to-Home, Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS), Reserve Online Pick Up In Store (ROPIS), Ship-from-Store (SFS), and Drop Ship (vendor direct-to-customer). Drives downstream Order Management System (OMS) routing and Last-Mile Delivery planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Fulfillment; NRF Omnichannel Fulfillment Standards

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the customer's device at the time of cart creation. Used for geolocation-based tax and shipping estimation, fraud detection, and digital analytics. May be considered PII under GDPR and CCPA in certain jurisdictions. Stored in compliance with data minimization principles.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; PCI DSS Requirement 6

attributes.name: is_abandoned
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this cart has been classified as abandoned based on session timeout or inactivity threshold rules. True when cart_status is 'abandoned'. Drives abandoned cart recovery workflow triggers in the abandoned_cart_recovery product. Supports cart abandonment rate KPI reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Cart Abandonment Rules; NRF E-Commerce Standards

attributes.name: is_guest_cart
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cart was created by an unauthenticated guest user (True) or an authenticated registered customer (False). Guest carts have limited personalization and recovery capabilities. Used for guest-to-registered conversion analysis and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) attribution.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Guest Checkout; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: item_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct line items (unique Stock Keeping Units / SKUs) currently in the cart. Used in Units Per Transaction (UPT) analysis, basket analysis, and assortment effectiveness reporting. Distinct from total_quantity which counts aggregate units across all line items.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR); NRF Basket Analysis Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the cart was most recently updated, including item additions, removals, quantity changes, coupon applications, or address updates. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used to determine cart inactivity duration for abandonment classification and session recency analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Cart Object; ISO 8601

attributes.name: locale_code
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 locale code representing the language and regional settings of the storefront session in which this cart was created (e.g., en_US, fr_CA, es_MX). Supports multi-locale storefront operations, localized pricing, and regional promotion targeting.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47 Language Tags; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Localization

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Estimated number of loyalty reward points the customer will earn upon successful conversion of this cart to an order. Displayed to the customer during checkout to incentivize purchase completion. Actual points are confirmed and awarded at order fulfillment. Supports loyalty program engagement and abandoned cart recovery messaging.
attributes.references: NRF Loyalty Program Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Loyalty Integration

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of customer loyalty reward points applied as a discount on this cart. Supports loyalty program redemption tracking, Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) analysis, and loyalty ROI measurement. Zero if no loyalty points were applied. Integrates with the Customer Loyalty and Engagement Programs business process.
attributes.references: NRF Loyalty Program Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Loyalty Integration

attributes.name: recovery_email_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether an abandoned cart recovery email has been dispatched to the customer for this cart (True) or not yet sent (False). Prevents duplicate recovery communications and supports recovery campaign performance tracking. Integrates with the abandoned_cart_recovery product for full recovery workflow visibility.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Marketing Cloud Integration; GDPR Article 6 Consent; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: saved_for_later_count
attributes.description: Number of items the customer has moved from the active cart to a 'saved for later' or wishlist holding area within the same session context. Supports purchase intent analysis, re-engagement campaign targeting, and assortment demand signal capture for merchandise planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Wishlist/Save for Later; NRF Merchandise Planning Standards

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Pre-discount, pre-tax gross merchandise value of all items in the cart at their listed retail prices. Represents the sum of (unit price × quantity) for all line items before any promotions, coupons, or markdowns are applied. Used as the base for Average Order Value (AOV) and Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Cart Pricing

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Estimated grand total for the cart calculated as subtotal_amount minus discount_amount plus estimated_tax_amount plus estimated_shipping_amount. Represents the net amount the customer is expected to pay. Used for Average Order Value (AOV) benchmarking and abandoned cart recovery value prioritization.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Cart Totals

attributes.name: total_quantity
attributes.description: Aggregate unit count across all line items in the cart (sum of quantities for all SKUs). Supports Units Per Transaction (UPT) calculation and inventory reservation planning. Differs from item_count which counts distinct SKU lines.

attributes.name: utm_campaign
attributes.description: Urchin Tracking Module (UTM) campaign parameter captured from the URL at cart creation, identifying the specific marketing campaign that drove the customer session (e.g., summer_sale_2024, loyalty_reactivation). Supports campaign-level Conversion Rate (CR), Average Order Value (AOV), and Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) attribution.
attributes.references: Google Analytics UTM Standards; NRF Digital Marketing Attribution

attributes.name: utm_source
attributes.description: Urchin Tracking Module (UTM) source parameter captured from the URL at cart creation, identifying the marketing channel or platform that drove the customer to the storefront (e.g., google, facebook, email_newsletter). Supports digital marketing attribution, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) analysis, and Return on Investment (ROI) reporting for paid and organic channels.
attributes.references: Google Analytics UTM Standards; NRF Digital Marketing Attribution

products.name: cart_item
products.description: Line-item level detail within a shopping cart, capturing the SKU/UPC added, quantity, unit price at time of add, any item-level promotion applied, item status (active, removed, saved-for-later), add-to-cart timestamp, and removal timestamp if applicable. Supports basket analysis, assortment affinity, and abandoned cart item-level recovery workflows.
products.reference: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Product Line Item

attributes.name: cart_item_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each line item within a shopping cart. Primary key for the cart_item data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Cart Line Item Object

attributes.name: cart_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent shopping cart that contains this line item. Establishes the header-to-line relationship between the cart session and its individual items.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.category. Business justification: Cart analytics by merchandise category drive assortment performance reporting, category-level conversion analysis, and merchandising optimization decisions. Replaces denormalized product_category text

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.department. Business justification: Omnichannel department-level sales and shrinkage reporting: cart_item.product_department is a denormalized string. Replacing it with a proper FK to store.department enables department-level online sal

attributes.name: digital_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.digital_catalog. Business justification: A cart item is added from a specific digital catalog listing on a storefront. The digital_catalog record captures the channel-specific published view (canonical URL, SEO title, image, publication stat

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical store selected for BOPIS or ROPIS fulfillment of this cart line item. Null for ship-to-home or drop-ship items. Supports online-to-offline attribution and store-level demand signal analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Store Locator; SAP S/4HANA Retail SD Module

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.lot. Business justification: Perishable/batch-tracked e-commerce items (grocery, pharma) require lot-level traceability for food safety recalls and FEFO fulfillment. Retail domain experts managing online grocery or regulated prod

attributes.name: price_override_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_override. Business justification: When a cart item price is overridden, the system must reference the authorizing price_override record for audit trail, fraud detection, and customer service dispute resolution. cart_item.price_overrid

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the authenticated customer who owns this cart. Null for guest/anonymous sessions. Used for abandoned cart recovery, Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) analysis, and personalization.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Customer Object; GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the item-level promotion applied to this cart line item at the time of add-to-cart. Null if no promotion was applied. Supports Pricing and Promotions Management analytics.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Salesforce Commerce Cloud Promotion Object

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_offer. Business justification: Line-level offer attribution reporting and discount accuracy auditing require each cart item to reference the specific promo_offer applied. Retail merchandising teams track offer performance at the it

attributes.name: reservation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.reservation. Business justification: When a customer adds an item to cart, a soft inventory reservation is created per line item to prevent overselling. Retail e-commerce operations require cart_item to reference its reservation for expi

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master product record associated with this cart line item. Links to the product catalog managed in Informatica MDM and Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Informatica MDM Product Golden Record

attributes.name: sku_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.sku_price. Business justification: Cart items resolve pricing at add-to-cart time from sku_price, which provides channel-specific, zone-specific, and promotion-adjusted prices. Core business process: cart pricing resolution and price l

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Cart items validate real-time inventory availability (ATP, on-hand qty) at specific nodes to prevent overselling during add-to-cart and checkout. Critical for omnichannel inventory visibility and BOPI

attributes.name: web_session_id
attributes.description: The web or app session identifier active when this item was added to the cart. Used for digital customer journey tracking, Click-Through Rate (CTR) attribution, and abandoned cart session-level recovery workflows in Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Session Tracking; GDPR Article 4 (pseudonymous identifier)

attributes.name: add_to_cart_source
attributes.description: The digital touchpoint or page from which the customer added this item to the cart. Supports Click-Through Rate (CTR) and Conversion Rate (CR) attribution analysis and product recommendation engine performance measurement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: product_detail_page|search_results|recommendation|wishlist|email_campaign|homepage|category_page|social_media|paid_ad — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Analytics; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: add_to_cart_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer added this item to the shopping cart. Principal business event timestamp for this entity. Used for abandoned cart analysis, session duration analytics, and digital customer journey tracking in Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Cart Event Timestamp; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cart line item record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for the Silver Layer record. Distinct from add_to_cart_timestamp which captures the business event time.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; Databricks Lakehouse Audit Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values on this cart line item (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, CAD). Supports multi-currency e-commerce operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: The type of device used by the customer when adding this item to the cart. Supports digital channel analytics, mobile commerce conversion rate (CR) analysis, and omnichannel customer journey attribution.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Session Analytics; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The monetary discount applied to this line item due to promotions, markdowns, or loyalty rewards. Calculated as list_price minus unit_price multiplied by quantity. Supports promotion ROI and markdown analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: fulfillment_type
attributes.description: The intended fulfillment method selected by the customer for this cart line item. Supports omnichannel fulfillment analytics including Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS), Reserve Online Pick Up In Store (ROPIS), Ship-from-Store (SFS), and Drop Ship operations.
attributes.references: NRF Omnichannel Fulfillment Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Fulfillment Options

attributes.name: gift_message
attributes.description: Optional personalized message entered by the customer for a gift item. Null if is_gift is False or no message was provided. Relevant only when is_gift is True.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Gift Message Feature; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: is_gift
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer designated this cart line item as a gift. True if the item is intended as a gift (may include gift wrapping or message); False otherwise. Supports gifting analytics and seasonal demand planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Gift Options Feature

attributes.name: is_in_stock
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product was in stock at the time the item was added to the cart. True if inventory was available; False if the item was added as a pre-order or back-order. Supports stockout-driven cart abandonment analysis.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; Blue Yonder Demand Planning; NRF Inventory Standards

attributes.name: is_private_label
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is a Private Label (store brand) item. True if the product is a store-owned brand; False if it is a national or third-party brand. Supports private label penetration rate and margin analysis.
attributes.references: NRF Private Label Standards; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: item_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cart line item. 'active' indicates the item is in the active cart; 'removed' indicates the customer explicitly removed it; 'saved_for_later' indicates the item was moved to a wishlist/save-for-later list; 'purchased' indicates the item was converted to an order; 'expired' indicates the cart session expired before checkout.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Cart Line Item Status; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cart line item record was last updated (e.g., quantity change, status change, price update). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Audit Trail

attributes.name: line_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential ordering number of this line item within the parent cart. Used to maintain consistent display order and support basket analysis sequencing.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Cart Line Item Sequence

attributes.name: line_subtotal
attributes.description: The total monetary value of this cart line item calculated as unit_price multiplied by quantity before tax. Contributes to Average Order Value (AOV) and Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) calculations at the cart level.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Line Item Subtotal; FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: The number of loyalty program points earned by the customer for purchasing this cart line item. Supports Customer Loyalty and Engagement Program analytics and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) calculations.
attributes.references: NRF Loyalty Program Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Loyalty Integration

attributes.name: purchased_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cart line item was converted to a confirmed order line. Null if the item has not been purchased. Used for cart-to-order conversion rate (CR) analysis and Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) attribution.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Order Conversion Event; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Number of units of the product added to the cart for this line item. Supports Units Per Transaction (UPT) analysis and inventory reservation checks.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Cart Line Item Quantity; NRF Retail Analytics Standards

attributes.name: quantity_available
attributes.description: The inventory quantity available for the SKU at the time the item was added to the cart. Captured as a snapshot from the inventory system. Supports out-of-stock analysis, abandoned cart attribution to stockouts, and Fill Rate reporting.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Inventory Availability; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: removal_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer explicitly removed this item from the cart. Null if the item has not been removed. Used for abandoned cart item-level recovery workflows and assortment affinity analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Cart Event Timestamp; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: saved_for_later_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer moved this item from the active cart to the saved-for-later list. Null if the item was never saved. Supports wishlist conversion rate analysis and re-engagement campaign targeting.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this cart line item record originated. Primarily Salesforce Commerce Cloud for digital storefronts. Supports data lineage tracking and Master Data Management (MDM) reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM Data Lineage Standards; ISO 27001

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The calculated tax amount applicable to this cart line item based on the product tax category and customer shipping destination. Supports financial reporting and FASB ASC 606 revenue recognition compliance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; FTC Consumer Protection; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Tax Module

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: The applicable tax rate (as a decimal fraction, e.g., 0.0875 for 8.75%) applied to this cart line item. Varies by product category and jurisdiction. Supports tax compliance reporting and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Tax Configuration

products.name: checkout
products.description: Captures the checkout funnel progression for a cart, recording each checkout step reached (cart review, address entry, shipping selection, payment entry, order review, order placed), step timestamps, step completion flags, abandonment step, selected shipping method, selected fulfillment mode (ship-to-home, BOPIS, ROPIS, drop-ship), and applied gift cards or store credits. Enables CR funnel analysis and checkout abandonment identification. Domain boundary: the checkout lifecycle ends at order placement — the order domain owns all post-placement order lifecycle (confirmation, fulfillment tracking, cancellation, modification). Digital return initiation is handed off to the returns domain.

attributes.name: checkout_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for a checkout session. Primary key for the checkout data product. Tracks the full funnel progression from cart review through order placement.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: B2B account-based checkout: corporate accounts have credit limits, tax-exempt status, and net-terms that must be validated at checkout. Retail B2B operations require checkout-to-account linkage for cr

attributes.name: carrier_service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.carrier_service. Business justification: Checkout shipping method selection directly maps to a carrier_service record. Retail uses this for shipping cost display accuracy, SLA promise validation, and carrier performance reporting by checkout

attributes.name: cart_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shopping cart that initiated this checkout session. Links the checkout funnel back to the cart and its line items in the e-commerce domain.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Checkouts for internal orders (employee purchases, corporate procurement) need cost center attribution for GL posting, budget variance analysis, and departmental expense tracking in retail accounting.

attributes.name: coupon_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.coupon. Business justification: Checkout-stage coupon validation, coupon redemption funnel analysis, and fraud detection on coupon misuse all require checkout to reference the coupon entity. Retail operations teams audit coupon appl

attributes.name: fulfillment_inventory_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.inventory_node. Business justification: BOPIS/ROPIS checkout requires the customer-selected pickup store to be recorded on the checkout record for order routing, node-level capacity management, and store fulfillment assignment. Retail domai

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.fulfillment_node. Business justification: BOPIS and ROPIS checkout flows require the customer-selected pickup node to be recorded at checkout. Retail operations use this for node-level order volume reporting, pickup slot management, and SLA c

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order record created upon successful checkout completion. Null for abandoned or expired checkouts. Represents the handoff boundary between the checkout domain and the order domain. Enables checkout-to-order attribution and funnel completion tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Order Management; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF Order Standards

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical store associated with this checkout when the fulfillment mode is Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) or Reserve Online Pick Up In Store (ROPIS). Null for ship-to-home and drop-ship fulfillment modes.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC); Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: loyalty_membership_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.loyalty_membership. Business justification: Checkout process must identify the loyalty member to validate points redemption (loyalty_points_redeemed exists on checkout), apply member-tier discounts, and generate the points ledger entry. Retail

attributes.name: payment_method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.payment_method. Business justification: Checkout saved payment method selection: customers select a stored payment method during checkout. The existing plain-text 'payment_method' column is denormalized. A proper FK enables payment validati

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_zone. Business justification: Checkout must apply zone-specific pricing rules, tax jurisdictions, and fulfillment-based price adjustments from price_zone. Core business process: final order pricing calculation based on customer lo

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the authenticated customer who initiated the checkout. Null for guest checkouts. Used for Conversion Rate (CR) funnel analysis segmented by customer cohort and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) attribution.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM Customer Golden Record; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Checkout captures final promotional context before conversion; essential for last-touch attribution, promotional effectiveness measurement at conversion stage, reconciling promotional discounts with p

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_offer. Business justification: Offer-level discount validation at checkout and maximum redemption enforcement per offer require checkout to reference the specific promo_offer applied. Retail finance teams reconcile checkout discoun

attributes.name: return_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to returns.return_policy. Business justification: At checkout, retailers must display the governing return policy (legal disclosure, consumer protection regulations). The checkout flow needs the applicable return_policy to show return window, restock

attributes.name: sfs_fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.sfs_fulfillment_node. Business justification: Ship-from-store order routing: when checkout fulfillment_mode is SFS, the specific fulfillment node must be captured to validate same-day/next-day cutoff times, picking capacity, and service postal co

attributes.name: shipping_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.address. Business justification: Captures shipping destination for order fulfillment. Business need: address validation during checkout flow, shipping cost calculation by carrier, tax jurisdiction determination for sales tax complian

attributes.name: sla_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.sla. Business justification: The delivery promise shown to customers at checkout is governed by a specific SLA record. Retail operations use this link for checkout promise accuracy audits, SLA breach attribution to checkout chann

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.storefront. Business justification: A checkout session always occurs on a specific digital storefront. This FK enables storefront-level analytics on checkout funnel performance (conversion rates, abandonment rates per storefront), suppo

attributes.name: web_session_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the digital browsing session in which this checkout was initiated. Sourced from Salesforce Commerce Cloud session tracking. Enables online-to-offline attribution and digital customer journey analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Session Tracking; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: abandoned_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the checkout session was identified as abandoned (customer exited without placing order). Null for completed or in-progress checkouts. Used for abandoned cart recovery campaigns and CR funnel drop-off analysis.

attributes.name: abandonment_step
attributes.description: The checkout funnel step at which the customer abandoned the session. Null for completed checkouts. Identifies the highest-friction point in the checkout funnel for Conversion Rate (CR) optimization and targeted recovery messaging.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Checkout Analytics; NRF E-Commerce Standards

attributes.name: address_validation_status
attributes.description: Status of the shipping address validation performed during the address entry checkout step. 'not_validated' = address entry step not yet reached; 'validated' = address confirmed by address verification service; 'failed' = address could not be validated; 'overridden' = customer proceeded with unvalidated address. Impacts last-mile delivery success rates.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Address Verification; USPS Address Validation Standards; NRF Last-Mile Delivery

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The digital commerce channel through which the checkout was initiated. 'web' = desktop/mobile web storefront; 'mobile_app' = native iOS or Android application; 'in_store_kiosk' = assisted selling kiosk in physical store; 'call_center' = agent-assisted checkout. Supports omnichannel attribution and channel-level Conversion Rate (CR) reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC); SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR); NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: checkout_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally visible reference number for the checkout session. Used in customer communications, customer service case management, and cross-system reconciliation with Salesforce Commerce Cloud. Format: CHK- followed by 10 digits.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Checkout Reference; NRF Data Standards

attributes.name: checkout_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the checkout session. 'initiated' = checkout started from cart; 'in_progress' = customer is progressing through funnel steps; 'completed' = order successfully placed; 'abandoned' = customer exited without placing order; 'expired' = session timed out before completion. Core field for Conversion Rate (CR) funnel analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Checkout Lifecycle; NRF E-Commerce Standards

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the checkout was successfully completed and the order was placed. Null if the checkout was abandoned or expired. Marks the boundary between the checkout domain and the order domain.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this checkout record was first written to the data platform (Silver Layer). Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for audit trail and data lineage purposes.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this checkout record (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency e-commerce operations and financial reporting normalization.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 606; GS1 Standards

attributes.name: current_step
attributes.description: The most recent checkout funnel step reached by the customer. Tracks progression through: cart_review → address_entry → shipping_selection → payment_entry → order_review → order_placed. Core field for Conversion Rate (CR) funnel step analysis in Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Checkout Flow; NRF E-Commerce Standards

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: The type of device used by the customer to initiate and progress through the checkout funnel. 'desktop' = web browser on desktop/laptop; 'mobile' = mobile web browser; 'tablet' = tablet web browser; 'app' = native mobile application. Enables device-level Conversion Rate (CR) analysis and checkout UX optimization.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Session Tracking; NRF E-Commerce Analytics Standards

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total promotional discount applied to this checkout from coupon codes, promotional pricing rules, and loyalty reward redemptions. Excludes gift card and store credit redemptions (tracked separately). Used for promotion effectiveness and markdown analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Promotions; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: fulfillment_mode
attributes.description: The selected fulfillment method for this checkout. 'ship_to_home' = standard home delivery; 'bopis' = Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS); 'ropis' = Reserve Online Pick Up In Store (ROPIS); 'drop_ship' = vendor ships directly to customer. Drives omnichannel attribution and last-mile delivery cost analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC); NRF Omnichannel Standards; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: gift_card_amount
attributes.description: Total value of gift cards applied as payment during this checkout. Zero if no gift cards were used. Tracked separately from promotional discounts for gift card liability accounting and tender type analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Gift Card Module; FASB ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: initiated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customer first entered the checkout funnel from the cart. Represents the principal business event timestamp (TRANSACTION_HEADER: BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP). Used to measure total checkout duration and time-to-abandon metrics.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the customer's device at the time of checkout initiation. Used for fraud detection, geolocation-based tax calculation, and digital analytics. Classified as potentially PII under GDPR and CCPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; PCI DSS v4.0; FTC Consumer Protection

attributes.name: is_address_entry_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer completed the address entry step of the checkout funnel. True = shipping/billing address entered and validated; False = not yet reached or abandoned at this step.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Checkout Funnel Tracking

attributes.name: is_cart_review_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer completed the cart review step of the checkout funnel. True = step completed and customer advanced; False = step not yet reached or abandoned at this step. Enables granular step-level Conversion Rate (CR) funnel analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Checkout Funnel Tracking

attributes.name: is_gift_order
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer designated this checkout as a gift order. True = gift order with gift messaging and/or gift wrapping selected; False = standard order. Drives gift packaging fulfillment instructions and suppresses price display on packing slips.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Gift Options; NRF Retail Standards

attributes.name: is_guest_checkout
