attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the invoice is posted (e.g., 2024). Used for annual P&L reporting, EBITDA tracking, and year-end AR close reconciliation.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total gross billed amount before tax, discounts, or adjustments. Represents the face value of goods or services invoiced to the B2B customer. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET minimum category.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the invoice was issued to the customer. Represents the principal real-world event time for revenue recognition under ASC 606. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP minimum category.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the AR invoice. Drives AR aging analysis, dunning workflow, and period-end close. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS minimum category.

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice document type in SAP FI-AR. Distinguishes standard customer invoices, credit memos for returns/adjustments, debit memos for chargebacks, proforma invoices, and intercompany billing.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Net total amount due after applying discounts and before tax. Represents the contractual obligation for payment. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET net total component.

attributes.name: open_amount
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on the invoice (net_amount minus applied_amount). Drives AR aging analysis, dunning escalation, and collections workflow prioritization.

attributes.name: payment_block
attributes.description: Indicates whether the invoice is blocked from automatic payment processing (True = blocked). Applied during dispute resolution, credit hold, or compliance review.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Agreed payment instrument for settling this invoice (e.g., ACH bank transfer, wire, check). Determines cash application routing and bank clearing workflow in SAP FI-AR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; PCI DSS (PCI SSC)

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP payment terms key (e.g., NT30, NT60, 2/10NET30) defining the payment schedule, early payment discount percentage, and due date calculation rules for this invoice.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; NRF Payment Standards

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the invoice is posted to the general ledger in SAP FI-AR. Determines the fiscal period for revenue recognition and AR balance reporting. May differ from invoice_date for period-end accruals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; FASB ASC 606; GAAP

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number provided by the customer (e.g., purchase order number, contract number) for remittance matching and EDI reconciliation. Stored in SAP FI-AR XBLNR field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: Date on which revenue from this invoice was recognized under ASC 606 criteria (performance obligation satisfied). May differ from invoice_date for multi-element arrangements or deferred revenue scenarios.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_status
attributes.description: ASC 606 revenue recognition status for this invoice. Indicates whether revenue has been recognized, is deferred pending performance obligation fulfillment, or has been reversed. Critical for FASB-compliant financial reporting.

attributes.name: sales_org_code
attributes.description: SAP sales organization (VKORG) responsible for this invoice. Enables P&L reporting and revenue attribution by sales channel, region, or business unit.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to the invoice (sales tax, VAT, or applicable jurisdiction tax). Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment component.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; FTC Pricing Transparency; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the AR invoice record in the source system. Supports change data capture and audit compliance. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED minimum category.

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: Amount written off as uncollectible bad debt for this invoice. Used for bad debt expense reporting, allowance for doubtful accounts calculation, and FASB-compliant AR reserve management.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; GAAP

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: Date on which the invoice balance was written off as bad debt in SAP FI-AR. Null until a write-off is executed. Required for bad debt aging and allowance for doubtful accounts reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; GAAP

products.name: budget
products.description: Comprehensive financial planning record encompassing annual budgets, periodic forecasts, rolling reforecasts, and forward-looking financial projections for retail business units, cost centers, and profit centers in SAP S/4HANA CO. Captures plan version (original budget, revised budget, monthly rolling forecast, quarterly reforecast, annual plan), fiscal year/period, category (CAPEX, OPEX, COGS, labor), GL account detail with line-item granularity (planned/committed/actual amounts per account and cost center), forecast method, variance analysis (budget vs. actual, forecast vs. prior forecast), revenue/COGS/gross margin/EBITDA projections by channel and business unit, approval workflow, and submission tracking. Supports OTB (Open to Buy) integration, budget vs. actual reporting, financial planning cycles, and investor financial guidance.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each budget record in the financial planning system. Primary key for the budget data product in SAP S/4HANA CO module.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center or profit center responsible for this budget line. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA CO cost center master data for P&L and EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.dc_facility. Business justification: DC operating budgets (labor, utilities, equipment) are planned and tracked by facility. Standard retail budgeting process requires facility-level budget allocation and variance reporting.

attributes.name: financial_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.financial_period. Business justification: Budget records are tied to specific fiscal periods. The budget table has fiscal_year (INT) and fiscal_period (INT) as separate columns, but no FK to the financial_period master. This FK enables joinin

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the General Ledger (GL) account associated with this budget line item, enabling line-item granularity for financial reporting and FASB-compliant disclosures.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: In SAP S/4HANA, budgets are defined within a specific ledger context (leading ledger for GAAP, extension ledgers for IFRS or management reporting). Linking finance_budget.ledger_id → ledger.ledger_id

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.location. Business justification: Store-level budgets must link directly to the store location for budget vs. actual variance reporting. Retail finance teams run store-level budget performance reports. finance_budget has cost_center_i

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.profit_center

attributes.name: actual_amount
attributes.description: The actual financial amount posted to the GL account and cost center for this budget period. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI actuals for budget vs. actual variance analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget record received final approval from the authorized approver. Required for audit trail and financial governance compliance.
attributes.references: FASB Internal Controls; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the budget record within the financial planning approval cycle. Tracks progression from draft through submission, review, approval, rejection, or period lock. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|rejected|locked — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; FASB Internal Controls

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or employee identifier of the financial authority (e.g., CFO, Finance Director, Cost Center Manager) who approved this budget record. Supports approval workflow audit trail.
attributes.references: FASB Internal Controls; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: budget_category
attributes.description: High-level financial classification of the budget line: Capital Expenditure (CAPEX), Operating Expenditure (OPEX), Cost of Goods Sold (COGS), labor costs, or revenue. Drives P&L and EBITDA reporting segmentation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; FASB ASC 842; NRF Financial Planning Standards

attributes.name: budget_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the budget record, used in financial planning communications, approval workflows, and audit trails. Format: BDG-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; NRF Financial Planning Standards

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The retail channel (store, e-commerce, omnichannel, wholesale, marketplace) for which this budget is planned. Enables channel-level revenue, COGS, and gross margin projections.

attributes.name: cogs_projection
attributes.description: Planned Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) for the budget period, used to project gross margin and support merchandise planning and Open to Buy (OTB) calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: The amount of the budget that has been formally committed through purchase orders or contracts but not yet expensed. Supports Open to Buy (OTB) integration and encumbrance accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this budget record was first created in the financial planning system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and financial close process tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this budget record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency financial planning and consolidation.

attributes.name: ebitda_projection
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Projection
attributes.description: Planned Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization (EBITDA) for the budget period. Key metric for investor financial guidance and enterprise P&L reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; NRF Financial Planning Standards

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (1–13, where 13 is a special closing period) within the fiscal year to which this budget line applies. Supports monthly and period-level budget vs. actual variance analysis in SAP CO.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter (1–4) within the fiscal year for this budget record. Used for quarterly reforecast cycles, investor financial guidance, and quarterly P&L reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; NRF Financial Planning Standards

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (e.g., 2024) to which this budget record applies. Aligns with the retail fiscal calendar in SAP S/4HANA FI for annual financial planning and investor guidance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: forecast_amount
attributes.description: The latest forward-looking financial estimate for this budget line, updated during rolling forecast or reforecast cycles. Used for forecast vs. prior forecast variance analysis and investor guidance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: forecast_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to derive the forecast or budget amounts: top-down (executive-driven allocation), bottom-up (cost center aggregation), driver-based (KPI-linked), statistical (model-driven), or zero-based budgeting.
attributes.references: NRF Financial Planning Standards; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: gross_margin_projection
attributes.description: Planned gross margin (revenue minus COGS) for the budget period and business unit. Supports Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) analysis and financial close reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; NRF Financial Planning Standards

attributes.name: is_locked
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget record has been locked for the period, preventing further edits. True when the period is closed or the budget has been formally locked post-approval.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; FASB Internal Controls

attributes.name: is_reforecast
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget record represents a reforecast (True) rather than the original budget plan (False). Distinguishes reforecast iterations from baseline budget entries for variance tracking.

attributes.name: lock_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget record was locked to prevent further modifications, typically at period-end close. Supports financial close process integrity and audit compliance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for financial planners to document assumptions, rationale, or commentary associated with this budget record. Supports audit trail and management review during financial planning cycles.
attributes.references: FASB Internal Controls; NRF Financial Planning Standards

attributes.name: otb_amount
attributes.description: The Open to Buy (OTB) amount representing the remaining purchasing budget available for merchandise procurement in this period. Calculated as planned inventory budget minus committed and received inventory costs.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF Merchandise Planning Standards

attributes.name: plan_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the planning period covered by this budget record. Defines the effective close of the budget window for financial reporting and period-end close processes.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: plan_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the planning period covered by this budget record. Defines the effective beginning of the budget window for financial close and reporting alignment.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: plan_version_type
attributes.description: Classifies the budget record by planning cycle type: original budget (initial annual plan), revised budget (approved amendment), rolling forecast (monthly update), quarterly reforecast, or annual plan. Maps to SAP CO plan version category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: planned_amount
attributes.description: The original planned financial amount for this budget line item in the functional currency. Represents the baseline against which actuals and forecasts are compared in budget vs. actual reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: prior_forecast_amount
attributes.description: The forecast amount from the immediately preceding forecast cycle, retained for forecast vs. prior forecast variance analysis and trend tracking in financial planning.

attributes.name: revenue_projection
attributes.description: Forward-looking revenue estimate for the business unit and channel in this budget period. Supports top-line financial planning, investor guidance, and Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) tracking.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; NRF Financial Planning Standards

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget record was formally submitted for approval in the financial planning workflow. Supports submission tracking and planning cycle compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; FASB Internal Controls

attributes.name: submitted_by
attributes.description: The name or employee identifier of the person who submitted this budget record for approval. Supports submission tracking and financial planning accountability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; FASB Internal Controls

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this budget record. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The absolute difference between planned amount and actual amount (actual_amount minus planned_amount) for this budget line. Positive value indicates overspend; negative indicates underspend. Supports budget vs. actual reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; NRF Financial Planning Standards

attributes.name: variance_pct
attributes.description: The percentage variance between planned and actual amounts ((actual - planned) / planned * 100). Used in financial dashboards and P&L reporting to flag material variances requiring management action.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; NRF Financial Planning Standards

products.name: financial_period
products.description: Fiscal calendar and financial period master defining the retail fiscal year structure (4-5-4 or 4-4-5 calendar), accounting periods, quarter boundaries, and year-end close dates. Includes period open/close status, period type (regular, adjustment, closing), and fiscal year variant. Controls posting periods in SAP S/4HANA FI and drives financial close scheduling.

attributes.name: financial_period_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the financial period record in the retail fiscal calendar. Primary key for the financial_period data product.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: comparable_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corresponding financial period in the prior fiscal year used for same-store sales (SSS/Comp Sales) and year-over-year (YoY) financial comparisons. Accounts for 53-week year shifts in the NRF retail calendar.
attributes.references: NRF Retail Fiscal Calendar; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: prior_year_period_financial_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the exact same period number in the immediately preceding fiscal year. Used for year-over-year (YoY) financial variance analysis, P&L comparisons, and FASB comparative financial statement preparation. Distinct from comparable_period_id which accounts for 53-week calendar shifts.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI; NRF Retail Fiscal Calendar

attributes.name: ap_posting_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts payable (AP) postings are permitted for this financial period. AP periods may be managed independently from GL periods in SAP S/4HANA to support vendor invoice processing timelines and COGS accruals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Posting Period; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: ar_posting_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts receivable (AR) postings are permitted for this financial period. AR periods may be managed independently to support customer payment processing, revenue recognition (ASC 606), and loyalty program financial settlements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Posting Period; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: budget_version
attributes.description: Identifier for the budget or plan version associated with this financial period (e.g., 'ORIGINAL', 'REVISED_Q2', 'FORECAST_V3'). Links the period to the corresponding financial plan in SAP CO for budget vs. actual variance analysis and financial planning cycles.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Planning; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: calendar_type
attributes.description: The retail fiscal calendar convention used for this period. The 4-5-4 and 4-4-5 calendars are NRF industry standards that divide the fiscal year into 4-week and 5-week periods to align comparable store sales (SSS) reporting across years.
attributes.references: NRF Retail Fiscal Calendar Standard; National Retail Federation

attributes.name: close_cycle_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days allocated for completing the financial close process for this period (from period end date to scheduled close date). A KPI for finance operations efficiency; industry benchmark for retail is typically 5–10 business days for month-end close.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; ISO 9001 Quality Management; SAP S/4HANA FI Financial Close

attributes.name: close_status
attributes.description: Status of the financial close process for this period. Tracks progression through the month-end or year-end close cycle. 'not_started' indicates close activities have not begun; 'in_progress' means close tasks are underway; 'completed' means the period is fully closed and reconciled; 'reopened' means a closed period was reopened for corrections.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI Financial Close; ISO 9001

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA company code (Buchungskreis) to which this financial period configuration applies. A company code represents an independent legal entity within the retail enterprise (e.g., a specific banner, subsidiary, or country operation).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code (OX02); FASB ASC 606; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: SAP CO controlling area code associated with this financial period. The controlling area defines the organizational unit for cost accounting, P&L reporting, and EBITDA tracking within SAP S/4HANA CO module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Controlling Area (OKKP); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this financial period record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements, data lineage tracking, and financial close governance per ISO 27001 and FASB standards.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; FASB ASC 606; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the functional currency of the company code during this financial period (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Governs currency translation for consolidated P&L and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the financial period (inclusive). Defines the upper boundary for transaction posting, revenue recognition cutoff, and financial close. For 53-week fiscal years, the final period end date may extend one week beyond the standard calendar.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; FASB ASC 842; SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period; ISO 8601

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The retail fiscal year to which this period belongs (e.g., 2024). Retail fiscal years may not align with the calendar year; typically begins in late January or early February per the 4-5-4 or 4-4-5 retail calendar convention.
attributes.references: NRF Retail Fiscal Calendar Standard; FASB ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant (T009)

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: SAP fiscal year variant code defining the fiscal year structure (e.g., 'K4' for calendar year, 'V3' for April–March, or a custom retail variant). Determines how posting periods map to calendar months in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant (T009); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: gl_posting_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether general ledger (GL) journal entry postings are currently permitted for this financial period. Derived from posting_status but maintained as an explicit business flag for integration with downstream systems that check posting eligibility.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period (OB52); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: is_53_week_year
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fiscal year containing this period is a 53-week year. Under the NRF 4-5-4 calendar, a 53rd week occurs approximately every 5–6 years to realign the fiscal calendar with the Gregorian calendar. Impacts comparable store sales (SSS) comparisons and year-over-year financial analysis.
attributes.references: NRF Retail Fiscal Calendar Standard; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: is_adjustment_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a special adjustment period (periods 13–16 in SAP) used exclusively for year-end audit adjustments, accrual reversals, and FASB-required restatements. Adjustment periods do not correspond to calendar time.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Special Periods; FASB ASC 606; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: is_quarter_end_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether this period is the final period of a fiscal quarter, triggering quarterly close procedures, quarterly P&L reporting, and SEC 10-Q filing preparation for publicly traded retail entities.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; SEC 10-Q Quarterly Reporting; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: is_year_end_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether this period is the final period of the fiscal year requiring year-end close procedures, including balance sheet finalization, retained earnings posting, and annual financial statement preparation per FASB standards.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI Year-End Close; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: ledger_group
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA ledger group identifier that this period applies to (e.g., '0L' for leading ledger, 'L1' for local GAAP ledger, 'L2' for IFRS ledger). Supports parallel accounting for multi-GAAP retail entities operating across jurisdictions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Parallel Accounting; FASB ASC 606; IFRS 15

attributes.name: mm_posting_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether materials management (MM) postings — including goods receipts, inventory adjustments, and COGS postings — are permitted for this financial period in SAP S/4HANA MM module. Critical for inventory valuation and COGS accuracy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Posting Period (MMPV); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or commentary associated with this financial period (e.g., 'Holiday season period — extended close window', 'Includes 53rd week adjustment', 'Restatement applied per ASC 606 guidance'). Used by finance teams for period-specific documentation.

attributes.name: period_close_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the financial period was officially closed in SAP S/4HANA FI, preventing further postings. Critical for financial close scheduling, audit compliance, and FASB revenue recognition cutoff enforcement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period (OB52); FASB ASC 606; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: period_length_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days in the financial period (typically 28 or 35 days for 4-week or 5-week NRF periods). Used for daily average calculations, proration of fixed costs, and lease accounting (ASC 842) period allocations.
attributes.references: NRF Retail Fiscal Calendar; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: period_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name for the financial period (e.g., 'FY2024 Period 1', 'Q1 FY2024 Week 1', 'January 2024'). Used in financial reports, P&L statements, and EBITDA dashboards for period labeling.
attributes.references: NRF Retail Fiscal Calendar; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: period_number
attributes.description: Sequential period number within the fiscal year (1–12 for regular periods, 13–16 for special/adjustment periods). Maps to SAP S/4HANA posting period (MONAT) in table BKPF. Controls which periods are open for posting in the general ledger.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period (OB52); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: period_open_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the posting period was officially opened for journal entry postings in SAP S/4HANA FI. Used for financial close audit trails and compliance with FASB reporting timelines.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period (OB52); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: period_short_code
attributes.description: Standardized short code uniquely identifying the financial period across systems (e.g., 'FY2024P01', 'FY2024P13'). Used as a business key for cross-system integration between SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS), and financial reporting tools.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Informatica MDM

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the period by its accounting purpose. 'regular' periods are standard operating periods; 'adjustment' periods are used for year-end adjustments; 'closing' periods are used for financial close entries; 'opening' periods for balance carryforward; 'special' for audit or correction postings.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI Special Periods (OBH2); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current open/close status of the posting period in the general ledger. 'open' allows new journal entries; 'closed' prevents further postings; 'blocked' restricts posting pending review; 'future' indicates the period is not yet active. Controls SAP S/4HANA FI posting period management (OB52).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period (OB52); FASB ASC 606; ISO 9001

attributes.name: quarter_name
attributes.description: Human-readable fiscal quarter label (e.g., 'Q1 FY2024', 'Q4 FY2023'). Used in financial reporting dashboards, investor relations materials, and comparable store sales (SSS/Comp Sales) analysis.
attributes.references: NRF Retail Fiscal Calendar; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: quarter_number
attributes.description: Fiscal quarter (1–4) to which this period belongs within the fiscal year. Used for quarterly P&L reporting, EBITDA tracking, and SEC/FASB quarterly financial disclosures.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; SEC Quarterly Reporting (10-Q); NRF Retail Fiscal Calendar

attributes.name: reopen_date
attributes.description: The date on which a previously closed financial period was reopened for additional postings or corrections. Populated only when close_status is 'reopened'. Supports audit trail requirements for FASB restatements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period; FASB ASC 606; ISO 27001

attributes.name: reopen_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for reopening a previously closed financial period (e.g., 'Audit adjustment required', 'Revenue recognition restatement per ASC 606', 'Vendor chargeback correction'). Required for SOX compliance and audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI; ISO 27001

attributes.name: scheduled_close_date
attributes.description: The planned/target date for completing the financial close process for this period, as defined in the financial close calendar. Used to track close cycle performance and SLA adherence for the finance operations team.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI Financial Close; ISO 9001

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the financial period. Defines the inclusive lower boundary for transaction posting, revenue recognition (ASC 606), and financial close scheduling.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period; ISO 8601

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this financial period record (e.g., status change, reopen event, close date update). Supports change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; FASB ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: week_number
attributes.description: Fiscal week number within the fiscal year (1–52 or 1–53 for 53-week years). Critical for weekly retail performance reporting, same-store sales (SSS) comparisons, and Open-to-Buy (OTB) planning cycles.
attributes.references: NRF Retail Fiscal Calendar; SAP S/4HANA CAR (Customer Activity Repository)

products.name: tax_posting
products.description: Tax transaction record capturing sales tax, VAT, use tax, and excise duty postings on retail transactions in SAP S/4HANA FI-TX. Includes tax code, tax jurisdiction (state/county/city/country), taxable base amount, tax amount, tax rate, tax type (input/output), tax determination date, reporting period, nexus indicator, exempt flag, and source document reference. Supports multi-jurisdiction sales tax compliance, Streamlined Sales Tax (SST) reporting, tax return preparation, tax audit defense, and regulatory reporting to federal, state, and local tax authorities.

attributes.name: tax_posting_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tax posting transaction record in SAP S/4HANA FI-TX.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Tax Posting Object

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Tax-exempt certificate validation and account-level nexus determination require linking tax postings to customer accounts. Retail tax compliance audits verify tax_exempt_certificate_number and tax_exe

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ap_invoice. Business justification: Vendor invoices (AP) are a primary source of tax postings in retail — purchase tax, use tax, and VAT on vendor invoices must be tracked. Linking tax_posting.ap_invoice_id → ap_invoice.ap_invoice_id en

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ar_invoice. Business justification: Customer invoices (AR) generate sales tax and VAT postings in retail operations. Linking tax_posting.ar_invoice_id → ar_invoice.ar_invoice_id enables direct reconciliation of tax collected on customer

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Tax postings have cost_center (STRING) but no FK to cost_center master. This FK enables cost allocation for tax expenses.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.dc_facility. Business justification: Sales and use tax postings by facility location for nexus determination, tax jurisdiction assignment, and compliance reporting. Required for multi-state retail tax compliance and audit defense.

attributes.name: financial_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.financial_period. Business justification: Tax postings must be associated with a financial period for period-end tax accruals, VAT return filing, and regulatory reporting. The existing reporting_period STRING is a denormalized text field that

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Tax postings have gl_account_number (STRING) but no FK to gl_account master. This FK enables account validation for tax postings.

attributes.name: inbound_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.inbound_shipment. Business justification: Cross-border retail inbound shipments trigger import duties, customs taxes, and freight taxes posted directly against the shipment. Tax authorities require shipment-level tax audit trails. tax_posting

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Tax postings in SAP S/4HANA are always generated as part of a GL document posting. Linking tax_posting.journal_entry_id → journal_entry.journal_entry_id provides direct traceability from the tax sub-l

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Tax postings in SAP S/4HANA are ledger-specific — tax amounts may differ between leading ledger (GAAP) and extension ledgers (IFRS, management). Linking tax_posting.ledger_id → ledger.ledger_id enable

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the retail store location where the taxable transaction occurred (for POS sales tax postings).

attributes.name: order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_line. Business justification: Line-level tax compliance: e-commerce and omnichannel orders require per-line tax postings for multi-jurisdiction nexus reporting and ASC 740 compliance. Retail tax teams trace tax postings to origina

attributes.name: original_posting_tax_posting_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original tax posting ID that this record reverses (populated only when reversal_flag is true).

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.pos_transaction. Business justification: Sales tax compliance: every POS transaction generates tax postings for jurisdiction-level remittance and audit. Tax authorities require transaction-level traceability. A retail tax compliance analyst

attributes.name: pos_transaction_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.pos_transaction_line. Business justification: POS line-level tax audit: each POS transaction line has its own tax_code and tax_rate; tax postings must trace to the specific line for sales tax audit defense, jurisdiction remittance, and tax-exempt

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the customer for output tax postings on sales transactions.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Tax postings have profit_center (STRING) but no FK to profit_center master. This FK enables P&L allocation for tax expenses.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.shipment. Business justification: Sales tax / VAT compliance: in retail, the taxable event is the shipment of goods to the customer. Tax authorities require traceability from tax postings to the shipment that triggered the tax obligat

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the supplier/vendor for input tax postings on purchase transactions.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Cross-reference to supporting documentation for tax audit defense (original invoice, receipt, exemption certificate, tax calculation log).

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: The business area code for cross-company-code financial reporting and segment analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Business Area Configuration

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code representing the legal entity responsible for this tax posting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this tax posting record was first created in the SAP S/4HANA FI-TX system.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known accounting document number from which this tax posting originated (invoice, receipt, credit memo).

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type of source accounting document that generated this tax posting.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate used to convert transaction currency to local currency for GL posting.

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the company's local reporting currency for financial consolidation.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this tax posting record was last modified (for correction postings or adjustments).

attributes.name: nexus_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the retailer has established tax nexus (physical or economic presence) in this jurisdiction, triggering tax collection obligation.
attributes.references: US Supreme Court South Dakota v. Wayfair (2018)

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date when the tax transaction was posted to the general ledger in SAP S/4HANA FI.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this posting is a reversal of a previously posted tax transaction (for corrections or cancellations).

attributes.name: reverse_charge_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a reverse charge VAT transaction where the customer is responsible for self-assessing and remitting VAT.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The calculated tax amount posted to the tax GL account, in transaction currency.

attributes.name: tax_amount_local_currency
attributes.description: The tax amount converted to local reporting currency for financial statement consolidation.

attributes.name: tax_authority_name
attributes.description: The name of the government tax authority to which this tax will be remitted (e.g., California Department of Tax and Fee Administration, IRS).
attributes.references: State and Local Tax Authority Registry

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The SAP tax code that defines the tax type, rate, and GL account assignment for this posting.

attributes.name: tax_determination_date
attributes.description: The business event date used to determine applicable tax rates and jurisdiction (typically transaction date or delivery date).

attributes.name: tax_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is input tax (paid to suppliers) or output tax (collected from customers).

attributes.name: tax_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction qualified for tax exemption (e.g., resale certificate, government entity, non-profit exemption).

attributes.name: tax_exemption_certificate_number
attributes.description: The exemption certificate number provided by the customer to support tax-exempt status (resale certificate, government ID, non-profit certificate).
attributes.references: Streamlined Sales Tax (SST) Exemption Certificate Standards

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_city
attributes.description: City or municipality name for city-level sales tax jurisdictions (applicable in US multi-jurisdiction tax scenarios).

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Composite jurisdiction code uniquely identifying the complete tax authority (country-state-county-city combination).

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the tax jurisdiction where the tax obligation arises.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_county
attributes.description: County or district name for county-level sales tax jurisdictions (applicable in US multi-jurisdiction tax scenarios).

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code within the country for state-level sales tax (US) or provincial tax (Canada).

attributes.name: tax_point_date
attributes.description: The date when the tax liability arises for VAT purposes (typically invoice date or goods delivery date per VAT regulations).

attributes.name: tax_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The effective tax rate percentage applied to the taxable base (e.g., 8.25000 for 8.25% sales tax).
attributes.references: State and Local Tax Authority Rate Tables

attributes.name: tax_registration_number
attributes.description: The retailer's tax registration number with the jurisdiction's tax authority (sales tax permit number, VAT registration number, GST number).

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: The category of tax being posted (sales tax, VAT, use tax, excise duty, withholding tax, customs duty).

attributes.name: taxable_base_amount
attributes.description: The gross transaction amount subject to tax before tax calculation, in transaction currency.

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the tax transaction was recorded.

products.name: ledger
products.description: Master reference table for ledger. Referenced by ledger_id.

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Primary key for ledger

attributes.name: parent_ledger_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on ledger (parent_ledger_id)

attributes.name: accounting_standard
attributes.description: The accounting standard or framework that governs this ledger (e.g., US GAAP, IFRS).

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The legal entity or company code to which this ledger belongs in the enterprise structure.

attributes.name: consolidation_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for consolidation scenarios when this ledger is used for group reporting.

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: The controlling area code for management accounting and cost center reporting associated with this ledger.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this ledger record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the functional currency of the ledger.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this ledger ceases to be active for new postings. Null indicates an open-ended ledger.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this ledger becomes active and available for financial postings.

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: Code representing the fiscal calendar variant used by this ledger (e.g., calendar year, 4-4-5 retail calendar).

attributes.name: is_consolidation_ledger
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this ledger is used for group consolidation and intercompany elimination purposes.

attributes.name: is_leading_ledger
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the primary leading ledger for the organization (true) or a secondary/parallel ledger (false).

attributes.name: last_closed_date
attributes.description: The date when the most recent period close was completed for this ledger.

attributes.name: last_closed_period
attributes.description: The most recent fiscal period (YYYYMM format) that has been closed in this ledger.

attributes.name: ledger_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the ledger based on reporting purpose and accounting framework alignment.

attributes.name: ledger_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the ledger used in financial reporting and system integration.

attributes.name: ledger_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the ledger purpose, scope, and usage within the financial reporting framework.

attributes.name: ledger_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the ledger for human-readable identification.

attributes.name: ledger_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the ledger in the financial system lifecycle.

attributes.name: ledger_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ledger based on its functional purpose in the financial accounting system.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified this ledger record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this ledger record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: posting_period_variant
attributes.description: Code defining the number and structure of posting periods (e.g., 12 regular periods plus special periods) for this ledger.

attributes.name: profit_loss_account
attributes.description: General ledger account number used for profit and loss statement aggregation.

attributes.name: retained_earnings_account
attributes.description: General ledger account number used for retained earnings carry-forward during year-end closing.

attributes.name: supports_cost_center
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this ledger supports cost center accounting for overhead allocation and analysis.

attributes.name: supports_profit_center
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this ledger supports profit center accounting for internal management reporting.

attributes.name: supports_segment_reporting
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this ledger supports segment-level financial reporting as required by FASB ASC 280.

attributes.name: valuation_view
attributes.description: The valuation perspective or view that this ledger represents for parallel accounting purposes.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who created this ledger record in the system.

domains.name: supplychain
domains.description: Manages end-to-end supply chain planning and execution from demand forecasting through distribution center operations, including facility management, warehouse workflows, inbound/outbound logistics, replenishment planning, purchase order lifecycle, cross-docking, and supply chain performance monitoring.

products.name: replenishment_plan
products.description: Replenishment plans for SKUs across all supply chain nodes (stores, DCs, MFCs), generated by Blue Yonder or equivalent planning engine. Captures planned order quantities, replenishment triggers, reorder points, safety stock levels and policy parameters (calculation method, service level target, demand variability factor), weeks-of-supply targets, plan status, and MOQ enforcement rules (minimum order quantity, order multiples, minimum order value). SSOT for automated replenishment decisions including buffer stock governance and supplier ordering constraints.

attributes.name: replenishment_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each replenishment plan record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the replenishment_plan data product.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 11179 - Data Element Naming and Definition

attributes.name: assortment_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.assortment_plan. Business justification: Assortment plans define active SKUs, depth targets, and planned weeks of supply that directly govern replenishment logic. Retail replenishment systems must know which assortment plan authorized each S

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_budget. Business justification: Retail Open-to-Buy (OTB) budgeting requires replenishment plans to consume and track against finance_budget OTB allocations. replenishment_plan.otb_consumed and finance_budget.otb_amount are the two s

attributes.name: cost_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.cost_price. Business justification: Replenishment order valuation uses the current landed cost price to calculate planned_order_value and assess margin. Retail supply planners reference cost_price for accurate order economics. unit_cost

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Reference to the demand forecast plan from Blue Yonder Demand Planning that drove the generation of this replenishment plan. Enables traceability from replenishment decision back to the underlying demand signal.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Demand Plan Reference

attributes.name: inventory_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supply chain node (store, Distribution Center (DC), or Micro-Fulfillment Center (MFC)) for which this replenishment plan is generated. Identifies the destination receiving location in the replenishment network.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Network Node; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: merch_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.merch_plan. Business justification: Replenishment plans must reconcile against merchandise plan OTB budgets and planned receipt amounts. Retail S&OP process requires planners to validate that replenishment orders stay within merch plan

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.plan. Business justification: A replenishment plan for a specific SKU/node is generated within the context of a broader aggregated supply plan. Linking replenishment_plan.plan_id → plan.plan_id provides the parent-child traceabili

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Retail replenishment planners create promotional replenishment plans (event buys / inventory builds) tied to specific campaigns. The existing 'promotion_flag' on replenishment_plan signals this need;

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.season. Business justification: Replenishment plans in retail are season-scoped — seasonal items have distinct reorder points, safety stock levels, and plan horizon dates tied to season buy deadlines and clearance exit dates. Season

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for which this replenishment plan is generated. The SKU is the primary product-level identifier used in replenishment planning across stores, DCs, and MFCs.
attributes.references: GS1 - Global Product Identification Standards; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary supplier responsible for fulfilling this replenishment plan. Links to the supplier master for MOQ enforcement, lead time, and EDI ordering constraints.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Vendor Master; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: approved_order_qty
attributes.description: The final order quantity approved by the buyer or auto-approved by the system after MOQ, order multiple, and buyer override adjustments. This is the quantity that will be transmitted to the supplier via EDI or purchase order.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Purchase Order Quantity; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: buyer_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a buyer has manually overridden the system-generated planned order quantity or parameters. True = buyer override applied; False = system-generated values accepted as-is. Supports audit trail for manual interventions.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Buyer Override; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this replenishment plan record was first persisted in the Silver layer lakehouse. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 - Information Security Management; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the planned order value and unit cost are expressed (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-currency retail operations.

attributes.name: current_on_hand_qty
attributes.description: The quantity of the SKU physically on hand at the supply node at the time the replenishment plan was generated. Sourced from Manhattan Associates WMS or SAP S/4HANA WM. Used as the starting inventory position for plan calculations.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - On-Hand Inventory; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

attributes.name: demand_variability_factor
attributes.description: A statistical measure of demand variability (coefficient of variation or standard deviation of demand) used by the planning engine to size safety stock. Higher values indicate more volatile demand and result in larger safety stock buffers.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Demand Variability Parameter

attributes.name: fill_rate_target_pct
attributes.description: The target order fill rate percentage (Fill Rate) for this replenishment plan, representing the percentage of demand that should be fulfilled from available inventory. Used as a supply chain performance KPI (KPI) target for this SKU-node combination.
attributes.references: NRF Supply Chain KPI Standards; Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Fill Rate Target

attributes.name: forecasted_demand_qty
attributes.description: The total forecasted demand quantity for the SKU at the supply node over the plan horizon, as generated by Blue Yonder Demand Planning. The primary input to the planned order quantity calculation.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Demand Forecast; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days from purchase order placement to expected receipt at the supply node, as defined in the supplier contract or purchasing info record. Used to calculate reorder points and plan order release dates.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Purchasing Info Record Lead Time; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: min_order_value
attributes.description: The minimum monetary value of a purchase order required by the supplier, expressed in the operating currency. Replenishment plans that do not meet the minimum order value threshold are consolidated or flagged for buyer action.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Purchasing Info Record; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: The minimum number of units that must be ordered from the supplier per purchase order line, as enforced by supplier contract terms. Replenishment plans with planned_order_qty below MOQ are rounded up or flagged for buyer review.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Purchasing Info Record MOQ; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: moq_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the planned order quantity meets or exceeds the supplier's Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) constraint. True = compliant; False = below MOQ threshold and requires buyer review or order consolidation before release.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MOQ Validation; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: node_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of supply chain node receiving the replenishment. Values: store (retail store), dc (Distribution Center), mfc (Micro-Fulfillment Center), dark_store (fulfillment-only location). Drives replenishment logic and lead time parameters.
attributes.references: NRF Supply Chain Standards; Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Node Classification

attributes.name: on_order_qty
attributes.description: The quantity of the SKU already on open purchase orders or in-transit to the supply node at the time of plan generation. Included in the net inventory position calculation to avoid over-ordering.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Open Purchase Order Quantity; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: order_multiple
attributes.description: The unit increment in which the SKU must be ordered (e.g., case pack size, pallet quantity). Planned order quantities are rounded up to the nearest order multiple before purchase order generation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Purchasing Info Record; GS1 - Packaging Hierarchy Standards

attributes.name: order_release_date
attributes.description: The date on which the replenishment plan is scheduled to be released as a purchase order to the supplier. Calculated by subtracting lead time from the planned receipt date. Drives the purchasing execution calendar.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MRP Order Release Date; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: override_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why a buyer manually overrode the system-generated replenishment plan. Populated only when buyer_override_flag is True. Supports root cause analysis of planning accuracy and buyer behavior patterns.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Override Reason; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: plan_generation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the replenishment plan was generated by the planning engine (Blue Yonder or equivalent). Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Used for plan freshness assessment and demand signal alignment.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Plan Run Timestamp

attributes.name: plan_horizon_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the planning horizon covered by this replenishment plan. Defines the end of the demand forecast window. Together with plan_horizon_start_date, bounds the coverage period for this plan.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Planning Horizon; SAP S/4HANA MM - Planning Period

attributes.name: plan_horizon_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the planning horizon covered by this replenishment plan. Defines the beginning of the demand forecast window used to generate the planned order quantity.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Planning Horizon; SAP S/4HANA MM - Planning Period

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the replenishment plan within the planning and execution workflow. Drives automated ordering triggers and buyer review queues. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|proposed|approved|released|in_progress|completed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Plan Status Lifecycle; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the origin and nature of the replenishment plan. Automated plans are system-generated by Blue Yonder; manual plans are buyer-created; override plans supersede automated recommendations; emergency plans address urgent stockout risk.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Plan Type Classification; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: planned_order_qty
attributes.description: The quantity of units recommended by the planning engine to be ordered for this SKU at the specified supply node. Subject to MOQ and order multiple enforcement before release to purchasing.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Planned Order Quantity; SAP S/4HANA MM - MRP Planned Order

attributes.name: planned_order_value
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the planned replenishment order, calculated as planned_order_qty multiplied by unit_cost. Used for Open-to-Buy (OTB) budget management and financial planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Open to Buy; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: planned_receipt_date
attributes.description: The expected date on which the replenishment order is planned to be received at the supply node, calculated as the order release date plus supplier lead time. Used for inventory projection and DC scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MRP Planned Receipt Date; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: promotion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this replenishment plan was generated or adjusted to support a planned promotional event. True = promotion-driven uplift included in forecasted demand; False = baseline replenishment. Links to promotional demand lift in Blue Yonder.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Promotional Demand; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM)

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: The inventory level (in units) at the supply node at which a replenishment order is triggered. Calculated as safety stock plus expected demand during supplier lead time. Core parameter for reorder-point-based replenishment policies.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Reorder Point Calculation; SAP S/4HANA MM - MRP Parameters

attributes.name: replenishment_method
attributes.description: The replenishment policy calculation method applied to generate this plan. Min/Max triggers orders when inventory falls below minimum; Reorder Point (ROP) uses statistical triggers; Days of Supply targets coverage duration; Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) delegates to supplier; Cross-Docking bypasses storage; Direct Store Delivery (DSD) is supplier-direct. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: min_max|reorder_point|days_of_supply|vendor_managed|cross_dock|dsd — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Replenishment Policy; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: safety_stock_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate the safety stock quantity. Fixed uses a static buffer; Statistical uses demand variability and lead time variance; Days of Supply targets a coverage duration; Service Level Based derives buffer from the target service level percentage.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Safety Stock Policy; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: safety_stock_qty
attributes.description: The buffer stock quantity maintained at the supply node to protect against demand variability and supply uncertainty. Represents the minimum inventory floor below which replenishment is urgently triggered. Also referred to as buffer stock.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Safety Stock; SAP S/4HANA MM - Safety Stock Level

attributes.name: service_level_target_pct
attributes.description: The target in-stock service level percentage used to calculate safety stock and replenishment parameters. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 95.00 = 95%). Represents the probability of not experiencing a stockout during the replenishment lead time.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Service Level Target; NRF Supply Chain KPI Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that generated or last updated this replenishment plan. Supports data lineage and Silver layer provenance tracking. Values: blue_yonder (Blue Yonder Demand Planning), sap_s4hana (SAP S/4HANA MM), orms (Oracle Retail Merchandising System), manual (buyer-created).
attributes.references: Informatica MDM - Source System Lineage; ISO 27001 - Data Provenance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this replenishment plan record was last modified in the Silver layer lakehouse. Tracks buyer overrides, status transitions, and plan revisions.

attributes.name: weeks_of_supply_target
attributes.description: The target number of weeks of inventory coverage (Weeks of Supply / WOS) that the replenishment plan aims to achieve at the supply node after order receipt. Used as a planning horizon parameter for days-of-supply replenishment methods.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Weeks of Supply Target; NRF Supply Chain KPI Standards

products.name: demand_forecast
products.description: SKU-level demand forecast records generated by Blue Yonder Demand Planning. Captures forecasted units, revenue, forecast horizon, statistical model used, override flags, forecast accuracy (MAPE/WMAPE), and demand signals including seasonality, promotions lift, and trend adjustments. Drives replenishment and OTB planning.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each SKU-level demand forecast record generated by Blue Yonder Demand Planning. Serves as the primary key for this table.

attributes.name: assortment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.assortment. Business justification: Assortment-scoped demand forecasting: demand forecasts are only generated for SKU-location combinations that are active in the assortment. Linking demand_forecast to assortment enables planners to val

attributes.name: assortment_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.assortment_plan. Business justification: New item demand forecasting (is_new_item flag on demand_forecast) is seeded from assortment plans — the assortment_plan defines planned_sku_count and planned_units for new items. Retail demand planner

attributes.name: customer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: Segment-driven demand planning: retail demand planners adjust forecasts based on customer segment behavior (churn risk, purchase frequency, AOV). Linking demand_forecast to the driving customer segmen

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store, distribution center (DC), or fulfillment node for which the demand forecast applies. Supports store-level and DC-level replenishment planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) — Location Management

attributes.name: merch_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.merch_plan. Business justification: Demand forecasts must reconcile against merchandise plan planned_sales_amount and planned_units as top-down targets. Retail S&OP requires demand planners to show forecast vs. merch plan variance. This

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Retail demand planners build promotional demand forecasts tied to specific campaigns to model promotional lift units. The 'promotional_lift_units' and 'is_promotional_period' attributes on demand_fore

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.season. Business justification: Demand forecasts in retail are inherently seasonal — seasonality_index, forecast horizon, and promotional lift are all season-driven. Linking demand_forecast to season enables season-level forecast ac

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) for which the demand forecast is generated. The SKU is the atomic unit of inventory and demand planning in retail.
attributes.references: GS1 — Global Product Classification; Informatica MDM — Product Golden Record

attributes.name: baseline_forecast_units
attributes.description: The pure statistical baseline demand forecast in units before any adjustments for promotions, seasonality, or manual overrides. Provides the unadjusted demand signal for comparison against the final consensus forecast.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Baseline Demand Signal

attributes.name: confidence_level_pct
attributes.description: The statistical confidence level (expressed as a percentage, e.g., 95.00) associated with the forecast interval. Indicates the probability that actual demand will fall within the forecast range. Used to set safety stock levels and replenishment buffers.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Probabilistic Forecasting; NRF — Inventory Optimization Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this demand forecast record was first written to the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports data lineage, audit trails, and incremental load processing.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Information Security Management; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the forecasted revenue amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency retail operations across international markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; FASB — Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that provided the demand signal inputs used to generate this forecast (e.g., SAP_CAR for POS transaction data, Salesforce_Commerce_Cloud for e-commerce demand, ORMS for inventory positions). Supports data lineage and source system auditability.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR); Informatica MDM — Data Lineage; ISO 27001 — Information Security

attributes.name: demand_category
attributes.description: Classification of the SKU's demand pattern used to select the appropriate forecasting model. 'regular' indicates stable, predictable demand; 'intermittent' indicates sporadic demand (Croston model); 'lumpy' indicates irregular high-volume spikes; 'new_item' indicates insufficient history; 'end_of_life' indicates declining/discontinuing SKU.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Demand Classification; NRF — Assortment Planning Standards

attributes.name: forecast_bias
attributes.description: The systematic directional error in the forecast, calculated as the mean of (forecasted units minus actual units) over a rolling period. Positive values indicate over-forecasting (excess inventory risk); negative values indicate under-forecasting (stockout risk). Critical for replenishment safety stock calibration.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Forecast Bias Analysis; NRF — Inventory Planning Standards

attributes.name: forecast_generation_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when this forecast record was generated by the Blue Yonder Demand Planning engine. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for the forecast lifecycle and supports version comparison across planning cycles.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Forecast Run Audit

attributes.name: forecast_horizon_weeks
attributes.description: The total number of weeks into the future covered by this forecast run, measured from the forecast generation date. Determines the planning horizon for replenishment, Open-to-Buy (OTB), and supply chain optimization.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Horizon Configuration; NRF — Supply Chain Planning Standards

attributes.name: forecast_lower_bound_units
attributes.description: The lower bound of the forecast confidence interval in units at the specified confidence level. Represents the low-demand scenario used for minimum order quantity (MOQ) planning and markdown risk assessment.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Probabilistic Forecast Intervals

attributes.name: forecast_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the forecast horizon period covered by this record. Together with forecast_period_start_date, defines the time bucket granularity (daily, weekly, monthly).
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Forecast Horizon Configuration

attributes.name: forecast_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the forecast horizon period covered by this record. Defines the beginning of the time bucket (day, week, or month) for which demand is forecasted.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Forecast Horizon Configuration

attributes.name: forecast_run_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific Blue Yonder Demand Planning batch run that generated this forecast record. Enables traceability back to the originating planning cycle and supports audit of forecast lineage.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Forecast Run Management

attributes.name: forecast_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the demand forecast record. 'draft' indicates a preliminary run; 'published' indicates the forecast is active for replenishment; 'approved' indicates planner sign-off; 'overridden' indicates a manual adjustment was applied; 'superseded' indicates a newer run has replaced this record; 'archived' indicates the record is retained for historical analysis only.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Forecast Workflow; NRF — Demand Planning Best Practices

attributes.name: forecast_type
attributes.description: Classification of the demand forecast by its planning purpose. 'baseline' is the statistical base demand without uplift; 'promotional' incorporates promotion lift; 'seasonal' reflects seasonal index adjustments; 'event_driven' accounts for specific demand events; 'consensus' is the final agreed forecast used for replenishment and Open-to-Buy (OTB) planning.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Forecast Type Configuration; NRF — Demand Planning Standards

attributes.name: forecast_upper_bound_units
attributes.description: The upper bound of the forecast confidence interval in units at the specified confidence level. Represents the high-demand scenario used for safety stock and maximum inventory planning to prevent stockouts.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Probabilistic Forecast Intervals

attributes.name: forecast_version
attributes.description: An incrementing integer version number for the forecast record for a given SKU-location-period combination. Enables tracking of forecast revisions across planning cycles and supports comparison of forecast evolution over time.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Forecast Versioning; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: forecasted_revenue
attributes.description: The projected revenue in the operating currency derived from the forecasted units multiplied by the expected selling price for the forecast period. Used in financial planning, Open-to-Buy (OTB) budgeting, and Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Financial Forecast Output

attributes.name: forecasted_units
attributes.description: The statistical model's predicted demand quantity in sellable units for the SKU at the specified location during the forecast period. This is the primary quantitative output of the demand planning engine and drives replenishment order quantities.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Demand Signal Output; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) — Replenishment Planning

attributes.name: is_latest_version
attributes.description: Indicates whether this forecast record is the most current version for the given SKU-location-period combination. True means this record is the active forecast used for replenishment and OTB planning; False means it has been superseded by a newer forecast run.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Forecast Version Management; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: is_new_item
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU is a new item with insufficient sales history for statistical forecasting.
